Feeds.qm_lovestory_act2_1AttachmentName: {cityname} is spending Valentine’s Day with Mr. ADVENTURE!

Missions.april_fools_task_1_reward: Thanks, we need all of the help we can get!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_1_desc: I want to welcome Santa with some of my famous gingerbread cookies! All I need is some ginger!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_2_desc: I want to make enough cookies for Santa and all of his elves. So let's head to the bakery!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_2_reward: I must've gotten the recipe wrong! This isn't a gingerbread cookie! It's a gingerbread man!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_3_desc: Well, I can't let the gingerbread man go out into the cold like this! Let's get him a sweater!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_3_reward: The gingerbread man says he has someone visiting him for the Holidays! A gingerbread woman!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_4_desc: Let's pick her up so that the ginger couple can have a happy Holidays together!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_4_reward: Aw, true love reunited! Reminds me of my time in Paris!
Missions.snm_holiday_baker_task_5_desc: The happy couple likes it so much here that they want to move into CityVille!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_1_desc: Time to make my last trip before the holiday!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_1_reward: Whoa, the train's going off the tracks! It's under some kind of magic spell!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_2_desc: We must tell all the children in the neighborhood!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_2_reward: All the children are boarding the train in their pajamas!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_3_desc: Well, we might as well get some hot cocoa! This is going to be a wild ride!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_3_reward: That hit the spot! I just wish I knew where we were going!
Missions.snm_holiday_conductor_task_4_desc: We're headed to Holiday Town! Santa's waiting for us!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_1_desc: It's not the holidays without new toys! Let's ask the kids at the Grade School what they want!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_1_reward: Kids say the darndest things! But at least I know what to build!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_2_reward: This toy comes from a land down under! Let's just hope it goes over with the kids!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_3_desc: We need to mass produce this for all the kids!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_3_reward: It's ready to ship! I can't wait to see the kids faces when they open the box!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_4_desc: The toy stores are begging me to put my new cute koala bear on their shelves for the holidays!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_5_desc: The day is finally here! Kids are opening up their presents!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_6_desc: The koalas are not only a hit with the kids, they're a hit with adults!
Missions.snm_holiday_toymaker_task_6_reward: Now, the koalas can live happily in the zoo year round and the kids can visit them anytime!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_1_desc: I better get to the bank before it closes for the holidays!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_1_reward: I wish the bank never closed. Nothing gets in the way of making money!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_2_desc: Now that my errands are done, I'm going to get some sleep.
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_3_desc: This is nothing but a pub, spirit. I haven't come here in ages.
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_3_reward: Is that me?! I used to be so full of life! Why wasn't I working?!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_4_reward: My...my assistant, Walt Stumpford, lives here?! I had no idea he had such a beautiful family!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_5_reward: That's...that's...me! And I'm all alone! I've seen enough, spirit! Take me home!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_6_desc: I'm alive! I'm alive! I have to get going. There's something at the mall I must do!
Missions.snm_holiday_scrooge_task_6_reward: Happy holidays, Stumpfords! Walt, here's a bonus for all your hard work!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_1_reward: It seems like just yesterday that this humble Post Office was the only thing on this corner!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_2_desc: Mmm. Pastry and coffee sounds great right now.
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_3_desc: I really want a salad right now. Who knew the Burger Joint would serve the best in town!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_3_reward: I wonder how many burgers have been served here since it opened!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_4_desc: The smell of strawberries reminds me of when I first met Rita!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_4_reward: And now you can look around and really see the fruits of your labor!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_5_desc: Today seems like a great day to walk by the pier!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_6_desc: My great grandmother buried a time capsule around here a long time ago!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_past_task_6_reward: Wow! Check your inventory for my great grandmother's Founder's Statue.
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_1_desc: There are so many thriving neighborhoods to live in! Which one to choose?
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_2_desc: Not only do people love the city but so do the animals!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_3_desc: The city is a shopping destination for locals and tourists alike!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_3_reward: That reminds me, I need to buy Bella an anniversary present!
Missions.snm_timeline_vance_present_task_5_desc: Cars have really put the city in the fast lane!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_1_desc: The city is becoming a global destination!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_1_reward: Everyone on earth seems to want to live here!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_2_desc: The city is becoming a bustling metropolis!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_3_desc: Variety is not only the spice of life but it's the main ingredient -- in our city!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_3_reward: The citizens are hungry for opportunity and new experiences!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_4_desc: The city is leading the way in new agricultural technologies!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_4_reward: And the seeds you planted a long time ago will finally sprout your success!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_5_desc: The city will continue to make waves in the shipping industry!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_5_reward: And there are a few surprises waiting to be unloaded onto your docks!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_6_desc: The city will soon be head and shoulders above the rest!
Missions.snm_timeline_sam_future_task_6_reward: You better make room for some really big news! Airport construction is set to begin!

Prey.standardDesc: I may look like just another bandit, but when it comes to the art of the steal, I'm the real deal.
Prey.meredithDesc: I have a lot of stealing tricks up my sleeve. Even when the cops think they've got me, things still disappear.
Prey.garyDesc: I use the latest technology to steal and always look handsome. No matter how hard the cops try to crack my code, they rarely succeed.
Prey.silentrobDesc: I have the right to remain silent!  I'm climbing the invisible ladder to the top of the crime world!
Prey.sneakinsallyDesc: You can't tame this wild mustang!  I'm gonna lasso this flea bitten town and rob it till the cows come home!
Prey.toniethetechieDesc: LOL!  All I need is a Wi-Fi signal and my laptop and I can clean your town out with just one click!
Prey.smellybanditsDesc: This really stinks!  If you keep cleaning up the city, it won't be any fun anymore.  We'll reek havoc again soon enough!
Prey.moversDesc: Brace yourself because we plan on carrying the load for all the criminals in this town!
Prey.karmaDesc: Hey, man, I make bank, not war.  Whether it's in a drum circle or a crime ring, I'm always centered, man.
Prey.robbinhoodDesc: I take from the rich and give to the poor!  It just so happens that I'M poor, too!
Prey.dogRetrieverDesc: I hope you have a heart of gold and decide to retrieve me!
Prey.dogGermanShepherdDesc: My bark is worse than my bite! I'll make sure to bark loud so you can find me!
Prey.dogPoodleDesc: I hope you rescue me soon because I'm badly in need of a pedicure!
Prey.dogKingCharlesDesc: Ugh, being lost is a royal pain! Send a search party at once!
Prey.downtownKennyDesc: Nothing feels better than feeling the wind in your hair as you fly down the road in someone else's car!
Prey.downtownFreddieDesc: You're not the boss of me! I'm the boss of me! And I plan on bossing myself around in your car!
Prey.downtownFrancisDesc: I have a need for speed! I also coincidentally have a need for speeding away from the cops in your car!
Prey.fishBassDesc: A common fish, requires a Level 1 Fishing Boat.
Prey.fishBarracudaDesc: An uncommon fish, requires a Level 2 Fishing Boat.
Prey.fishSharkDesc: A rare fish, requires a Level 3 Fishing Boat.
Prey.fishEelDesc: A very rare fish, requires a Level 4 Fishing Boat.
Prey.fishKrakenDesc: A mythical fish! Requires a Level 5 Fishing Boat.

Quest.skin_hint: You need to build the Remodel HQ before you can buy this skin!
Quest.unlockOnQuestLine: This item will be unlocked by completing {questname} on this quest line.
Quest.unlockByFinishingQuest: This item will be unlocked by completing the following quest.
Quest.quest_manager_hint: Mouse over icons to view Quests. Click on icons to add to the side bar.
Quest.quest_manager_new_hint: Click on quest icons to add to the side bar.  Quests with an X can be hidden.
Quest.quest_manager_hidden_tab_hint: Hidden quests can be completed, but will not show up in your sidebar. Clicking an icon activates it.
Quest.q_rename_city_dialog_finish: Brilliant! Keep building Houses and Businesses to grow your City!
Quest.q_pop_news_tutorial_newsContent: Will {user,name} Have What It Takes To Be Mayor?
Quest.q_pop_news_tutorial_invite_title: Grow your city faster with neighbors!
Quest.q_welcome_train_dialog_description: My trains always run on time! Here's free Goods for your city.
Quest.q_build_neighborhood_task1_hint: HINT: Use the BUILD menu to build Houses. Houses increase Population.
Quest.q_build_neighborhood_dialog_finish: Did you know: Mayors can build seaports? Give your friends coins to start their own city!
Quest.q_plant_and_harvest_task2_hint: HINT: Click on the Plot of land after you harvest it, then select a crop to plant.
Quest.q_plant_and_harvest_dialog_hint: Crops make goods! So be sure to harvest your crops before they wither!
Quest.q_plant_and_harvest_intro: My family and I have so many chores to do. Can you lend us a hand?
Quest.q_collect_rent_task1: Collect Rent from Rita's Country Home behind the barn
Quest.q_collect_rent_dialog_hint: HINT: Click and hold the mouse to move around your city.
Quest.q_collect_rent_dialog_finish: Thanks for stoppin' by! C'mon back soon to collect more. Tell friends about your progress!
Quest.q_collect_rent_dialog_header: C'mon by, I'm in the blue house behind the barn!
Quest.q_build_business_guide_task3_hint: HINT: Collect coins only after 10 customers are served.
Quest.q_build_business_guide_dialog_finish: C'est bon! Tell friends about your new bakery, and I'll tell them you're running for Mayor!
Quest.q_build_business_guide_intro: Your growing population is impressive! Build me a magnifique bakery and you may earn my vote.
Quest.qm_upgrade_business_task3_hint: HINT: Ask your friends for help to upgrade faster.
Quest.qm_upgrade_business_dialog_hint: Upgrading businesses improves their payouts and gives them a new look!
Quest.q_move_business_dialog_hint: Only your friends can send the chocolate I require. Ask them, s'il vous plait.
Quest.q_move_business_dialog_finish:
Magnifique! Sales are sure to go up!
 You'd make a great Mayor someday!
Quest.q_move_business_dialog_header: Excusez-moi! I require the finest chocolate!
Quest.q_visit_neighbor_task1_hint: HINT: Click Samantha's picture on the bottom bar, then click the VISIT button.
Quest.q_visit_neighbor_dialog_hint: HINT: Click Samantha's picture on the bottom bar, then click the VISIT button.
Quest.q_visit_neighbor_dialog_finish: Merci! I'm thinking you have the right recipe to be mayor. Tell your friends about your pastry tour!
Quest.q_plant_flag_task1_hint: HINT: The City Flag is in the BUILD Menu under Decorations.
Quest.q_build_post_office_dialog_hint: HINT: The Post Office is in your Inventory.
Quest.q_build_post_office_dialog_finish: I officially declare your town to be a city! Tell your friends about your new zip code!
Quest.q_build_post_office_dialog_header: Build a Post Office to make your town into an official city!
Quest.q_place_statue_task1_hint: HINT: The Gray Bunny is in your Inventory.
Quest.q_place_statue_dialog_finish: The 'lil bunny looks mighty cozy in her new home! Share your hoppin' success!
Quest.q_place_statue_intro: What a cute 'lil bunny! Looks like she needs a home.
Quest.q_place_town_hall_dialog_hint: The City Hall will be your office, if you win the Mayoral election!
Quest.q_place_town_hall_dialog_header: Once there's a City Hall, we can choose a Mayor!
Quest.q_pop_news_mayor_nominated_newsContent: Will Mayor Bring Seaport And Worldly Goods To {cityname}?
Quest.q_train1_task1_hint: HINT: Silos are in the BUILD Menu under the Crate Icon.
Quest.q_train1_dialog_finish: Great job! You're on track for my trains. Tell your friends you're chuggin' along.
Quest.q_train1_intro: The fast trains from Charlieville are comin'! Time to get working on the railroad!
Quest.q_train2_dialog_hint: Your neighbors know the route best. Visit and get their advice on the best place to lay track.
Quest.q_train2_dialog_finish: Scouting is done! Tell your friend about the great train routes you discovered.
Quest.q_train3_dialog_hint: When these trains complete their routes, a fortune in trading opens up to you if you have the goods!
Quest.q_train3_dialog_header: Click on the Train Platform and send trains to your friends!
Quest.q_train4_dialog_hint: If you can get me a nice breakfast, and I'll send a Charlieville train packed with goods!
Quest.q_train4_dialog_finish: Conductor Charlie loves his breakfast! Share his appetite for your mayoral run!
Quest.q_train4_dialog_header: I'm ready to depart Charlieville, but could use a good breakfast!
Quest.q_welcome_train_epilogue_message: You've unlocked trains from Charlieville! They're fast and have great returns!
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_dialog_hint: Help me knock 'em down, and I'll help ya become Mayor!
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_dialog_finish: We've chopped 'em down and you're ready for buildin'. Share your axe-cellence with friends!
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_intro: I'm a simple man. Lumberjack by trade. Lookin' forward to life here and supportin' ya for Mayor.
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_epilogue: I wonder what secrets have been kept about the folks who first claimed this land?
Quest.q_clear_the_forest_epilogue_title: NEATO! YOU FOUND A TIME CAPSULE!
Quest.q_time_capsule1_dialog_hint: Is the key buried on Rita's farm? Harvest crops to search and see.
Quest.q_time_capsule1_dialog_finish: You've begun to reveal the secret past of the city. Share the historic news with friends.
Quest.q_time_capsule1_epilogue: You've uncovered a mysterious Family Album! Complete more Goals to reveal the secrets hidden in the historic land beneath your city!
Quest.q_time_capsule2_dialog_header: Go back in time and learn the history and mystery of the land.
Quest.q_time_capsule2_intro: The Museum archeologist dug up another capsule with a lovely mystery inside.
Quest.q_time_capsule2_epilogue: Who is this romantic spouse, and how do they fit into your city's past? The more characters you meet, the more you'll reveal!
Quest.q_time_capsule2_letterText:
My Darling,

I can't wait to join you on the frontier!

Send for me when you can.


With love,
your spouse-to-be!
Quest.q_visit_neighbor4_dialog_finish: Nice job on the neighbor's trees, they are truly pleased. Tell friends whatcha done!
Quest.q_family_lodge_dialog_finish: My family and I are dern proud of our new home! Tell friends about your good will!
Quest.q_family_lodge_dialog_header: Build my family a home and we'll support you for Mayor!
Quest.q_family_feast_dialog_finish: What a great feast, we ate until we got lazy! Tell friends about your hunger to be Mayor!
Quest.q_mayor_prep_dialog_finish: Congrats! The budget is balanced, share your balancing act with friends.
Quest.q_mayor_prep_intro: Oh my gosh! The election is coming soon! Better get your budgeting skills in order.
Quest.q_more_businesses_task1_hint: HINT: You may need to increase your Population to unlock the Toy Store
Quest.q_more_businesses_dialog_finish: Good show! You got down to business in a big way. Your mayoral qualities are apparent.
Quest.q_more_businesses_dialog_header: No time to toy around, we need a toy store!
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_task2: Place a Franchise in Samantha's city
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_dialog_hint: I'm counting on you to franchise a business in Samantha's city!
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_dialog_finish: Feel the power! You are now a successful franchiser. Your friends need to know about this!
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_dialog_header: Increase your business power with Franchises!
Quest.q_expanding_ventures_intro: It's time to put your city on the map in more places than one by building franchises!
Quest.q_place_hq_dialog_finish: Congratulations, the sky's the limit. Literally. Share secrets of getting higher with friends.
Quest.q_place_hq_dialog_header: Break ground now on your first HQ!
Quest.q_place_hq_intro: You'll need it to run the Franchises you have in other cities.
Quest.q_earn_star_task1: Click your HQ, then click Supply
Quest.q_earn_star_dialog_finish: You've run your franchise and increased my confidence. Share your wealth of knowledge now.
Quest.q_expand_further_dialog_hint: Expand your franchise to 2 or more cities. You'll add an HQ floor for each one!
Quest.q_expand_further_dialog_finish: Talk about vertical success! You've added floors to your HQ. Tell your friends!
Quest.q_steady_income_task2_hint: HINT: click on Empty Lots in your Friends' cities.
Quest.q_steady_income_dialog_hint: The more often you supply a franchise, the more you'll earn!
Quest.q_steady_income_dialog_finish: Bravo! You're on your way to earning more stars! Ask friends if they're up to the task!
Quest.q_rita_garden_dialog_finish: It's exactly what I was lookin' for! I'm sure your friends would love to take a peek at it.
Quest.q_edgar_burger_task1_hint: You will need a population of 150 before you can build a burger joint.
Quest.q_edgar_burger_dialog_hint: You've started off great, now keep going strong with a convenient restaurant.
Quest.q_edgar_burger_dialog_finish: Well done, indeed! With business finesse like this, your bid for mayor is sure to succeed.
Quest.q_build_chateau_dialog_finish: My Chateau is, as Andre would say, "Magnifique". Share your impeccable taste.
Quest.q_scout_competition_task1_hint: HINT: Click on businesses in other cities to send a tour bus.
Quest.q_scout_competition_dialog_finish: A very profitable quest! Share what it takes to succeed in business!
Quest.q_please_the_citizens_dialog_hint: Build a park and give them a pretty place to hangout.
Quest.q_please_the_citizens_dialog_finish: Awesome job of "greening up" by building a new park. Ask your friends to graze in the grass too!
Quest.q_please_the_citizens_dialog_header: The citizens are in need of some greenery in their scenery.
Quest.q_pigeon1_intro: They all call me crazzzzy! But the pigeons know better.
Quest.q_pigeon1_dialog_hint: Pigeons get sunburned easily! Give them some shade!
Quest.q_pigeon1_dialog_header: Pigeons need a place to sit. Build comfy benches!
Quest.q_pigeon2_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Move Tool by clicking the Cursor button on the menu bar.
Quest.q_pigeon2_dialog_finish: The pigeons are no longer pooped! Share the scoop with your friends!
Quest.q_pigeon3_dialog_hint: My pigeons only eat organic, it gives their feathers a lovely sheen.
Quest.q_pigeon3_dialog_finish: The pigeons have given up garbage for organic. Share their positive change with friends!
Quest.q_pigeon3_dialog_header: Keep the precious pigeons from starving!
Quest.q_pigeon4_dialog_finish: My pigeons are currently sprinkling the museum with their love. Share their joy!
Quest.q_pigeon4_dialog_header: Build the museum for my birdie friends and I.
Quest.q_pigeon4_intro: My dear, the pigeons have kept my secret for years: I'm actually quite rich.
Quest.q_increase_pop_dialog_header: The city needs more folks to support it.
Quest.q_news_halfway_elections_newsContent: Mayoral Victory Ensures Seaport And Worldwide Influence For {user,name}
Quest.q_rita_cont1_dialog_hint: This time there's strawberry harvestin' and rent collectin' needed!
Quest.q_rita_cont1_dialog_finish: Once again you've been a heap of help! Let your friends know what a great helpin' hand you are!
Quest.q_rita_cont2_dialog_finish: The neighbors thank you for harvestin' and waterin' their crops. Share your pride with friends.
Quest.q_build_school_intro: You've got so many bright children in {cityname}! I'm here to teach them!
Quest.q_build_school_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Grade School under Community Buildings in the Build menu.
Quest.q_build_school_dialog_hint: Here's your homework. Build me a lovely school where I can teach the children!
Quest.q_build_school_dialog_finish: The terrific school you built will become legendary. Tell friends you got an A+!
Quest.q_news_school_built_newsContent: Election Getting Closer! Voters Getting Smarter!
Quest.q_safety_first_dialog_hint: You can find Stop Signs and Sidewalks under Decorations in the Build menu.
Quest.q_safety_first_dialog_finish: Thanks for the new stop signs and sidewalks! Tell friends the kids are safe!
Quest.q_place_to_play_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Swing Set under Decorations in the Build menu.
Quest.q_place_to_play_dialog_hint: Kids love to play, so here's a new assignment: build a playground!
Quest.q_place_to_play_dialog_finish: The kids love the playground and the citizens will love you as Mayor. Tell friends!
Quest.q_elected_mayor_dialog_hint: I propose we test your mayoral mettle on two essential city needs!
Quest.q_news_elected_mayor_newsContent: {cityname} Celebrates Future Seaport With Fantastic Fireworks!
Quest.c_prepare_shipping1_dialog_finish: Yo ho! This port is on its way to being afloat. Share your success with friends!
Quest.c_prepare_shipping1_intro: Time to set sail for the new seaport and that's your next challenge as the new Mayor.
Quest.c_prepare_shipping2_dialog_hint: You can find Piers and Boats under Shipping in the Build menu.
Quest.c_prepare_shipping2_dialog_finish: Shiver Me Timbers! The pier is built and your boat is seaworthy. Tell friends to get goin'.
Quest.c_news_seaport_town_newsContent: Rumor: Governor Considers Capital City Move
Quest.q_timecapsule1_epilogue_message: Unreal! You've uncovered a Family Album with deep secrets of your land!
Quest.q_timecapsule2_epilogue_message: Wow! Who's this romantic spouse and how does she fit into {cityname}'s past?
Quest.q_timecapsule2_epilogue_letterText:
My Darling,

I can't wait to join you on the frontier!

Send for me when you can.

With love
Your spouse-to-be!

Quest.c_more_billy1_dialog_finish: You've minded your dollars and sense well. Share the success with friends.

Quest.c_expand_city_dialog_finish: Congrats on your progress! Share your expansive thinking with friends.

Quest.c_central_park_1_dialog_hint: If you build a central park, I may donate yet another gem to the city!

Quest.c_more_andre3_dialog_header: Get tres constructive on my nouvelle restaurant!

Quest.c_capitol_sports2_dialog_finish: Hot Dog! You've done it again and the fans will be well-fed. Tell your friends!

Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_2_dialog_finish: A hearty meal for the fighters was super appreciated! Share your successful recipe.
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_2_intro: My team gets very hungry on the job! Feed them to "fire-up" your Capital campaign!
Quest.m_fire_n_hospital_3_dialog_hint: Let's fight fire with fire! Help the firemen inspect and smoke detect!

Quest.m_dating_4_epilogue2_title: LIKE THE DOCTOR SAID, WE HAD A BLAST!
Quest.m_dating_4_epilogue2_message: I've taught my students about South America! Sharing it with a romantic man was amazing!
Quest.m_dating_5_dialog_hint: We're happy you're all-aboard for our date. What do you think is next for us?

Quest.m_dating_5_epilogue2_message: I adored learning more about the world (and the doctor!) from the comfort of a train car!

Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_dialog_hint: Look for the Warehouse in your Inventory. Store away your decorations by using the new Warehouse tool.
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_dialog_finish: You did it! Hire friends to create more space in your Warehouse and store more decorations.
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_task1: Add more space to your warehouse by having four crew members staffed
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_task1_hint: HINT: Click on your Warehouse to ask your friends to staff it.
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_dialog_hint: If you have at least four friends staffed in your Warehouse, you can click on it to upgrade it for free!
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_dialog_finis: Great job! Now you can store your businesses, residences, and community buildings in your Deluxe Warehouse!
Quest.qm_storage_warehouse_deluxe_dialog_heade: Now you can store your businesses, residences, and community buildings in your Deluxe Warehouse!
Quest.qm_rent_collector_dialog_finish: That's quite the crew you've assembled.  Maybe you can help me find a new chauffeur when you're done.
Quest.qm_rent_collector_intro: Your city is getting bigger and bigger.  It reminds me of my stock portfolio.  And my car collection.  Speaking of cars...
Quest.qm_rent_collector_2_task1_hint: To use the auto tool, click on the car itself or go to the tool menu and click on the auto collect icon
Quest.qm_rent_collector_2_dialog_finish: Looks like you're gonna make quite the landlord.  Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm off to buy a small island.
Quest.qm_rent_collector_2_dialog_header: We better fuel up so we don't get stranded on the side of the road for hours.  Time is money!
Quest.qm_clerk_office_dialog_hint: At the City Clerk Office you can re-name franchises, businesses and your city!
Quest.qm_clerk_office_dialog_finish: Neato! Your City Clerk's Office is open and staffed! Ask friends to add one to their city!
Quest.qm_factory_1_dialog_hint: Factories are a major step to make your city an industry leader!
Quest.qm_factory_1_dialog_finish: Congrats on your first Factory! The machinery to grow your city is in place! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_factory_1_dialog_header: Place a Factory in your city from your inventory!
Quest.qm_factory_2_dialog_hint: At the heart of every successful city is a busy factory that's always producing!
Quest.qm_factory_2_dialog_finish: Gosh! Your city's factory is a lean, mean, production machine! Share the "goods" news!
Quest.qm_factory_2_dialog_header: Put your factory to work by producing goods!
Quest.qm_factory_2_intro: It's swell that your Factory is up and running! Now it's time to get industrious and make the goods!
Quest.qm_visitor_center_dialog_hint: Build and staff the Visitor Center. You can find it in your inventory.
Quest.qm_visitor_center_dialog_finish: Great job opening the Visitor Center! Why not spread the news and share a reward with your friends?
Quest.qm_visitor_center_dialog_header: Invite Friends to work in your Visitor Center!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost1_dialog_hint: It's hard to believe Rusty's lost at sea! We have to get to the bottom of this, so I can recover my missing goods!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost1_dialog_finish: These supplies will help us in our search! Share some good with friends.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost1_intro: Rusty may be lost at sea with my valuable goods on-board! Rich rewards await if you find him!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost2_task1: Ask 8 Friends to join your search party!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost2_task2_hint: HINT: Collect from Seafood Restaurant and Tower Eats.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost2_dialog_hint: Something's fishy about Rusty's disappearance. Lets assemble a search party for the rescue!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost2_dialog_finish: Superb job recruiting and supplying the Rusty search party. Tell friends to search too!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost3_dialog_hint: If Rusty is really missing, a voyage to "sea where he is" is a sensible idea. Dont forget your life vests!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost3_dialog_finish: You made a valiant voyage in your search for lost Rusty! Suggest friends set sail!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost3_intro: My money says a smart way to find Rusty is to head out to his common destinations!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_dialog_hint: It appears Rusty's not lost at sea. It's time to search closer to home!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_dialog_finish: We found many clues about Rusty in neighboring cities! Send friends to investigate!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_dialog_header: Visit neighbor's cities to expand your search!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost4_intro: Speed up your search for Rusty! Find clues to his whereabouts by visiting neighbor's cities.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_task1_hint: HINT: The Diner offers this collection.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_task2_hint: HINT: Collect from Cozy Cottage, Country Home, Spring Bungalow, and Lake House.
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_dialog_hint: Help Rusty miss his home in your city by supplying his favorite food and chair!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_dialog_finish: Well done! You lured Rusty home from his tropical adventure! I've also secured a new shipping route for you!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_intro: It turns out Rusty's not lost at all! He's on vacation in the Bahamas and plans to stay!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_epilogue_message: I am pleased you have returned from the tropics with my valuable goods!
Quest.c_rusty_gets_lost5_epilogue2_message: The Bahamas were hot mon! But your pancakes and chair were a mighty fine welcome back!
Quest.qm_retail1_dialog_hint: Edgar and I have different taste in food, but if the pigeons like it we're fine!
Quest.qm_retail1_dialog_finish: The pigeons and I are ready for a wild dinner with Edgar! Ask friends to prepare the meal!
Quest.qm_retail1_dialog_intro: The pigeons and I are going shopping to get goodies for our dinner with Edgar. Can you help?
Quest.qm_retail2_dialog_header: Help Edgar find parking for his expensive car!
Quest.qm_retail3_task1: Send 20 tour buses to your neighbors' businesses
Quest.qm_retail3_task3_hint: HINT: Tofu Burger, Department Store, and Grocery Store offer this collection.
Quest.qm_retail3_dialog_hint: Yes, it's crazy! Ruth's pigeons really want to go shopping out of town!
Quest.qm_retail3_dialog_finish: Our fine feathered friends had a lovely time on their shopping spree and so did we!
Quest.m_reporter1_task3: Place 1 Pink Flowers (From Forever Young Collection turn in)
Quest.m_reporter1_dialog_finish: Neato! My interview revealed that Ruth's new museum is really taking flight! Tell all your friends!
Quest.m_reporter1_dialog_header: Make Ruth's museum exhibit crazy and beautiful!
Quest.m_reporter2_dialog_hint: Watching Paul whittle is so much fun. His carvings are "chop notch!"
Quest.m_reporter2_dialog_finish: Paul whittled me an amazin' tree carving I'll cherish forever! And his jam was yummy! Tell friends!
Quest.m_reporter2_dialog_header: Get Paul trees so he can start whittlin' a carvin'!
Quest.m_reporter2_intro: Next up for my interviews with city characters is Paul. I think we're going chopping together!
Quest.m_reporter3_dialog_finish: C'est fini! Andre's put the icing on his one-of-a-kind carrot cake for me! Ask friends to bake one!
Quest.m_news_wedding_planning_newsContent: Doctor and Teacher Reveal Wedding Plans!
Quest.m_reporter4_task3_hint: HINT: Harvesting Wheat offers this collection.
Quest.m_reporter4_dialog_hint: To make the pizza, Andre's dough-pending on you!
Quest.m_reporter4_dialog_finish: "Grazzi" to Lorenzo for the dough tossing lesson and the "perfecto" pizza! Tell friends "Get doughing!"
Quest.m_reporter4_intro: I can't wait to make conversation and dough with Lorenzo whose pizza making skills are legendary!
Quest.m_reporter5_task2: Have 3 Filet Mignon (Surf and Turf Collection)
Quest.m_reporter5_task2_hint: HINT: Seafood Restaurant and Tower Eats offer this collection.
Quest.m_reporter5_dialog_hint: Score food and drinks to make the baseball team's celebration a hit! Get the Tavern from turning in the Down Town Collection.
Quest.m_reporter5_dialog_finish: You're an all-star! The team and I had a ball celebrating their victory! Share your score!
Quest.m_reporter5_dialog_header: Go to bat to help Jack's hungry team celebrate!
Quest.m_reporter5_intro: Our baseball team won again! I can't wait to hang with Coach Jack and the players as they celebrate!
Quest.m_reporter6_dialog_hint: When it comes to Edgar's shoes, you need to truly shine!
Quest.m_reporter6_dialog_finish: Sweet! Edgar's shoes look worth their weight in gold! Share your shining success!
Quest.m_reporter6_intro: Before our resident mogul will converse with me, he wants to be sure he's polished! His shoes that is!
Quest.m_reporter6_epilogue_message: Edgar has just donated a lovely Tree House for the city! Look for it in your inventory!
Quest.m_pop_news_reporter_newsContent: Readers Learn What Makes Edgar, Paul, Andre and Jack Tick!
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_task1_hint: HINT: French Restaurant offers this collection.
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_dialog_hint: The wedding meal must be genius! Let's start with my crusty French bread!
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_dialog_finish: Mais qui! The smell of fresh bread and love fill the air! Tell everyone it's bake time!
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_dialog_header: Help me make sure this wedding isn't half-baked!
Quest.m_andre_wedding1_intro: Magnifique! To prepare for Louise and Dr. Sheperd's big day I must begin baking immediately!
Quest.m_andre_wedding2_dialog_hint: The wedding is upon us! There's no time to waste in getting the dinner ready!
Quest.m_andre_wedding2_dialog_finish: My wedding dinner is set with flowers and Eggplant Parmesean! Ask friends to get cheesy!
Quest.m_andre_wedding2_dialog_header: Your help with the wedding dinner c'est tres important!
Quest.m_andre_wedding2_intro: My wedding dinner must be superb from les fleurs (flowers!) to the fromage (cheese!)!
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_task2: Have 6 Chocolate Covered Strawberries (Strawberry Crop Collection)
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_dialog_hint: There are many layers to making a great cake. Please help me get what I need!
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_dialog_finish: The doctor and teacher say my wedding cake is "magnifique!" Tell friends to make the cake!
Quest.m_andre_wedding3_intro: Cutting the cake is my favorite part of a wedding. No cutting corners pour moi!
Quest.m_get_married_1_dialog_finish: I love my new diamond ring! Your jewelry store rocks! Ask friends to put a ring on it!
Quest.m_get_married_1_intro: I've learned you have a jewelry store in your city where I can choose my ring!
Quest.m_get_married_2_task2_hint: HINT: Wedding Store and Tuxedo Rental offer this collection.
Quest.m_get_married_2_dialog_finish: My wedding dress will get the highest marks for sure. Tell friends to get dressed!
Quest.m_get_married_2_intro: I've got the diamond, so it's time to address the dress! And the pearls too!
Quest.m_get_married_3_task1_hint: HINT: The Tuxedo Rental Store is the reward for turning in a Jet Setter Collection.
Quest.m_get_married_3_task3: Collect from any Tuxedo Rental Store 5 Times
Quest.m_get_married_3_dialog_hint: Many a man will be married in your city! Get a Tuxedo Rental store by turning in the Jet Setter Collection.
Quest.m_get_married_3_dialog_finish: My shiny blue Tuxedo will make Louise swoon! Tell friends to get their tux store on!
Quest.m_get_married_3_dialog_header: Find me a tux that would make a penguin jealous!
Quest.m_get_married_3_intro: The wedding's getting close, which means it's tux time. I hope you have something in-store for me!
Quest.m_get_married_4_dialog_hint: Whaddaya say we make the bridesmaids fall in love with the handsome groomsmen!
Quest.m_get_married_4_dialog_finish: My groomsmen are almost as handsome as me! Make sure your neighbors groomsmen are linked!
Quest.m_get_married_5_dialog_finish: We found a place we both agreed was totally us! Share this with friends!
Quest.m_get_married_5_intro: It's the most romantic moment so far! The place where we'll get married!
Quest.m_get_married_5_epilogue_message: It's so romantic! I can't wait to marry the doctor there!
Quest.m_get_married_5_epilogue2_message: It is the perfect place! Modern yet just right for our historic wedding!
Quest.m_get_married_6_dialog_finish: You've made everything perfect for our wedding! Thank you! Tell friends to decorate too.
Quest.m_get_married_6_dialog_header: Everything must be perfect for our wedding, especially the decorations!
Quest.m_get_married_6_epilogue_message: The decorations are in place and the benches are ready for our guests!
Quest.m_get_married_7_task1: Have a Newlywed House in your city (Turn in Bridal Collection)
Quest.m_get_married_7_task2: Collect rent from a Newlywed House 5 times
Quest.m_get_married_7_dialog_hint: Our perfect newlywed house will be a terrific place for us to come home to!
Quest.m_get_married_7_dialog_finish: We both feel "right at home" in our new house! Ask friends to go house hunting too!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_1_task2: Collect from any Shamrock Sing-a-long 2 times
Quest.qm_st_pattys_1_dialog_hint: When the Sing-a-long's ready, your city will be "fine as a fiddle" for St. Pattys! Unlock: St. Patty's Pub
Quest.qm_st_pattys_1_dialog_finish: Charlie and I can't wait to hit the new pub for a game of darts! Ask friends to build one!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_1_intro: We love socializin' on St. Patty's Day. Would'ya build an Irish pub with enough mugs to go 'round?
Quest.qm_st_pattys_2_dialog_hint: Andre needs your help with cookin' up a Corned Beef and Cabbage dinner!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_2_dialog_finish: Andre's St. Patty's Day meal is gonna hit the spot fer sure! Ask friends to get cookin'!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_2_dialog_header: Prepare a festive St. Patrick's Day meal!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_2_intro: As a first generation Irishman, I love St. Patrick's Day! Let's put on the green in your city!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_task1_hint: HINT: Painting Booth can be found in the Decorations section of your Build menu.
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_dialog_hint: There'll be lotsa requests for shamrocks 'n clovers painted on the kid's faces! Reward: St. Patrick's Park
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_dialog_finish: Gee Willickers! The kids are lovin' wearin' the green on their faces! Ask friends to get painting!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_dialog_header: Help supply Rita and Sid's Face Painting Booth!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_3_intro: Be a sweetheart and lend Sid a hand with a St. Patrick's Day face painting booth in his store!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_task2_hint: HINT: Clover Patch can be found in the Decorations section of your Build Menu.
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_dialog_hint: It think it's brilliant to have a special park for celebrating the green!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_dialog_finish: Ruth was disappointed I didn't bring anything for her pigeons! Ask friends to go to the park!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_dialog_header: Help Edgar with his clover bouquet for Ruth!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_4_intro: For St. Patrick's Day, I'm meeting Ruth in the park to give her a bold bouquet of Four Leaf Clovers!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_5_task3: Collect from any Fiddle Shop 5 times
Quest.qm_st_pattys_5_dialog_hint: Help me get back in with Ruth and the pigeons' good graces with a song or two.
Quest.qm_st_pattys_5_dialog_finish: My fiddling was a high note for Ruth and her pigeons' St. Patrick's Day! Ask friends to play too!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_5_dialog_header: Help Edgar get his fiddle shop!
Quest.qm_st_pattys_5_intro: I need to acquire a fiddle shop so I can serenade Ruth and her pigeons 'til their Irish eyes smile!
Quest.qux_irishrestaurant_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the St. Patrick's Day Quest.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet1_dialog_hint: Please welcome my troupe with a comfortable place to live and "limber up!"
Quest.qm_russian_ballet1_dialog_finish: You've made some smooth moves to welcome my dance troupe to your city! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet1_intro: I lead a Russian ballet troupe that will perform in your city! Prepare for our visit!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_task1: Have 1 Fine Arts Theatre in your city
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_task1_hint: HINT: Find the Fine Arts Theatre under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_dialog_hint: It's my wish that our dance performance is a cultural high note for your city!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_dialog_finish: I admire the design of your city's Fine Arts Theatre! Share your success with friends.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet2_dialog_header: Build your city's first Fine Arts Theatre!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet3_task3_hint: HINT: Street Clocks are a gift on the Free Gift tab!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet3_dialog_hint: My troupe and I need leotards and make-up! We're depending on you!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet3_intro: We are quite excited to dance in your city, but our luggage is missing with all of our clothing!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Dance Studio under Businesses in the Build Menu.
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_dialog_finish: Da! Our Dance Studio is finished and we are proud to live in your city! Share the news!
Quest.qm_russian_ballet4_dialog_header: Build a Dance Studio for Alexi and his troupe!
Quest.qux_performancetheater_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the Dance in the City Quest.
Quest.qux_dancestudio_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the Fine Arts Theatre Quest.
Quest.s_lorenzo_family1_dialog_hint: My papa's very demanding, so it's wise to have everything he needs!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family1_intro: My papa just told me "mi famiglia" will be visiting soon. There's so much to get ready!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_dialog_hint: Mama, papa, sisters, brothers, uncles, aunts! That's a lotta people to house!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_dialog_finish: Grazie mille! You've found lotsa room for "mi famiglia!" Ask friends to make space!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family2_intro: My family's visiting and my house is too small for them all! Find them a "grande" place to live!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_task3: Find 1 Fried Tomato from the Tomato Collection
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_dialog_finish: Grazie! My family thinks I'm "un grande affare"(a big deal) in your city! Spread the word!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_dialog_header: Help me make my family proud!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family3_intro: My "famiglia" is curious to see and taste the joys and smells of Italy we've brought to your city!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family4_dialog_hint: Toys will make my niece smile, and the more Get Well Cards she gets the better! Unlock: Pizzeria
Quest.s_lorenzo_family4_intro: My niece is in the hospital with an allergic reaction. She'll be fine, but needs some cheering up!
Quest.s_lorenzo_family4_epilogue2_message: I received so many Get Well Cards, I had to get well pronto!
Quest.qux_tomatoes_hint: You must complete the Lorenzo's Family Quest before you can plant these.
Quest.qux_italiandeli_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the House The Family Quest.
Quest.qux_pizzeria_hint: Before you can buy this, you must complete the Sneezy Niece Quest.
Quest.qm_gremlinsminigame_dialog_finish: You sure know your AC from your DC 'cause you took the juice out of the Energy Bandits!
Quest.qm_gremlinsminigame_dialog_header: You've got 30 seconds to catch as many Energy Bandits as you can!
Quest.qm_monsterbanditsminigame_dialog_finish: You sure know your AC from your DC 'cause you took the juice out of the Ghosts!
Quest.qm_monsterbanditsminigame_dialog_header: You've got 60 seconds to catch as many Ghosts as you can!
Quest.qm_monsterbanditsminigame_intro: If I were you, I'd be guarding my energy! Ghosts have been seen in your town!
Quest.qm_hardware1_dialog_hint: A Hardware Store's where I come up with some of my best buildin' ideas fer sure! You can now find it in your inventory.
Quest.qm_hardware1_dialog_finish: Well don'tcha know! Your Hardware Store's my most valuable tool! Ask friends to build one!
Quest.louise_college1_task1_hint: HINT:  Find the College Library under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.louise_college1_task2: Collect from any College Library 3 times
Quest.louise_college1_dialog_hint: This is no ordinary library. The College Library is through the roof with books!
Quest.louise_college1_dialog_header: Help Louise improve your city's school!
Quest.louise_college1_intro: I have some important homework for you to help improve the education in my school!
Quest.louise_college2_task2: Collect 1 Fountain Pen from the Bookworm Collection (from the Bookstore)
Quest.louise_college2_task3: Collect rent from 40 Residences in your city
Quest.louise_college2_dialog_hint: Having a community college is key to the kids having a great education in your city!
Quest.louise_college2_dialog_finish: Well done! You really applied yourself to my community college funding assignment! Tell friends!
Quest.louise_college2_intro: Now that my school has passed the test, we need a community college for the children after they graduate!
Quest.louise_college3_task2: Send 30 Tour Buses to your neighbor's Businesses
Quest.louise_college3_dialog_hint: Support industry in your city first! Louise's community college will just have to wait!
Quest.louise_college3_dialog_finish: Thank you for understanding that business is an education in itself. Inform your friends.
Quest.louise_college4_task2: Ask friends for 10 Pro Education Posters
Quest.louise_college4_dialog_hint: If you want your city to be super smart, a community college is the right answer!
Quest.louise_college4_dialog_finish: The kids and I appreciate your brilliant support of our higher education effort. Educate friends!
Quest.louise_college4_dialog_header: Make sure education wins in your city!
Quest.louise_college4_intro: My students and I want to send Edgar "back to school!" Help us continue to fund the community college!
Quest.louise_college5_dialog_hint: If I vote in favor of higher education, it's sure to happen! Fund this effort!
Quest.louise_college5_dialog_finish: It's official! The community college in your city has been approved and budgeted! Inform friends!
Quest.louise_college5_intro: I've been convinced! I am in favor of funding the new community college for your city and need your support!
Quest.qux_communitycollege_hint: In order to purchase this item, you must finish the Edgar's college try quest!
Quest.louise_college7_task1_hint: HINT: Find the Community College under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.louise_college7_dialog_hint: The Community College will be an important addition to your city! Build it now!
Quest.louise_college7_dialog_finish: The Community College is built and I give you an A+ for your effort! Ask friends to build theirs!
Quest.louise_college7_intro: We're all set to build a Community College in your city! I can't wait to teach there too!
Quest.louise_college8_dialog_hint: Ornithology's not only for the birds! My feathered friends can teach you a lot!
Quest.louise_college8_dialog_finish: My pigeons and I are ready to share the poop in our ornithology class! Share with friends!
Quest.louise_college8_intro: Surprise! I have a Doctorate in Ornithology and want to let it fly by teaching at your college!
Quest.qm_cruiseship_dock_task2: Place 4 New Decorations Near City Port
Quest.qm_cruiseship_dock_dialog_hint: The City Port must be placed next to water.
Quest.qm_cruiseship_dock_dialog_finish: Great job! Building your City Port puts you on course for Cruise Ships! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_cruiseship1_dialog_hint: Show tourists the sites and get them there!
Quest.qm_cruiseship1_dialog_finish: Now tourists can find the best sites in your city and get there in style! Tell friends!
Quest.qm_cruiseship1_dialog_header: Get Tourism Pamphlets and Tour Buses!
Quest.qm_cruiseship2_dialog_hint: The Cruise Ships can't dock without a finished City Port!
Quest.qm_cruiseship2_intro: It's time to finish building your City Port and grow population to meet arriving passengers!
Quest.qm_cruiseship3_dialog_hint: Welcome all the new tourists to your city!
Quest.qm_cruiseship3_dialog_finish: Your city is ready to celebrate the arrival of Cruise Ships! Share the news!
Quest.qm_cruiseship3_epilogue_message: The Cruise Ships and tourists have arrived! Look for bigger Cruise Ships docking soon!
Quest.s_museum_dialog_finish: This is historic! The Log Cabin has taught us a lot about your city's past! Tell friends!
Quest.s_museum_dialog_header: Help Rita and Max explore your city's history!
Quest.s_museum_intro: Dig this! While helping Rita harvest her crops, I found remnants of a Log Cabin deep in the dirt!
Quest.s_museum_2_dialog_hint: What will the Museum staff and I unearth next in our search for the past?
Quest.s_museum_2_dialog_finish: The more we dig up, the more we learn about your city's history! Ask friends to explore!
Quest.s_museum_2_intro: No bones about it! The museum staff and I must discover more about the old Log Cabin artifact!
Quest.s_museum_3_dialog_hint: My students can't wait to dig in and learn about your city's past!
Quest.s_museum_3_dialog_finish: The students and I really loved getting dirty with Max at the Log Cabin dig! Tell friends!
Quest.s_museum_3_intro: I'm so excited for my students to learn about archeology by helping Max excavate the old Log Cabin!
Quest.s_museum_4_task1_hint: HINT: You can find the Log Cabin in your inventory.
Quest.s_museum_4_dialog_hint: The replica of the old Log Cabin will become a major tourist attraction!
Quest.s_museum_4_dialog_finish: Your Log Cabin replica got the popular vote from tourists and students! Share the news!
Quest.s_museum_4_dialog_header: Build an authentic looking Log Cabin!
Quest.s_museum_4_intro: I vote that you honor your city's ancient history and build a replica of the old Log Cabin!
Quest.s_museum_5_news_newsContent: Old Log Cabin, New Archeologist Making History!
Quest.s_museum_6_dialog_hint: The students will learn a lot if I can convince Max to join my school.
Quest.s_museum_6_intro: That's why I want Max to teach science at my school! Your homework: Make it happen!
Quest.s_museum_7_task2_hint: HINT: Find the Children's Center under Community Buildings in the Build Menu.
Quest.s_museum_7_task3: Collect from Children's Discovery Center 3 times
Quest.s_museum_7_dialog_hint: I'm a bit jealous of Max and Louise's time together! Help me impress her!
Quest.s_museum_7_dialog_finish: I'm feeling better because Louise loves the new Discovery Center. Tell friends as well!
Quest.s_museum_7_dialog_header: Build the Discovery Center the doctor has ordered!

Quest.qm_eating_contest1_dialog_hint: In this contest, the best way to get in shape is eating a lot!

Quest.qm_eating_contest1_dialog_header: Supply food for the eating contest trainees!

Quest.qm_eating_contest2_dialog_finish: If my creative training program is any indication, the eating contest is mine to win! Tell friends!

Quest.qm_eating_contest3_dialog_finish: Thanks for the workout! I'm on schedule to win the eating contest! Alert friends!

Quest.qm_eating_contest4_intro: The eating contest day has arrived and the polls predict I'm going to win by a landslide!
Quest.qm_eating_contest5_dialog_hint: The collection pieces can be found from harvesting strawberries, pumpkins, and corn!
Quest.qm_eating_contest5_dialog_finish: What an upset! And I don't mean stomach! Ruth's pigeons flew in to win the eating contest!

Quest.qm_zoo_arctic_intro: Wildlife is my life! I need your help to build a Zoo Habitat for the Arctic Animal I've rescued!

Quest.qm_zoo_1_dialog_finish: Your first Jungle Animal is safe in its new home! Visitors love it! Tell friends!

Quest.qm_zoo_3_dialog_finish: Brilliant work! It's truly in your nature to give folks a world-class Zoo! Share the news!
Quest.qm_zoo_3_intro: If you want your Zoo to be a real tourist attraction, get the funds to make it more fun!
Quest.qm_zoo_4_dialog_hint: I hear your Cafeteria will serve "Corn On A Stick!" What a healthy treat!

Quest.qm_zoo_5_dialog_finish: Neato! Your Picnic Area at the Zoo is a big hit! Tell friends to build theirs!
Quest.qm_zoo_5_intro: That reminds me! I think it would be terrific to put a Picnic Area in your Zoo! Let's do it!
Quest.qm_zoo_5_epilogue_message: The Jungle Animals are very happy! And it's a growing attraction for {cityname} citizens and visitors!
Quest.qm_cincodemayo_1_dialog_hint: It won't be a real Cinco de Mayo party without a great atmosphere and food!

Quest.s_movie_star2_intro: But shopping with a movie star is a different animal! I'm sure she has fabulous, expensive taste!
Quest.s_movie_star3_dialog_hint: I hear movie stars are super picky about their food! Andre's meal has to shine!
Quest.s_movie_star3_dialog_finish: Yum! Andre is ready to cook a delicious dinner for Miss Bennett! Do your friends know?
Quest.s_movie_star4_task2: Collect from any 10 neighbor's Burger Joints
Quest.s_movie_star4_task2_hint: HINT: City Sam has a Burger Joint.
Quest.s_movie_star4_dialog_finish: Good times! Bella had extra onions on her burger and won her pool game! Spread the news!
Quest.s_movie_star4_dialog_header: Plan Bella Bennett's burger night on the town!
Quest.s_movie_star4_intro: I only wanted a basic burger and a game of pool!
Quest.s_movie_star5_task1_hint: HINT: Frog Pond will be in Decorations after finishing the Star in the City goal.
Quest.s_movie_star5_dialog_hint: When you see your city on the big screen, you'll know it was worth it!

Quest.s_movie_star5_intro: Bella Bennett's studio will shoot her latest film in your city!
Quest.s_movie_star1_epilogue_message: Your city was an exciting location for my film to take place! I love the pond!

Quest.qm_inta_food_fest1_dialog_hint: Folks love to try food of all kinds! Make sure it's fresh and plentiful!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest1_dialog_finish: Your International Food Festival is off to a delicious start! Friends should prepare too!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest1_dialog_header: Help Rita prepare for the International Food Festival!

Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_task2: Collect 3 times from any French Restaurant in your city
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_dialog_hint: It's nothing but the best for the citizens who will eat my food at the Festival!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_dialog_finish: We've created some marvelous international recipes together! Friends should hear about it!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_dialog_header: Get Andre the ingredients for his recipes!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest2_intro: Will you help me cook? Together, we'll make fabulous food for the International Food Festival!

Quest.qm_inta_food_fest3_dialog_hint: Your International Food Festival has success written all over it.
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest3_dialog_finish: Brilliant! You've earned my support for the International Food Festival! Inform friends!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest3_intro: Your International Food Festival will be superb for tourism! Let's be sure everyone knows about it.
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_task2: Collect from any 5 Greek Restaurants in your city
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_dialog_hint: My pigeons eat every kind of Greek food except anything made with chicken!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_dialog_finish: My pigeons are cooing nonstop about the Greek cuisine at your Festival! Spread the news!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest4_dialog_header: Get the Greek food cooking for the Festival!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_task2: Collect 4 times from any Thai Restaurant in your city
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_dialog_hint: Restaurants will be more popular than ever at the International Food Festival!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_dialog_finish: Fresh food and fun! What a perfect recipe for your International Food Festival! Tell all!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_intro: Be a sweetheart and help me with some last minute chores for the International Food Festival!
Quest.qm_inta_food_fest5_epilogue_title: Our International Food Festival was a real big success!
Quest.qux_greekrestaurant_hint: Complete the FESTIVAL RECIPES! quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_promo_kungfupanda_intro: If you build a Drive-In Movie Theater in your city, I'll come see "Kung Fu Panda 2" there!

Quest.qm_bridge_1_intro: If you build me a Bridge to the other side of the River, we'll all reap the rewards!

Quest.qm_bridges5_epilogue_message: My tourist business is expanding according to plan. Hotels will be my next big thing.

Quest.qf_mall_construction_intro: You can imagine how excited I was when I heard you're opening a new Mall in your city!

Quest.qf_mall2_construction_intro: Your businesses are doing so great that you're ready to open another mall in your City!

Quest.spring_party_quest_dialog_finish: The pigeons and I are pooped after our party! Tell friends it's only for three days!

Quest.spring_party_quest_epilogue_title: What a wonderful spring party! Don't you think Arthur and Myrtle?
Quest.qm_boat_race_intro: Dan may sail a big cruise ship, but I'm the real sea captain. I've challenged him to a Boat Race!

Quest.qm_boat_race2_dialog_finish: Alrighty mate! We're on our way to winning the Boat Race.

Quest.qm_boat_race3_dialog_hint: Collect from your Seafood Restaurant or Tower Eats to get Crab and Lobster
Quest.qm_boat_race3_dialog_finish: My referee training is right on track. Tell friends that Charlie is ready to ref.
Quest.qm_boat_race4_intro: Dan's spreadin' rumors that he's in it to win it. I'll be waving him goodbye soon after we launch.

Quest.qm_boat_race4_task3: Have 2 Sports Drinks from the Fitness collection

Quest.qm_boat_race5_epilogue_title: It was loads of fun exploring China on land Dan!
Quest.qm_boat_race5_epilogue_message: Thanks for the kind words Rusty. It cost me the race, but I won a new seafaring friend!

Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_intro: Man, I love the 4th of July!  It's almost as fun as coaching!

Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_task3_hint: HINT: Ask your friends for them!

Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_2_dialog_header: Let's show this ice cream who's boss!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_2_task1_hint: HINT: Check the Businesses Build menu for your newly-unlocked Ice Cream Shop!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_2_dialog_hint: You know, {cityname} deserves a Liberty Bell.  And a championship!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_intro: Nothing's more American than cooking out on a hot grill!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_dialog_header: Join Jack's team and help him with his BBQ!

Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_task2_hint: HINT: Click on Burger Joints in your Neighbor's Cities
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_3_dialog_finish: What's for dessert? Oh yeah! Sue's Fireworks Show!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_intro: I'm here to make sure {cityname} has a safe and sane Fireworks Celebration.
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_dialog_header: Safety First! Fun Second! More Fun Third! July Fourth!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_task1_hint: HINT: Now is a good time to build an Emergency Clinic if you don't have one.
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_dialog_hint: Don't you wish your city had a fireworks store?! Then build one!
Quest.qm_july_411_bbq_4_dialog_finish: We did it! And with all fingers intact!
Quest.qux_chinesefireworks_hint: Complete the FOURTH OF JULY FEVER: RED, WHITE, & BBQ quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_bbqrestaurant_hint: Complete the FOURTH OF JULY FEVER: LIGHT THE FUSE quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_marathonTimed1_dialog_finish: What a blast!  It was close all the way to the finish. But I did it, the trophies mine!
Quest.qm_marathonTimed1_intro: That gold medal is mine!  I've been training for weeks and I'm running on all cylinders! Here comes Courtney Flex!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_intro: The pigeons have had this street carnival circled on their calendar for months. And yes, my pigeons use a calendar.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_dialog_header: The key to a good Street Carnival is picking a good street. Or avenue. But Avenue Carnival just sounds weird.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_task2_hint: Finish your carnival before people arrive!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_dialog_finish: Alright, time to have some fun.  But remember, it's all fun and games until someone loses a beak.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_2_intro: I think carnival food is like a romance novel. You love it but you don't want your friends to find out.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_2_dialog_header: I better feed the pigeons before this carnival turns into a horror film.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_2_dialog_finish: They say cheaters never win.  But, in my experience, they sometimes do.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_3_dialog_header: Looks like the pigeons want cotton candy now. I guess that makes me their sugar mama.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_3_task1_hint: Visit neighbors to send Tour Buses!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_3_dialog_finish: Who knew my pigeons had such a sweet tooth?  Who knew my pigeons had any teeth at all?!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_4_intro: I haven't had this much fun since I cut my own hair!
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_4_dialog_header: Those birds have gone overboard and now they need me to play doctor.  Luckily, I have a PhD in Pigeonomics.
Quest.qf_carnival_quest_4_dialog_finish: Well, now I know why they say, "Don't bring birds to a carnival."  Actually, I don't think anyone says that.

Quest.qux_cottoncandystand_hint: Complete the STREET CARNIVAL: SWEETEN THE DEAL quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_grillstand_hint: Complete the STREET CARNIVAL: STUFFED PIGEONS quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_green1_intro: You have one of the greatest cities on earth.  But now it's time to make it one of the greenest cities on earth!
Quest.qm_green1_task2: Get 25 Petitions for a Wind Farm
Quest.qm_green1_dialog_finish: Now that we've cleared the air, let's put our green thumbs to use at the Garden Shop!
Quest.qm_green1_dialog_header: Nothing turns on a city like a renewable energy source!
Quest.qm_green2_intro: With the new Garden Shop, your citizens will reap what they sow!
Quest.qm_green2_dialog_finish: I consider myself a world class recyclist.  Let's see if you can keep up!
Quest.qm_green2_dialog_header: To go greener, you're going to have to dig deep!
Quest.qm_green3_intro: Let's get the Recycling Plant running smoothly.  I always like to say, "It's the gift that keeps on giving!"
Quest.qm_green3_dialog_finish: You've got the green light to keep going greener!  Your city needs a symbol of sustainability!
Quest.qm_green3_dialog_header: Lead by example and get your Eco-Friendly House in order!
Quest.qm_green4_intro: You're almost there!  You're close to having the most environmentally friendly cities in the world!
Quest.qm_green4_task2: Collect from any level 3 City Hall 3 times
Quest.qm_green4_dialog_finish: Bravo!  I don't think {cityname} can get any better or eco-friendly.  I'm green with envy.  Get it?!  Green?!
Quest.qux_recyclingplant_hint: Complete the NIP IT IN THE BUD quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_ecohouse_hint: Complete the REUSE THE FORCE quest to unlock.
Quest.qux_ecoskyscraper_hint: Complete the THE SKY'S THE LIMIT quest to unlock.
Quest.qm_neighbor_vists_hearts_task1_hint: Click on the arrow button to select the heart tool. Level up your reputation to get more hearts!
Quest.qm_neighbor_vists_hearts_task2_hint: Visit City Sam to help you progress on this task!
Quest.qf_crop_mastery_intro: Y'all have become purdy good farmers!  But now  it's time to see who's really got the lay of the land!
Quest.qf_crop_mastery_dialog_header: I know a thing er two about crop mastery. If you don't know yer way around a corn field, you ain't even close!
Quest.qf_crop_mastery_task1_hint: Be a General not a kernel
Quest.qf_crop_mastery_task3_hint: Higher mastery levels give you more goods!
Quest.qf_crop_mastery_dialog_finish: Wowee! I ain't never seen anybody master a crop like that!  I ain't just butterin' you up, neither!

Quest.qm_bastille_dialog_finish: It's time to say bon voyage to the parade and prepare a patriotic feast!
