Quest.q_brazil_f1_track_3_task3_hint: Some of these cars have to have parts flown in
Quest.q_broadway_actingschool_1_dialog_finish: I've seen a lot of talented people in my time and you, my friend, have what it takes to be a star!
Quest.q_broadway_actingschool_2_dialog_header: Kids make great actors because they're so spontaneous and imaginative. At least I'm young at heart!
Quest.q_broadway_actingschool_2_task1: Collect from Amulet Apartments or Krylon Tower
Quest.q_broadway_actingschool_2_task1_hint: A lot of up and coming actors live here
Quest.q_broadway_actingschool_2_dialog_finish: I feel like I did a good job today teaching your class. I'm being modest. I did an amazing job.

Quest.q_broadway_actingschool_3_dialog_finish: Now don't get used to flying in this private jet. A great actor must always be humble. Or pretend to be.
Quest.q_buckingham_palace_1_intro: Welcome the world to your city and give your citizens the royal treatment with the regal British Palace!
Quest.q_buckingham_palace_1_dialog_header: Let's find the best spot in town for the British Palace! We'll need a spot that's fit for a king or queen!
Quest.q_buckingham_palace_1_dialog_finish: Your citizens feel right at home at the British Palace! They especially like the queen size beds!
Quest.q_buckingham_palace_2_intro: Let's treat your British citizens to a refreshing cup of tea! I'm sure it's 4 o'clock somewhere in the world!
Quest.q_buckingham_palace_2_dialog_header: The key to a good cup of tea is having the finest tea leaves available. Let's go find some!

Quest.q_buckingham_palace_2_task3_hint: It's becoming quite the tourist attraction
Quest.q_buckingham_palace_2_dialog_finish: I must admit that I rather enjoyed tea time today! I think I may have to make it a daily habit from now on!
Quest.q_buckingham_palace_3_task2_hint: We'll add this to the roast beef & potatoes

Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_1_intro: This is it, boys! We’ve been planning this trip for months and it’s finally here!
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_1_dialog_hint: Complete all 4 goals to earn the Lighting Firecrackers decoration!
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_2_dialog_header: Let’s make sure we stick to our agenda, boys. There are a lot of tourist traps around here!
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_2_task3: Collect 40 Red Lanterns from Residences or Ask Friends
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_2_dialog_finish: Thanks for showing us around, Dan! You really know your way around Shanghai!
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_3_dialog_header: Wow, look at all those red fire crackers lighting up the night sky! We’re starting the year off with a bang!
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_4_intro: It looks like Frank met a girl named Xiao Wong. They haven’t left each other’s sight in days!
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_4_dialog_header: Well, Frank’s fortune cookie did say, “You’ll meet the love of your life when you least expect it.”
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_4_task1_hint: She’s taking him to her favorite restaurants
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_4_task2: Send Tour Buses to 50 Neighbor Businesses
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_4_dialog_finish: Well boys, it looks like we started the Year of the Dragon off right! Good luck and let’s do it again soon!
Quest.q_chinese_newyear_2012_epilogue_message: I can't wait to have Xiao come visit {cityname} very soon!
Quest.q_city2ndbirthday_1_dialog_header: Let's go get some GPS Trackers so we can track down all the lost anniversary gifts! Come on!
Quest.q_city2ndbirthday_1_dialog_finish: Aw, what a great gift! You shouldn't have! I mean, you really shouldn't have opened it but I won't tell on you!
Quest.q_city2ndbirthday_2_intro: Let's celebrate CityVille's 2nd anniversary in style! First, we'll need to do some collecting so we can throw a party!

Quest.q_city2ndbirthday_3_dialog_header: I feel like you're the teacher and I'm the student when it comes to opening these containers! You're good!
Quest.q_city_of_the_year_1_goal: GOAL: RUN FOR CITY OF THE YEAR!
Quest.q_city_of_the_year_1_dialog_header: Previous winners of the City of the Year Award all had incredible Downtown areas. Keep building yours!

Quest.q_city_of_the_year_2_dialog_finish: The shops are buzzing and everyone loves the new fashions around town!
Quest.q_city_sign_1_intro: Let's build a personalized sign in your city!

Quest.q_city_sign_1_dialog_finish: I bet your friends are going to love your new City Sign! I wonder what message you'll tell them first!
Quest.q_city_sign_2_intro: Let's upgrade your City Sign to see more letters! Come on! Let's go!

Quest.q_city_sign_2_task1_hint: You can change the sign text whenever you want

Quest.q_city_sign_3_task2_hint: Save energy when collecting from the Solar Mall
Quest.q_city_sign_3_task3_hint: Build more residences to increase your population
Quest.q_city_sign_3_dialog_finish: I saw the sign and it really opened up my eyes! I can't wait to see what other messages you send us!
Quest.q_city_sign_v2_intro: The only thing better than having one City Sign is having three! So let’s place three awesome City Signs in your city!
Quest.q_city_sign_v2_dialog_header: Thanks so much for following my instructions to the letter! These new signs are going to look great!
Quest.q_city_sign_v2_task3_hint: Good job on the new City Signs
Quest.q_city_sign_v2_dialog_finish: You’re really a natural when it comes to making signs! Next time you make one, sign me up! I’d love to help!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_1_intro: Your city’s Famous Nightlife District has been in the dark for far too long! Let’s flip the switch and light up the night!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_1_dialog_header: The Majestic Plaza is the crown jewel of the Famous Nightlife District! Complete it before guests arrive!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_1_task3: Collect Lights from Majestic Plaza during Night
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_1_dialog_finish: It’s about time your city lightened up! The new lights you collected are really brightening the night sky!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_2_intro: Since your city’s Famous Nightlife District is off to a good start, you should go blow off some steam with the locals!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_2_dialog_header: Folks are strutting their stuff out at the Famous Nightlife District! So let’s go find you some new threads!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_2_task3: Collect Lights from Nightlife buildings during Night
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_2_dialog_finish: People really love your new nightclub shirt! Be careful before someone steals it right off your back!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_3_intro: Your Famous Nightlife District has really turned out to be a diamond in the rough! Let’s go find some Diamond Earrings!

Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act1_3_dialog_finish: Your Famous Nightlife District is buzzing with excitement! It’s safe to say that your future looks bright!

Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act2_1_dialog_finish: Good call on putting desk lamps in the Nocturnal Headquarters! I couldn’t see a foot in front of my face!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act2_2_intro: It looks like your Famous Nightlife District is coming along nicely! Let’s take a shot in the dark and invite the public!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act2_2_dialog_header: Folks are flying in from all over the place to check out what’s happening in your city after the sun goes down!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act2_2_task3: Earn enough lights to level up
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act2_2_dialog_finish: Now that your Famous Nightlife District is up and running, you’ve really turned into the life of the party!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act2_3_intro: It’s ladies’ night at the Famous Nightlife District! So give your female friends some fancy heels to strut around in!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act2_3_dialog_header: So far, you’ve got it made in the shade! Speaking of shade, let’s harvest some Nightshade Crops!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_1_dialog_header: If I’m going to redesign this old place, I’m going to need a protractor to help me get my measurements right!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_1_task3: Collect Kooky Keys from Nightlife Residences
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_2_task3: Collect Night Lights from Nightlife Community Buildings
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_2_dialog_finish: I wasn’t so sure about this whole Famous Nightlife District thing at first. But now I see the light!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_3_intro: Your Famous Nightlife District is quickly becoming the place to be seen! Let’s get dressed up and head over!
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_3_task2: Upgrade Night Watch Police Station to Level 3
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_3_task3: Unlock the Fourth Expansion in the Famous Nightlife District
Quest.q_cityatnight_saga_act3_3_task3_hint: I can’t wait to see what’s over there
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_1_intro: Your city needs your help to win medals in the CityVille Games! So go out there and make them proud!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_1_dialog_header: Let's get your team ready to compete! Win bronze, silver and gold medals in timed sporting events!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_1_task3_hint: You need them to carry all your medals
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_1_dialog_finish: You're going to look great in your new tracksuit! Now get out there and make us proud!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_2_intro: The only thing better than winning one medal is winning two! Come on! Go show the world what you can do!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_2_dialog_header: You're really good at detecting medals! Let's see if you can go out there and "detect" two more!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_3_intro: The only thing better than winning two medals is winning three! Come on! Don't stop now! You're on a roll!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_3_dialog_header: Finish off more events by winning three medals!  You can do it! You're the medal magnet!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_3_task1_hint: Winning the Gold gives you the best rewards!
Quest.qf_citygames_escapade_3_dialog_finish: Wow, after wowing the crowd by winning three medals, you deserve to take a five! Go on! Get some rest!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_1_dialog_header: Your economy is strong but it can always be stronger! Let’s get down to business and boost it!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_1_epilogue_message: I can't thank you enough for bringing a little Italy to your city! I've really got it made here!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_2_intro: If you really want to make your city stand out, you have to go big or go home! Let’s start by upgrading City Inc.
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_2_dialog_header: I think it’s time we visit your neighbors! Remember, good business is all about networking!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_2_dialog_finish: I can tell that you’ve got a bright business future ahead of you. And you can take that to the bank!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_3_intro: Your city’s business is booming! Let’s pad the bill and go round up some brand spanking new legal pads!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_3_task2: Collect from the Bankroll Business School
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_1_3_dialog_finish: You did a great job putting your city’s businesses on the map! I suppose it’s time for you to clock out!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_1_dialog_header: Before your city can have a top notch space program, you have to put your scientists to the test! Let’s go!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_2_intro: There’s so much of outer space that we don’t know anything about! So let’s not waste any time getting there!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_2_task3_hint: Prep for the weightlessness of space in water
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_2_dialog_finish: Your space program is really coming together! Your citizens are going to go over the moon when they find out!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_3_intro: Today’s the big day! Your space program is officially launching and the whole city is coming out to celebrate!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_3_dialog_header: The television crews are here to capture the big moment! Five, four, three, two, one…blast off!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_3_task2_hint: This Launch Pad will launch many missions
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_3_task3_hint: The ratings for the launch were sky high
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_2_3_dialog_finish: Your space program is already out of this world! Congrats on finding another way to put your city on the map!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_1_intro: If you can attract the world’s top architects to your city, then you’ll really be able to put your city on the map!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_1_dialog_header: Top notch architects can build modern marvels that will bring fame to your city’s skyline! Let’s get going!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_1_dialog_finish: Now that you’ve collected levels and design plans, you’ve leveled the playing field for the architects!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_2_intro: If your city's architecture is going to stand out from the rest, you'll need to train the architects of tomorrow!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_2_dialog_header: Let's upgrade your Architectural School so all those young architects can prepare for their careers!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_2_task1: Upgrade an Architectural School to Level 3
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_2_task3: Collect from Barcelona Cargo Plane Routes
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_2_dialog_finish: A good way to sharpen your design skills is drawing. It doesn't matter what it is. Just draw something!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_3_intro: One thing that will always make your city stand out is a few tall skyscrapers! So let's go collect from one right now!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_3_dialog_header: Let's collect from the Caribbean Cruise Routes and show these architects how to have a good time!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act1_3_3_dialog_finish: Now that you've gotten the architects' attention, they'll be working wonders in your city in no time!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act2_1_1_dialog_header: The Opening Ceremonies need to go out with a bang! So let’s go ask your friends for Pyrotechnics!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act2_1_1_dialog_finish: The pyrotechnics are a huge hit! Everyone seems to be having a blast at the Opening Ceremonies!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act2_1_2_intro: You need to get the word out about the CityVille Games by hanging up posters of all the famous athletes!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act2_1_2_dialog_header: The track and field athletes need a place to stay while they’re in town! Let’s build them some apartments!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act2_1_2_dialog_finish: Wow, you’re doing a great job of getting ready for the CityVille Games! Will you be my personal trainer?!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act2_1_3_intro: The athletes need to look their best for the CityVille Games! So let’s go ask your friends for some Jackets!
Quest.q_citymap_saga_act2_1_3_dialog_header: Some of the VIP guests are flying in for the Games in Private Jets! It looks like you’ll be cashing in on them!

Quest.q_gala_1_dialog_finish: Cool! Now that the Red Carpet Gala is built, the real fun can begin!
Quest.q_gala_2_task2_hint: We'll need great party favors for the VIPs
Quest.q_gala_2_task1: Upgrade the Red Carpet Gala to Level 3
Quest.q_gala_2_dialog_finish: Ah, the Gala is really looking nice! Let's roll out the red carpet and throw a party!
Quest.q_gala_3_task1: Collect from Red Carpet Houses 12 times
Quest.q_gala_3_task1_hint: Make sure the VIPs are ready for the party
Quest.q_gala_3_dialog_finish: Wow! That was the best Gala ever! You sure know how to throw a party!
Quest.q_godowntown_1_intro: Something big is going down! You should head Downtown and see what all the buzz is about! Let's go!
Quest.q_godowntown_1_dialog_header: Let's get down to business and check out the awesome new Downtown district! I can't wait to get there!
Quest.q_godowntown_1_task2_hint: Premium Businesses can be found Downtown
Quest.q_gov_center_1_intro: Your city has a lot of community buildings! Let's give it a Government Center to hold them for you!
