Quest.q_gov_center_1_task2: Upgrade the Government Center to Level 7
Quest.q_gov_center_1_task2_hint: Click on the Government Center to upgrade
Quest.q_gov_center_1_dialog_finish: Let's be honest. This Government Center is good but it could be great! Let's take it to the next level!
Quest.q_govt_building_1_dialog_header: You’ve proven yourself to be a fair leader and I think it’s only fair to thank you for all you’ve done so far!
Quest.q_govt_building_1_dialog_finish: Congratulations! Your citizens really love the new Government Square! You must be very proud!
Quest.q_govt_building_2_intro: Your citizens can see that you’re leading by example and they want to help you make their great city even better!
Quest.q_govt_building_2_dialog_header: If you’re going to improve your city, you need to go back to square one! Get help from your friends!
Quest.q_govt_building_2_task2_hint: Allows 1000 Population and 1050 Downtown Value. Your citizens will love it!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_1_intro: Add the New Leaf Greenhouse to your city so you can store more crops and save more space!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_1_dialog_header: The New Leaf Greenhouse is great for storing medium termed crops like cranberries and pumpkins!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_1_dialog_finish: Your idea to add greenhouses to your city is going to encourage other cities to do the same!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_2_dialog_header: After you make sure you have two New Leaf Greenhouses, let's start harvesting your crops!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_2_task3: Harvest 40 Green Grapes from a New Leaf Greenhouse
Quest.q_greenhouse2_2_dialog_finish: Your grapes look great! Your new Greenhouses are already making life easier in your city!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_3_intro: This Greenhouse idea seems to really be growing on you! Why stop now?! Let's add even more!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_3_dialog_header: Let's dust off some of these pumpkins and cranberries and add them to our harvest!
Quest.q_greenhouse2_3_dialog_finish: You sure are making great use of your Greenhouses! I wonder if you can fit any more crops in there!
Quest.q_greenhouse3_1_intro: We’ve made a technological breakthrough with the new Late Bloomer Greenhouse! Place one in your city today!
Quest.q_greenhouse3_1_dialog_header: The Late Bloomer Greenhouse is amazing! It can store long terms crops that take a day or more to harvest!
Quest.q_greenhouse3_1_dialog_finish: Everyone loves all the corn that you just harvested! Especially the kids! Who knew?!
Quest.q_greenhouse3_2_dialog_header: After you make sure you have two Greenhouses, let’s start harvesting your crops!
Quest.q_greenhouse3_2_task2: Harvest a Level 2 Late Bloomer Greenhouse
Quest.q_greenhouse3_2_dialog_finish: Wow, that’s a lot of wheat! It looks like your new Greenhouses are really coming in handy!
Quest.q_greenhouse3_3_intro: You’ve planted a lot of bountiful crops in your Greenhouses and now it’s time to finally reap the benefits!
Quest.q_greenhouse3_3_dialog_header: Let’s dust off some corn and cabbage and add them to our harvest!
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_1_intro: With the new Water Greenhouse you can grow crops on the water!
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_1_dialog_header: Test out the new building which lets you plants crops on the water!
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_1_dialog_finish: So far the water has been kind! Good work!
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_2_dialog_header: You could use more than one of these Water Greenhouses!
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_2_task2: Collect from Level 2 Water Greenhouses 5 Times
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_2_dialog_finish: You’ve managed to keep your goods production afloat!
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_3_task2: Collect from a Level 3 Water Greenhouse 5 Times
Quest.q_greenhouse_water_3_dialog_finish: You’re a natural! Your Water Greenhouses are doing great!
Quest.q_grow_pumpkin_1_intro: Grow an enormous pumpkin for your city’s Halloween festival and earn enormous rewards!
Quest.q_grow_pumpkin_1_dialog_header: It’s time to scout out the perfect patch for your baby pumpkin to start growing!
Quest.q_grow_pumpkin_1_dialog_finish: You’re on your way to growing the biggest pumpkin in town, so don’t stop here!
Quest.q_grow_pumpkin_2_intro: Rumor has it that another city is growing a bigger pumpkin! Squash the competition!
Quest.q_grow_pumpkin_2_dialog_header: Your friends can help you push the limits of your pumpkin! Let’s outgrow that other city!
Quest.q_grow_pumpkin_2_task1_hint: Unless you want to stand in the field yourself
Quest.q_grow_pumpkin_2_dialog_finish: You outgrew them! That other pumpkin didn’t stand a chance against your monster squash!
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_1_intro: You have one of the most talented gymnastic teams in the world! Supply them with what they need to win!
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_1_dialog_header: The gymnasts require the best in equipment and facilities to focus their energy on the competition.
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_1_task2_hint: Only the best facility for these athletes
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_1_dialog_finish: The gymnasts love their new training facility! They want to name it after you in your honor!
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_2_intro: Your gymnasts need sponsorships that best reflect their athletic spirit!  Also, the other competitors are en route!
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_2_task2_hint: Harvest Malls to earn Famous Businesses
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_3_intro: The day of their competition is nearly here!  Make sure that they are 100% focused and ready!
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_3_dialog_header: Your gymnasts’ adrenaline is pumping and they are ready to win!  Check on their final practices!
Quest.q_gymnastics_center_3_dialog_finish: Your gymnasts are well trained, equipped, and mentally ready to bring home the gold!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_1_dialog_header: Before the ghosts arrive, you should give your city a spooky makeover! Come on! I’ll help!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_1_task2: Upgrade Zombie Safe House Residence to grant Ghost Population
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_1_dialog_finish: Now that the ghosts have arrived, your city is literally a ghost town! This’ll be one Halloween to remember!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_2_dialog_header: Once you build Spectral TV, the ghosts can be on the air and on the scare! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_2_task1: Upgrade Spectral TV for Ghost Pop
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_2_task1_hint: Upgrade or purchase Halloween community buildings to allow ghost population
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_2_task3: Collect Black Roses from Halloween Residences with Ghost Population
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_2_task3_hint: Upgrade Halloween residences to grow ghost population
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_2_dialog_finish: Nothing says hospitality like a black rose. But it seems like the visiting ghosts love them!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_3_dialog_header: Let’s find some Witch’s Wands so we can cast spells on any spooky surprises we see in the Schoolhouse!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_3_task1_hint: Let’s see if it makes the ghoulish grade
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act1_3_dialog_finish: Well, the cat’s out of the bag about the Haunted Schoolhouse! A few studious spirits have enrolled already!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_1_dialog_header: Show off your work to your friends by inviting them to stay for the phantom festivities!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_1_task1_hint: Even ghosts need a place to rest
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_1_dialog_finish: Your population is creeping up in a creepy way! Soon your spooks will outnumber the living!
Quest.qux_faeriefragrances_hint: Complete the GHOSTLY GUESTS Goal to unlock Faerie Fragrances!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_2_task2: Collect from Faerie Fragrances or Backwoods Blacksmith
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_2_dialog_finish: That’s some super sanguine city you’ve got! An upgraded blood bank and ghosts galore? Yes!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_3_intro: The ghosts in your city are telling ghost stories about a Mysterious Mausoleum that appears once every hundred years!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_3_task3: Collect Dusty Bouquets from Halloween Buildings
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act2_3_dialog_finish: The greatest trick he ever pulled off was making the Mausoleum reappear! He must’ve said Abra-cadaver!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act3_1_task2: Collect Bandage Cloth from Ghost Community Buildings
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act3_1_dialog_finish: We’ve taken care of grub, garments and guests for our ghostly gala! You’ve done a lot!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act3_2_intro: The hour for revelry is here! Now is the time to make sure our city is the perfect Halloween host!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act3_2_dialog_header: A new upgraded lab for my creepy creations would be just what the doctor ordered!
Quest.q_halloween_saga_act3_2_dialog_finish: You’ve shown what a dead-friendly destination your city is with your new improvements!
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_1_dialog_header: Construct a creepy clock tower for your ghosts, ghouls and monsters to reside!
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_1_task1: Place and Upgrade The Creepy Clock Tower to Level 2
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_2_dialog_header: Make sure your tower continues to escalate into the unknown! Don’t get vexed by vertigo!
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_2_task1: Upgrade The Creepy Clock Tower to Level 4
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_3_intro: My ghostly Aunt Prue wants to move in to your tower, but she’s pretty picky!
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_3_dialog_header: Aunt Prue wants a suite! Upgrade your tower to attract classy undead tenants like her!
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_3_task1: Upgrade Creepy Clock Tower to Level 6
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_3_task2: Get Tarnished Keys from Ghost Homes
Quest.q_halloween_skyscraper_3_dialog_finish: You’ve completed a hair-raising endeavor! A tower housing a plethora of phantoms!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act1_2_intro: You’ve got nearly everything to celebrate a cool, crisp winter, but something’s missing!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act1_2_dialog_header: I’ve invited friends to spend some time with us at the lake! Help me get ready for them!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act1_2_task2: Collect from Locomotive Lori Routes 12 Times
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act1_3_dialog_header: One of the baby Yetis has gone missing and it’s up to us to help find it! Start looking!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act1_3_dialog_finish: The Yeti was hiding under your Holiday Tree! Looks like you’ve found some gifts too!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_1_intro: Keep growing your holiday tree to new heights and collect special, festive gifts from it!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_1_dialog_header: Winter has arrived! Let’s gather decorations for your tree to make it more festive!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_1_task1: Upgrade the Giant Holiday Tree to Level 4
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_1_dialog_finish: Wow! Your tree has grown to be far more festive draped in decorations! Keep it up!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_2_intro: Earn rewards by sharing the joys of holiday cheer with neighbors and out-of-towners alike!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_2_dialog_header: Encourage winter tourism and earn big rewards! Everyone needs a little holiday escape!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_2_dialog_finish: Great job encouraging your citizens to get out and enjoy the winter with a holiday!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_3_intro: Earn rewards by finding a place for your citizens to have outdoor winter activities!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_3_dialog_header: A ski slope would be ideal! Let’s see if we can find the perfect one to add to your city!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act2_3_task3: Harvest Reindeer Zoo or Kringle Crafts
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_1_task1: Upgrade your Giant Holiday Tree to Level 6
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_1_dialog_finish: What a magnificent tree you’re growing! It adds so much holiday presence to your city!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_2_task2_hint: So he can dash through the snow in cheer
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_2_task3: Collect from Gift Box Abode or Twinkle Castle
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_2_dialog_finish: You did it! Now Santa can continue his journey delivering gifts! Here’s one for you!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_3_intro: Find a way to add to your city’s ambience for the holidays and earn big rewards!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_3_dialog_header: You’ve found a holiday light display on the outskirts of your city! Let’s investigate!
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_3_task3_hint: Stop horsing around and spread the holiday word
Quest.q_holiday2012_saga_act3_3_dialog_finish: You did a fine job draping your city in winter splendor! Enjoy your holiday rewards!
Quest.q_ice_factory_1_dialog_header: Carving ice is easy when you have the right tools! Let’s start by building the workshop!
Quest.q_ice_factory_1_task1: Build the Rustic Wing of your Ice Workshop
Quest.q_ice_factory_1_dialog_finish: There’s a chill in the air...in a good way! Your Ice Workshop is coming together nicely!
Quest.q_ice_factory_2_intro: These ice buildings will definitely provide a nice, unique winter ambience in your city!
Quest.q_ice_factory_2_task1: Build the Urban Wing of the Ice Workshop
Quest.q_ice_factory_2_task2_hint: Craft Ice Residences in your Urban Wing
Quest.q_ice_factory_2_dialog_finish: Congratulations on sculpting some lovely frozen architectural ambience for your city!
Quest.q_international_mall_1_dialog_header: Place the International Shopping Center so that the shopping sprees can begin! Your citizens are waiting!
Quest.q_international_mall_1_task1: Place and Complete the International Shopping Center
Quest.q_international_mall_1_task3_hint: Your citizens would like to shop overseas, too
Quest.q_international_mall_1_dialog_finish: Great job sending those Cruise Ships and handling all those businesses! Now let’s upgrade the mall!
Quest.q_international_mall_2_intro: Now that your International Shopping Center is up and running, let’s upgrade it and attract even more shoppers!
Quest.q_international_mall_2_dialog_header: After you upgrade, you can collect from Businesses in a neighbor’s city! It’s the neighborly thing to do!
Quest.q_international_mall_2_task1: Upgrade International Shopping Center to Level 2
Quest.q_international_mall_2_task1_hint: It’s becoming the center of attention
Quest.q_international_mall_2_task2: Collect from Businesses in a Neighbor’s City
Quest.q_international_mall_3_intro: Your International Shopping Center is becoming an international sensation! So let’s keep upgrading!
Quest.q_international_mall_3_dialog_header: Your International Shopping Center has put you and your city front and center! You must be very excited!
Quest.q_international_mall_3_task1: Upgrade International Shopping Center to Level 3
Quest.q_international_mall_3_dialog_finish: Now that you have an amazing International Shopping Center, you deserve to go on your own shopping spree!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_1_intro: My wife and I want to share our Italian culture with Cityville!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_1_task2: Have 6 Italian Businesses in your city
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_1_task2_hint: It's nice to see more friends from home
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_1_dialog_finis: Mamma mia! With all these Italian businesses opening up, it's like we're living in a Little Italy!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_1_mouseover_me: Welcome Italy to your city and become an Ambassador to the world!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_mouseover_me: Help Lorenzo keep the family business going and keep your Italian citizens happy!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_dialog_heade: My friends call me dough boy because I'm always kneading pizza dough! And I could stand to lose a few!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_dialog_finis: Hey, don't eat too much of that sauce! I know it's delicious but you have to save some for my customers!
Quest.qm_govrunrita3_mouseover_message: While Lorenzo retires, help his son take over the family restaurant!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_dialog_heade: Now that my work is in the past, it's time to pursue my passion for racing! Drop the checkered flag!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_task1_hint: Ask from Friends or Harvest Businesses to Collect
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_1_message: Welcome France to your city and become an Ambassador to the world!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_1_intro: I came here from France so I could hone my recipes and try them on a new batch of hungry customers!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_1_task1: Place and Complete the French Gothic Fortress
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_1_task3_hint: I've persuaded many friends to move here
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_message: Help Andre upgrade his French café and help keep his customers happy!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_intro: Running the best café in town is a piece of cake! The hard part is trying to get a table here on a Saturday night!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_task1: Ask friends for 35 Reservations or collect from French Businesses
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_task2: Upgrade a French Restaurant to 3 stars
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_task2_hint: We need to accommodate more customers
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_task3: Place 2 French decorative Art Pieces in your city
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_task3_hint: French decorations can be found in the European section
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_2_dialog_fin: The café was so busy tonight that I didn't have a chance to eat! I'm so hungry that I can't even think!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_3_mouseover_: Celebrate Andre's big award and help him upgrade the Cooking School!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_3_intro: Finally, my baking expertise has been recognized! Chic Chef Magazine has named me Baker of the Year!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_3_dialog_hea: I'm going to use the prize money from the Baker of the Year award to make my café even better!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_3_task2_hint: Maybe it'll produce the next Baker of the Year
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_3_task3_hint: We need to make more French bread than ever
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_2_1_epilogue_m: I can't thank you enough for bringing a bit of France to your city! I feel like I never left home!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_1_mouseover_: Welcome Spain and realize your goal of having an international city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_1_intro: I came to CityVille to help run my family's businesses! But I will never forget my Spanish heritage! Viva Spain!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_1_dialog_hea: My family used to do flamenco performances together! My father even played flamenco guitar!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_1_task2: Collect 15 times from any Spanish Business
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_1_dialog_fin: My family loves to show off its talents! And I can't wait to show this city more of my culture!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_2_mouseover_: Help Salvador entertain his restaurant patrons and show them a good time!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_2_dialog_hea: I always like to entertain my customers while they eat! They always leave bigger tips!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_2_task1: Master the Matador Restaurant to 2 Stars
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_3_mouseover_: Help Salvador keep his casinos packed and his customers happy!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_3_intro: Thanks to my parents, I know how to put on a good show for my customers! Let's go put one on over at my casino!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_3_dialog_hea: My casino has been successful ever since it first opened! I guess you could say it's beginner's luck!
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_3_task2: Collect 5 Trophy Cases from the Soccer Stadium
Quest.q_international_saga_act1_3_1_epilogue_m: Thank you for welcoming Spain to your city! It's made my relatives and me very happy!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_1_intro: Let’s explore North America and showcase its architecture in your city so you can earn some amazing rewards!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_1_dialog_header: Benjamin Franklin wanted to make the turkey the national bird of the United States! Let’s go find some!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_1_task2_hint: This task is for the birds
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_1_dialog_finish: Your citizens really love the new North American buildings! You’re really living the American dream!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_2_intro: Now that your city is overflowing with nods to North America, let’s take it one step further! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_2_dialog_header: Mexico is one of the world’s leading producers of bananas! Let’s go collect some in your city!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_2_task1_hint: Collect Buffalo from North American Buildings
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_2_task2: Collect Mexican Bananas from North American Buildings
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_2_dialog_finish: Congratulations on mastering North America! Now your city has even more international appeal!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_3_intro: Let’s explore Antarctica and showcase its frozen wonders in your city so you can earn some amazing rewards!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_3_dialog_header: Let’s break the ice in your city by expanding out to the Antarctic Research Station!
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_3_task1: Expand out to the Antarctic Research Station
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_3_task2: Ask friends for Ice Core Drills
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_3_task2_hint: This will help us learn about the climate
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_3_task3_hint: Your city keeps growing and growing
Quest.q_intl_2013_saga_act1_3_dialog_finish: With the addition of North American and Antarctic items, your city no longer has a continental divide!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_1_message: Welcome Japan and its customs while you continue to build an international city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_1_intro: My grandparents live in Kyoto, Japan and I always used to visit them as a child! I loved all the beautiful sights there!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_1_dialog_hea: One thing that I really love about Japan is all the gorgeous gardens and pavilions! Let’s give your city one!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_1_task2: Collect 20 Cherry Blossoms from Japanese items or Ask Friends
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_1_task3_hint: These are served at Tea Shops and Noodle Shops
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_1_dialog_fin: I already loved living in your city but now that it has a little more Japanese flavor, it’s my cup of tea!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_2_intro: I took a semester to study abroad in Tokyo and it really inspired me to become an architect! I love all the skyrises!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_2_dialog_hea: It didn’t take me long to figure out how to use what I saw in Tokyo’s architecture in my own designs!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_2_task1_hint: Timeshare Tower, Skyscraper Condos, Beachfront Condo and more!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_2_task3: Collect 15 City Sketches from Community Buildings
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_2_task3_hint: I think I have an idea for my next project
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_2_dialog_fin: I take as much pride in my sketches as I do in my buildings! My Japanese heritage has instilled that in me!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_3_message: Help Frank design a gift to your city inspired by his Japanese heritage!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_3_intro: I would love to design something for your city that shows my parents that their son hasn’t forgotten where he came from!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_3_dialog_hea: I’m going to cement my legacy by designing a gift to you inspired by a famous media company in Japan!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_3_task3: Collect from any Japanese business 20 times
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_1_1_epilogue_m: Thank you for welcoming Japan to your city! It’s made my relatives and me very happy!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_1_message: Welcome the United States while you continue to build an international city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_1_dialog_hea: Let's give your city a little Hollywood glamour with some new businesses and a Film Studio!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_1_task3_hint: There's no business like show business
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_1_dialog_fin: I'm fortunate that I've been able to work on my career while living in your city! It's a dream come true!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_2_intro: Now that I'm a big star, I want to produce my own movies! And I want to produce them right here in your city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_2_dialog_hea: Being a star has its perks! It means I can live wherever I want and I just so happen to want to live in your city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_2_task1: Collect 30 Ruby Red Slippers from any Mansion residence or ask friends
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_2_task3_hint: Everyone wants to live like a star
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_2_dialog_fin: Now that your city has even more Hollywood memorabilia, it's really becoming an international icon!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_3_message: Help Bella get her film into a film festival and open a new movie theater!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_3_intro: My new movie just got accepted into an international film festival! I think shooting it in your city really helped!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_3_task3_hint: Upgrade your Cruise Ship Pier to unlock Tours
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_3_dialog_fin: Now that this theater is in your city, maybe my movies will inspire a young girl to grow up to be just like me!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_2_1_epilogue_m: Thank you for welcoming the United States to your city! It's made all my career dreams come true!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_1_mouseover_: Welcome the UK while you continue to build an international city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_1_dialog_hea: Now, I'm heading to the UK to do a little more research before I finally finish my book! I'm so excited!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_1_task3_hint: Build and collect from UK theme residences
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_2_mouseover_: Help Louise go back home and finish her novel!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_2_intro: Going back to the UK was very inspiring! Now it's time to head home and put the finishing touches on my novel!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_2_dialog_hea: Whenever I get writer's block, I go over to the local university. Being around students helps me write!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_2_task2: Collect 10 Novel Edits from any University Building
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_2_dialog_fin: It's finished! My novel is finally finished! Oh, I hope it's good! I wonder if people will buy it!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_3_mouseover_: Help Louise sell her new novel and open a bookstore!
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_3_task2: Collect 50 Copies of Louise's Fantasy Novel from businesses or ask friends
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_3_task3_hint: Build and collect from Grade School, Middle School, or High School
Quest.q_international_saga_act2_3_1_epilogue_m: Thank you for welcoming the UK to your city! It's made all my career dreams come true!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_1_mouseover_: Welcome Dubai while you continue to build an international city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_1_task1: Collect 25 Forklifts from Dubai Shipping Routes or ask friends
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_1_task1_hint: Selling these really lifts my spirits
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_1_task3: Collect from any Gated Community neighborhood 5 times
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_1_task3_hint: It's a great place to raise a family
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_2_mouseover_: Help Vance make the most of his business trip to Dubai!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_2_dialog_fin: No matter how hard I work while I'm here, I always find a little time to take in the sights and sounds of Dubai!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_3_mouseover_: Help Vance open up the newest headquarters for Valor Industries in Dubai!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_3_intro: Since I'm opening up the newest headquarters for Valor Industries here, Dubai is going to give your city a big gift!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_3_dialog_hea: The grand opening of Valor Industries is a success! A lot of people will get much-needed jobs here!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_1_1_epilogue_m: Thank you for welcoming Dubai to your city! My family is eternally grateful!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_1_mouseover_: Welcome Brazil while you continue to build an international city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_1_intro: I grew up in Brazil with my mother and I like to reminisce about my time there! I especially miss the food and soccer!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_1_dialog_hea: My mother used to always make traditional Brazilian dishes! My favorite one was Feijoada!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_1_task1: Collect Feijoada Dishes from Family residences or ask friends
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_1_task1_hint: My mother made the best Feijoada
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_1_dialog_fin: Man, I really miss Brazil! I already have a lot on my plate but I think I want to help bring Brazil to your city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_2_dialog_hea: In soccer, you use your feet a lot but you also use your head! Let's put our heads together and do this!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_2_task3: Collect Soccer Jerseys from Brazilian businesses
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_3_mouseover_: Help Sue start a soccer league in your city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_3_intro: The soccer game was such a huge success that I think I'm going to start a soccer league in your city immediately!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_3_task2_hint: You can find the Custom Car Shop in your inventory if you have not placed it
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_2_1_epilogue_m: Thank you for welcoming Brazil to your city! It's made your citizens and me very happy!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_1_mouseover_: Welcome the World while you continue to build an international city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_1_intro: Wow, your city has come so far! I remember when it was just a small town. Everything was so simple back then!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_1_dialog_hea: After moving here, I got a little job helping out at the local newspaper. It was really exciting for me!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_1_task1: Collect Newspapers from any Family residence or ask friends
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_1_task2: Collect from any Bakery, Burger Joint, or Flower Kiosk
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_2_mouseover_: Help Sam cover the news on her new website, City.Sam!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_2_dialog_hea: My site has become really popular around your city and it's made living here even more fun than before!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_2_task1_hint: I'd love to live in a place like this someday
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_2_task3: Collect from any Level 3 Bakery, Burger Joint, or Flower Kiosk
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_2_task3_hint: Which means I can go to my favorite spots more
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_3_message: Help Sam cover the news on all the international events in your city!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_3_intro: Since you've welcomed the world to your city, it has made me want to report on the news all over the globe!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_3_dialog_hea: With all my recent success, I think I may move Downtown and make my own headlines for a change!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_3_dialog_fin: Wow, your city has always been very international but Downtown is truly a whole new world! I'm so excited!
Quest.q_international_saga_act3_3_1_epilogue_m: Thank you for welcoming the world to your city! On behalf of all of your citizens, we really appreciate it!
Quest.q_island_ferry_intro: Build a Ferry Marina today to bring island tourists and house boats to your city!
Quest.q_island_ferry_task1_hint: Collect from residences for a chance to get one
Quest.q_island_ferry_task2: Complete construction of the Ferry Marina
Quest.q_island_ferry_task2_hint: You must place the Marina along the coast
Quest.q_island_ferry_task3_hint: Place it in the water to get ready for Islands
Quest.q_island_ferry_dialog_finish: Tourists are going to enjoy strolling along the Marina! Everyone’s really excited for the new Islands!
Quest.q_italian_castle_1_intro: Let's bring a piece of history to your city and continue on our path of making you an Ambassador to the world!
Quest.q_italian_castle_1_dialog_header: The ruins of an Italian Castle are up for sale but it's up to you to restore it to it's former glory!
Quest.q_italian_castle_1_dialog_hint: Complete all 3 goals to earn a Baroque Fountain decoration!
Quest.q_italian_castle_1_dialog_finish: Wow, you're really good at tracking down relics! Maybe you should come over and decorate my house, too!
Quest.q_italian_castle_2_intro: Oh no! Thieves have stolen some of your valuable relics! Let's go catch them and get your relics back!
Quest.q_italian_castle_2_dialog_header: Come on! I'll help you find these scumbags! I think I know where they may be hiding!
Quest.q_italian_castle_2_task1: Collect 30 Italian Relics from Residences or Friends
Quest.q_italian_castle_2_dialog_finish: Just as I suspected! The thieves were still hiding in the Castle! Well, at least it was easy to find them!
Quest.q_italian_castle_3_dialog_header: Let's lay out the welcome mat for the tourists! They're going to be blown away by this beautiful castle!
Quest.q_italian_castle_3_task2: Collect 20 times from the Venetian Mask Shop
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_1_dialog_header: The Jumbo Cruise Port will be home to your new powerful Cruise Ship which can hold many more tourists!
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_1_task1: Place and Complete a Level 1 Jumbo Cruise Port on your coastline
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_1_task1_hint: A Level 1 Jumbo Cruise Port = 4 Regular Cruise Ports!
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_1_dialog_finish: A lot of cities think that they don’t need a Jumbo Cruise Port. But that’s just a bunch of mumbo jumbo!
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_2_intro: Your Jumbo Cruise Port is already helping you save space in your city! So upgrade it immediately and save even more!
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_2_dialog_header: With so many tourists in your city, the stores are running out of swimsuits! Go see if your friends have any!
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_2_task1: Upgrade your Jumbo Cruise Port to Level 2
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_2_dialog_finish: Nice job harvesting those rice crops! I just can’t believe you did it in a swimsuit! Such a trendsetter.
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_3_intro: I think I’ve seen enough evidence to judge this case! Your Jumbo Cruise Port is a huge success! Keep upgrading!
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_3_dialog_header: This is not time to be in cruise control! You need to send and harvest your Mediterranean Cruises!
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_3_task1: Upgrade your Jumbo Cruise Port to Level 3
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_3_task2_hint: You can send them from your Jumbo Cruise Port
Quest.q_jumbo_cruise_3_task3: Collect Jumbo Shrimp Cocktails from Restaurants
Quest.q_kaboom_1_intro: KaBOOM! Playgrounds provide fun, safe places for children in places where PLAY is currently missing!
Quest.q_kaboom_1_task2_hint: Contributing helps KaBOOM! finish their playgrounds too!
Quest.q_kaboom_1_task3_hint: Playgrounds are designed by kids for kids, Contributing makes their dreams come true!
Quest.q_kaboom_2_dialog_header: The kids are having so much fun on their new playground!
Quest.q_kaboom_2_task1_hint: Contributions go towards building an additional KaBOOM! playground for children!
Quest.q_kaboom_2_task2_hint: KaBOOM! playgrounds can be designed to fit just about anywhere!
Quest.q_kaboom_2_task3_hint: These playgrounds don’t build themselves! Contributing helps keep volunteers energized.
Quest.q_kaboom_2_dialog_finish: Your new playground looks amazing! I can’t believe you built this thing from the ground up! Great job!
Quest.q_keys3_quest_intro: Your citizens have Island fever! And the only prescription is more Islands! Let’s give ‘em what they want!
Quest.q_keys3_quest_dialog_finish: I’m sure I’m not the only one who thinks this but your new fishermen’s island, Cod Cove, looks amazing!
Quest.q_keys4_quest_task1_hint: You can start collecting before you place
Quest.q_keys4_quest_task3: Collect from the Fortune Island Casino 10 times
Quest.q_keys4_quest_task3_hint: Complete the Island to collect from the Casino
Quest.q_keys_hillside_task3_hint: Turn Goods into Special Delivery Crates
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_1_intro: You should build yourself a Lakefront Civic Center so you can make more room for your city’s community buildings!
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_1_dialog_header: Uh oh, it looks like we need some Crosscut Saws! I’ve got my fingers crossed that your friends have some!
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_2_dialog_header: A lot of your Lakefront locals would like to visit your neighbors’ cities! So load up the bus and head out!
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_2_task1: Upgrade your Lakefront Civic Center to Level 2
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_2_dialog_finish: Your Lakefront Civic Center is quickly becoming your city’s new center of attention! This place is packed!
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_3_dialog_header: Your citizens are going to jump for joy when they see these amazing Water Trampolines you found!
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_3_task1: Upgrade your Lakefront Civic Center to Level 3
Quest.q_lakefront_civic_center_3_dialog_finish: Between sending citizens out on cruises or giving them water trampolines, you’re cruising right along!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_1_intro: You should build a cozy neighborhood by the lake so you can make room for more vacation homes! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_1_dialog_header: If you don’t mind, could you watch my fishing rods while I get some more tackle? Thanks, neighbor!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_1_dialog_finish: Ah, man! I had a huge fish on my line but he jumped off the hook right at the last minute! Did you see that?!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_2_intro: It looks like your Lakefront Neighborhood is already helping you save space and earn bonuses! So let’s upgrade it!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_2_dialog_header: These new Lakefront homes are sellin’ like hotcakes! Everyone wants to live down by the lake!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_2_dialog_finish: You’ve really got it made in the shade over here! Oh, that reminds me. I’m gonna go take a nap under that tree!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_3_dialog_header: I say we take this party where no party has gone before! Onto the water! Let’s go find some Party Rafts!
Quest.q_lakefront_neighborhood_3_dialog_finish: That party was a blast! And it was great to meet all your next door neighbors! They love it here!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_1_intro: Now that the Lakefront is part of your city, let’s roll out the welcome mat for all those happy vacationers!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_1_dialog_finish: Everyone is having a really great time so far! You must be one happy vacationer!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_2_intro: There’s a lot of natural beauty out here by the Lakefront! Look at all those ducks on the water! They’re so cute!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_2_dialog_header: Let’s go ask your friends for Duck Whistles so we can call our fine feathered friends over to us!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_3_intro: There’s nothing more relaxing than taking a rowboat out on the lake! So let’s go find some for the vacationers!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_3_dialog_header: We better find some rowboats fast or we’re gonna be up a creek...er...lake without a paddle!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_3_task3_hint: So you can unlock better rewards
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act1_3_dialog_finish: From the looks of it, you should’ve built the Drawbridge a long time ago. But that’s water under the bridge.
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act2_1_dialog_header: People are flocking to your new Lakefront in droves! Increase your population for better rewards!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act2_1_dialog_finish: Your crops are coming in nicely! Whether it’s in the city or by the lake, you really are the cream of the crop!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act2_2_intro: The action down by the lake is in full swing! Let’s go collect some tire swings so we can keep the fun going!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act2_2_dialog_header: I bet some of those Lakefront Businesses have spare tires for the tire swings! Let’s ask them!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act2_3_intro: It’s time for you to make some history by placing and completing the Lakefront Historical Society!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act2_3_task3_hint: Preserve the lakefront for generations to come
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_1_intro: I think it’s time we go down and have a little fun on the lake...literally! I want to see how well you can water ski!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_1_dialog_header: There’s no better way to get your feet wet than by strapping on a pair of water skis! Let’s go find some!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_1_dialog_finish: You’ve struck a good balance of mixing business with pleasure! And you’re balancing on the skis well, too!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_2_intro: Man, this really is the life! I could spend all day out on the lake! I think I may have to come back here every year!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_2_dialog_finish: You really made a big splash today with your new life jacket! It’s both stylish and useful at the same time!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_3_intro: One of the things I like about the Lakefront is that everything is just a stone’s throw away! It’s so convenient!
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_3_task1: Collect Skipping Stones from Lakefront Community Buildings
Quest.q_lakefront_saga_act3_3_task2_hint: I can’t believe how many people are here
Quest.q_lofts_1_intro: Test out my new experimental Business Loft designs and increase population! Build them today!
Quest.q_lofts_1_dialog_header: What do you think of this Restaurant Loft? If you like this one, I’ve got more blueprints!
Quest.q_lofts_1_task2_hint: These designs save space with Business and Residence in one!
Quest.q_lofts_1_task3_hint: Business Lofts can be handy money makers
Quest.q_lofts_1_dialog_finish: Thanks for testing out my new Business Loft! It’s a success, so let’s build some more!
Quest.q_lofts_2_intro: Time to mix it up by letting me help you build more new Business Lofts in your city!
Quest.q_lofts_2_dialog_header: That restaurant loft was a huge success! Let’s try building some of my other designs!
Quest.q_lofts_2_task2_hint: Click to deliver supplies and upgrade to add more population to your City!
Quest.q_lofts_2_task3_hint: New residents needed for your new Business Lofts
Quest.q_lofts_2_dialog_finish: Great job! These buildings are bound to be sure successes from every angle! Keep it up!
Quest.q_lofts_3_task3_hint: Bring more Citizens to your Business Lofts!
Quest.q_lofts_3_dialog_finish: A roof-raising success! I’d say we work together almost as well as my Business Lofts!
Quest.q_lovehotel_1_goal: GOAL: STAY AT THE HONEYMOON HOTEL
Quest.q_lovehotel_1_task2_hint: Build a Flower Kiosk and take it to the next level
Quest.q_lovehotel_1_task3_hint: Let's welcome them with a bouquet of flowers
Quest.q_lovehotel_1_dialog_hint: You can find the Honeymoon Hotel in your inventory
Quest.q_lovehotel_1_dialog_finish: Your guests loved the fresh flowers! It looks like business is booming and love is blooming!
Quest.q_lovehotel_2_intro: Now that the Honeymoon Hotel is open, let's spread the word to all the happy couples!
Quest.q_lovehotel_2_dialog_header: Let's surprise them with French kisses! French chocolate kisses, that is!
Quest.q_lovehotel_2_task1: Collect 35 Chocolate Boxes from Businesses or friends
Quest.q_lovehotel_2_task2: Collect from a Level 3 Wedding Hall 2 times
Quest.q_lovehotel_2_dialog_finish: We're not only bringing together a lot of natural matches but some unlikely pairs as well!
Quest.q_lovehotel_3_dialog_header: Our guests love the fact that they can have some time to themselves. Let's leave these lovebirds alone!
Quest.q_lovehotel_3_dialog_finish: With all the lovely French touches you've added to your city, it may be the most romantic place on earth!
Quest.q_mall_solar_task1_hint: The Solar Mall takes less energy to collect from its businesses.
Quest.q_mall_solar_task2_hint: Click on the Solar Mall to bring up the Mall Menu
Quest.q_mall_solar_task3: Upgrade your Solar Mall to level 2
Quest.q_mcd5_quest_dialog_header: This mid-day break will leave you and your citizens smiling
Quest.q_mcd5_quest_task3: Place your McDonald's Cycle Center for an 18% bonus
Quest.q_mcd5_quest_task3_hint: You will find this in your inventory after you master the Springtime McDonald's
Quest.q_mcd5_quest_task4: Collect items from the Springtime McDonald's for extra rewards
Quest.q_mcd5_quest_task4_hint: Continue to collect from the Springtime McDonald's to complete the Lunch at McDonald's collection
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_1_epilogue_message: Since you're being such a big help to me, I'm going to make sure you go on the "Nice" list!
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_1_task3_hint: The building will need a lot of supplies
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_1_dialog_hint: Complete all 4 goals to earn the Bushwick Apartments! (adds up to 1960 population)
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_2_intro: Let's make your city the worldwide leader in telecommunications! Come on, let's spread the news!
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_3_intro: This just in! I've hired news crews from all over the world to report the news to all different cultures!
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_3_dialog_finish: I've been telling you for a while now but your city is really becoming a global communications hub!
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_4_intro: The Television Network in on the air and it's a huge success! It has happy viewers all over the world!
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_4_dialog_header: All the hard work that you've put into the Television Network is now coming back to you and paying off!
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_4_task2: Collect 50 Resumes from Residences or Ask Friends
Quest.q_metro_elder_one_4_task3_hint: Find news in the far reaches of the earth
Quest.q_morecars_1_dialog_header: For all those delivery truck drivers who want to carpool, allow me to show them the brand new CV Work Horse!
Quest.q_morecars_1_dialog_finish: The delivery truck drivers really love the new CV Work Horse! Looks like you really delivered the goods!
Quest.q_morecars_2_dialog_finish: The carpool is really heating up thanks to the success of the solar powered Solargo! I might get one, too!
Quest.q_morecars_3_dialog_header: The best part is, the Inferno uses ethanol. Which means that this sports car needs corn to run!
Quest.q_morecars_3_dialog_finish: With these new cars, your city is on the fast track to becoming the most carpool friendly city in the world!
Quest.q_national_park_task1: Upgrade the National Park Office to Level 2
Quest.q_national_park_task1_hint: You can move a fully upgraded Park Office!
Quest.q_national_park_task2_hint: Ask friends or collect Seedlings from the Park Office!
Quest.q_national_park_task3_hint: You can earn Mystery Seedlings that grow into trees!
Quest.q_national_park_phase2_1_dialog_finish: Now that you have so many beautiful trees around your National Park, you should celebrate!
Quest.q_national_park_phase2_2_intro: Your National Park is pretty great but you can always make it better! Let's add more buildings to your park!
Quest.q_national_park_phase2_2_task1: Have National Park Buildings in your city
Quest.q_national_park_phase2_2_dialog_finish: Let me know if you need a park ranger in your National Park. I know a guy. You may have heard of him.
Quest.q_natural_wonder_craft_1_intro: It's time to make some more wonder-ful additions to your city with these Natural Wonders! Come on! Let's get started!
Quest.q_natural_wonder_craft_1_task2_hint: Complete A Wonder To Level 1 To Place It
Quest.q_natural_wonder_craft_1_dialog_finish: You look like you really know where you're going now that you have your Wonderful Maps!
Quest.q_natural_wonder_craft_2_intro: Let's completely upgrade your Natural Wonder so you can reap the benefits of even more amazing bonuses!
Quest.q_natural_wonder_craft_2_dialog_header: It's time for you to get the boot! No, seriously! You should ask your friends for Wonderful Boots!
Quest.q_natural_wonder_craft_2_dialog_finish: Wow, you did a great job of upgrading your Natural Wonder! You're really a natural at this, aren't you?!
Quest.q_neighborhood_o_hoods_dialog_finish: You really saved the day in your city by saving space with your new Super Hood!
Quest.q_nessi_1_intro: Legend has it that a mysterious monster dwells on the bottom of the lake! Locals have been spotting her for years!
Quest.q_nessi_1_dialog_header: Her name is Nessi and she’s a bit on the shy side. But if you give Nessi her favorite treat, she might come out!
Quest.q_nessi_1_task1_hint: She’s a big monster in a small pond
Quest.q_nessi_1_dialog_finish: Nessi loves these flowers! The more you feed her, the more she’ll grow! I hope she comes out for us soon!
Quest.q_nessi_2_intro: It looks like Nessi’s breaking out of her shell a bit! Let’s give her some treats when she comes up to the surface!
Quest.q_nessi_2_dialog_header: Nessi’s bigger than the stories I’ve heard! And if she keeps feasting on flowers, she’ll get even bigger!
Quest.q_nessi_2_task3_hint: People are enjoying their lakefront homes
Quest.q_nessi_2_dialog_finish: I think I just saw Nessi’s head poke out of the water! Or was it her tail?! I wish I could get a closer look!
Quest.q_nessi_3_intro: At the rate that Nessi is eating, not only is her legend growing but she’s literally growing as well! She’s getting huge!
Quest.q_nessi_3_dialog_header: For a lake monster, Nessi sure is a gentle giant! I’m pretty sure she’s more scared of us then we are of her!
Quest.q_nessi_3_dialog_finish: Uh oh, it looks like Nessi is in a playful mood! This is one splash fight that we can’t win! I promise you that!
Quest.q_nessi_4_intro: Ring the dinner bell! It’s time to feed Nessi again! She really can’t get enough of these flowers! She’s insatiable!
Quest.q_nessi_4_dialog_header: Let’s make sure that Nessi’s gotten her fill. Before long, she’s going to be too big for the lake!
Quest.q_nessi_5_intro: The entire lakefront community has caught Nessi fever! They can’t get enough of this lovable lake monster!
Quest.q_nessi_5_dialog_header: People are starting to come from miles around to get a glimpse of this legendary creature!
Quest.q_nessi_5_dialog_finish: I think it’s safe to say that Nessi is a lot more comfortable around people now than when we first met her!
Quest.q_new_years_core_loop_1_intro: It’s a New Year! Earn big rewards by keeping our resolution to improve our city every day!
Quest.q_new_years_core_loop_1_dialog_header: There’s nothing like a brand new year to re-energize us for for more city-wide improvements!
Quest.q_new_years_core_loop_1_dialog_finish: Way to increase your population! We’re making big progress already! Keep up the good work!
Quest.q_new_years_core_loop_2_intro: Keeping resolutions to be healthier make you a role-model to your citizens! Let’s get started!
Quest.q_new_years_core_loop_2_dialog_header: Lifestyle changes are difficult, but they can be fun too if you make them with friends!
Quest.q_new_years_core_loop_3_intro: Amp up tourism in your city for a chance to earn big rewards by way of happy travelers!
Quest.q_new_years_resolution_1_dialog_header: I’m gonna whip your city into shape this New Year’s! Being greener is healthy for everyone!
Quest.q_new_years_resolution_1_dialog_finish: We’ve encouraged healthy eating, more wild greenery and sustainable power! Terrific!
Quest.q_new_years_resolution_2_dialog_header: Having healthy and fit citizens should be a goal around the world! Let’s set an example!
Quest.q_new_years_resolution_2_task1_hint: Find fitness buildings to click on
Quest.q_new_years_resolution_2_dialog_finish: With all this healthy eating and exercise, your city is feeling more fit already! Keep it up!
Quest.q_new_years_resolution_3_dialog_header: Connect with your family and friends to share your newfound healthy lifestyle with them!
Quest.q_new_years_resolution_3_dialog_finish: Your city is feeling happy, healthy, and full of heart too! A great way to start the new year!
Quest.q_newyear_eve_1_intro: I can't believe 2011 is already over! Well, let's party one last time and ring in 2012, everybody!
Quest.q_newyear_eve_1_dialog_header: I can't wait for the big party! While Max decorates the museum, I'm going to go find us some party hats!
Quest.q_newyear_eve_1_task1: Complete the New Year's Museum Party
Quest.q_newyear_eve_1_task3_hint: Hats can be rewarded on residence collections
Quest.q_newyear_eve_1_dialog_hint: Complete all 3 goals to earn the NYE Party Spot (1,500 population)
Quest.q_newyear_eve_1_dialog_finish: I still need a party dress! Hopefully, Louise can do me a favor and let me borrow one of hers!
Quest.q_newyear_eve_2_intro: It's time for the guests to arrive! I plan on making a grand entrance with Jack, Louise, and Dr. Shepherd!
Quest.q_newyear_eve_2_dialog_finish: Most of my friends haven't seen this side of me but I'm quite the party animal! Who wants to dance?!
Quest.q_newyear_eve_3_intro: This is such an exciting night! I can't wait to see what the New Year brings to all my friends and me!
Quest.q_newyear_eve_3_task1_hint: Collect from Municipals or Ask Friends for help
Quest.q_newyear_eve_3_task2_hint: What a great place for a party
Quest.q_newyear_eve_3_dialog_finish: Wow, what a night! I hope next year's party is just as fun as this one was! I'm going to mark it on my calendar!
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_1_mouseover_message: Make it your New Year's Resolution to go green in 2012!
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_1_task2_hint: Let's plant more grass and trees
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_2_mouseover_message: Let's say no to littering and say yes to cleaning up the community!
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_2_intro: Ridding the environment of litter and recycling is a great way to go green! Let's go take out the trash!
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_3_mouseover_message: Keep going green and plant some trees for future generations!
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_3_intro: Let's go green...literally! Let's grab some soil and compost and plant some seeds in your city!
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_3_task1_hint: Bags of Soil can drop when harvesting crops
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_3_task2_hint: Compost drops when collecting from residences
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_3_task3_hint: Your citizens will love these trees
Quest.q_newyear_res_go_message: You stuck to your New Year's Resolution and proved you're the greenest person in town!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_1_mouseover_message: Make it your New Year's Resolution to help those in need!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_1_intro: Nothing makes a person feel better than giving back to those who are less fortunate! Let's go make a difference!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_1_dialog_header: There are a lot of young kids out there who would really benefit from your generosity. Let's get to work!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_1_task2_hint: I can't wait to see their faces when they see it
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_1_task3_hint: We need tools for all the volunteers
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_2_mouseover_message: Help your neighbors and keep working on the Boys and Girls Center!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_2_intro: Great job helping the children! Keep carrying out your New Year's Resolution and help your neighbors, too!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_2_dialog_header: Your neighbors have busy lives just like you. Lend a hand and show them that you're here to help!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_2_task1: Send 40 Tour Buses to your Neighbors' Businesses
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_2_task1_hint: Some of them need help at work
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_2_task2_hint: And some of them need help at home
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_3_intro: After visiting your neighbors, it looks like some of them could use some help with their goods! Whaddya say?!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_3_dialog_header: Some of your neighbors' crops look thirsty! Let's test the waters and give them a little drink!
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_3_task1: Harvest or unload Goods 15 times in your Neighbors' Cities
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_3_task3_hint: The Center needs a fresh coat of paint
Quest.q_newyear_res_help_epilogue_message: You stuck to your New Year's Resolution and the kids and neighbors are so glad you did!
Quest.q_newyear_res_live_1_mouseover_message: Make it your New Year's Resolution to get in shape!
Quest.q_newyear_res_live_1_dialog_header: It would be great to have a Health Complex in your city so your citizens can meet their fitness goals!
Quest.q_newyear_res_live_2_intro: Living healthier doesn't just mean exercising more. It also means eating healthier as well!
Quest.q_newyear_res_live_2_dialog_header: Let's stock up on plenty of fruits and vegetables so you can stick to your New Year's Resolution!
Quest.q_newyear_res_live_3_intro: After all this exercise, you need to get a good night's sleep! Then you'll wake up with more energy!
Quest.q_newyear_res_live_epilogue_message: You're eating healthier, exercising more, and getting enough rest each night! Here's to a healthier you!
Quest.q_night_light_intro: Your Famous Nightlife District is becoming one of your city’s biggest bright spots! So let’s add some more buildings!
Quest.q_night_light_dialog_header: Let’s unlock your 10th Nighttime Expansion so you can have City Light 100% of the time!
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_1_intro: Give your citizens a night to remember by building them a Nighttime Neighborhood and Civic Center!
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_1_dialog_header: Your new Nighttime Neighborhood and Civic Center will help you save space in your Nightlife District!
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_1_task3_hint: This holds your Nightlife Community Buildings
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_1_dialog_finish: Grab your goblets and let’s toast your city’s new Nighttime Neighborhood and Civic Center!
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_2_intro: You should upgrade your Nighttime Neighborhood so you can save even more space in your city!
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_2_dialog_finish: Let’s take a break and go have a little fun in your Nightlife District! The night is young!
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_3_intro: Let’s upgrade your Nighttime Neighborhood one more time so you can squeeze in a few more residences!
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_3_task1: Collect from Nighttime Civic Center or Nighttime Neighborhood
Quest.q_night_spacesaver_3_dialog_finish: You did a great job with your Nighttime Civic Center and Neighborhood! Now, let’s call it a night!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_1_intro: Construct a Nighttime Space Needle to be the centerpiece of your Famous Nightlife District and receive huge bonuses!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_1_dialog_header: Let's get started by placing your Nighttime Space needle in your Famous Nightlife District!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_1_task1_hint: It drops City Lights for your Nightlife District!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_1_dialog_finish: Now that your Nighttime Space Needle has an Antenna, it's more powerful than ever before!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_2_intro: Let's upgrade your Nighttime Space Needle so you can receive even bigger bonuses! Come on! Let's go!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_2_dialog_header: Whoa, the Nighttime Space Needle is really tall! Let's get some safety cables to make sure no one falls!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_2_dialog_finish: Now that you have Red Signals on your Nighttime Space Needle, your citizens will be seeing red!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_3_dialog_header: All these upgrades are starting to pay off! So let's upgrade your Nighttime Space Needle again!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_3_dialog_finish: Those blue signals really stand out on your Nighttime Space Needle! You're lighting up the night!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_4_dialog_header: Do you know what time it is? Yep, you guessed it! It's time to upgrade your Nighttime Space Needle again!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_4_dialog_finish: Other cities will be green with envy once they see the green signals on your Nighttime Space Needle!
Quest.q_nighttime_space_needle_5_intro: I've been collecting blue signals until I turned blue in the face! Come on! Let's go find some more!
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_1_task1_hint: This is a nice place to hold the Opening Ceremony
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_1_task3_hint: Look for the CV Games bonus tooltip in the market
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_2_task2: Upgrade the Ceremony Hall to Level 3
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_3_dialog_finish: Your city should host the CityVille Games more often! You've proven to really be a game changer!
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_expansion_intro: It's time to celebrate the CityVille Games' MVP, the Most Valuable Party! So let's head over to the Dignitary Mansion!
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_expansion_task2: Collect RSVPs from the Dignitary Mansion
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_expansion_task3_hint: I can't believe I'm mingling with VIPs
Quest.q_opening_ceremony_expansion_dialog_fini: It looks like the party to kick off the CityVille Games is going into overtime! I hope I get my second wind!
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_1_intro: I can't believe all my friends are coming over to my house for a slumber party! I can't wait until they all get here!
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_1_dialog_header: It would be so cool to watch a movie outside under the stars! Help me get everything ready for my friends!
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_2_dialog_header: The first thing we're going to do after school is head to the mall! I think I want to buy some new shoes!
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_2_task1_hint: I hope the neighbors don't mind the noise
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_2_task2: Collect from a Level 2 Television Tower
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_2_dialog_finish: I wonder if the girl next door would like to come to the slumber party. I think I'll go ask if she'll join us!
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_3_dialog_header: Wait! We can't watch the movie without having the proper snacks! Let's make a last minute snack run!
Quest.q_outdoor_theater_3_dialog_finish: Wow! That was so much fun! I should have slumber parties at my house more often! Well, if my Dad lets me!
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_1_dialog_header: Help Mama Polar Bear find her babies in time for them to celebrate the holidays together!
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_1_task1: Have a Level 2 Iceberg for Mama Polar Bear
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_1_task2_hint: Expand to and move a cub closer to Mama Polar Bear
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_1_task3_hint: Animal rescue missions can get chilly
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_1_dialog_finish: Mama Polar Bear is closer to seeing her cubs! Can you reunite them in time for the holidays?
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_2_dialog_header: Enlist everyone's help in getting this family back together! Surely citizens will chip in!
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_2_task2_hint: Expand to and move another cub close to Mama Polar Bear
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_2_task3: Have a Level 4 Iceberg for Mama Polar Bear
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_3_intro: Our polar bear family is happier thanks to your efforts, but we've still got work to do!
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_3_dialog_header: Everything is coming together for a heartfelt reunion! Just a few key pieces left!
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_3_task2: Have a Level 7 Iceberg for Mama Polar Bear
Quest.q_polarbear_rescue_3_dialog_finish: A warm, fuzzy family reunion and rewards for you make this endeavor a holiday success!
Quest.q_ponyranch_1_dialog_header: Now that you're back in the saddle, let's dress this ol' Pony Ranch up a bit! The ponies have exquisite taste!
Quest.q_ponyranch_1_task3_hint: Get Ponies from Ranch Buildings or ask friends
Quest.q_ponyranch_2_intro: The most amazing thing I can imagine is an entire planet full of unicorns! But you have to start with at least one!
Quest.q_ponyranch_2_dialog_header: If you really think you're gonna get yourself a unicorn, then you're gonna have to pony up! Big time!
Quest.q_ponyranch_2_task2_hint: Make sure everything's ready for the unicorn
Quest.q_prembus_mall_1_intro: Get down to business and give your citizens a Premium Business Mall! It accepts all Premium Businesses!
Quest.q_prembus_mall_1_dialog_header: The Premium Business Mall is going to be the place to be! So let’s go ahead and place it in your city right now!
Quest.q_prembus_mall_1_task2: Place and Complete Premium Business Mall
Quest.q_prembus_mall_1_dialog_finish: Your Premium Business Mall looks great! Start putting Premium Businesses in it and saving space today!
Quest.q_prembus_mall_2_intro: Let’s upgrade your Premium Business Mall so you can increase the number of businesses that it can hold!
Quest.q_prembus_mall_2_dialog_header: Let’s round up some Gold Watches for your Premium Businesses! After that, you’ll be as good as gold!
Quest.q_prembus_mall_2_dialog_finish: I’m pretty exhausted after rounding up those Gold Watches! If you don’t mind, I’m gonna go off the clock!
Quest.q_prembus_mall_3_task2: Upgrade your Premium Business Mall to Level 3
Quest.q_prembus_mall_3_task2_hint: A bigger mall equals more businesses
Quest.q_prembus_mall_3_task3_hint: Use these goods to make premium goods
Quest.q_premium_casino_1_intro: Is Lady Luck on your side? Build the Premium Casino for a chance to win the Mega Jackpot!
Quest.q_premium_casino_1_task3_hint: Collect often for more chances to win the Mega Jackpot
Quest.q_premium_casino_1_dialog_finish: Now that your Premium Casino is up and running, see if you can hit the Mega Jackpot! Get ready to let it ride!
Quest.q_premium_casino_2_dialog_finish: You've done a great job with your new Premium Casino! If you hit the Mega Jackpot, be sure to call me!
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_1_dialog_header: After you place the Eternal Spring Greenhouse in your city, let’s make sure to harvest all the Poblano Chilis!
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_1_task1: Place and Complete the Eternal Spring Greenhouse
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_1_dialog_finish: These heat lamps are coming in handy! Thanks to them, your crops are growing up big and strong!
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_2_dialog_header: Other cities are going to be green with envy when they find out that you have two Eternal Spring Greenhouses!
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_2_task2: Upgrade a Eternal Spring Greenhouse to Level 3
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_2_dialog_finish: Now that you’ve mastered Prickly Pears, you’re really going to be able to beat the desert heat!
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_3_dialog_header: Now that you have all those new premium goods, it’s time for you to supply your businesses with them!
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_3_task1: Upgrade 2 Eternal Spring Greenhouses to Level 3
Quest.q_premium_greenhouse_3_dialog_finish: After upgrading your Eternal Spring Greenhouses, you’re getting exactly what you deserve!
Quest.q_pyg_museum_dialog_header: Not only will the Activity Club benefit the kids in your city, it’ll also raise your city’s population cap!
Quest.q_pyg_museum_task2: Gather Club Sponsorship Signatures from Friends or Businesses
Quest.q_pyg_museum_task3_hint: Build a Custom Car Shop to get cars in your city
Quest.q_pyg_museum2_intro: It’s almost time for the grand opening of the after school Activity Club! We just have a few more things to do!
Quest.q_pyg_museum2_dialog_header: We need to round up some baseballs for the kids and pick up a few science exhibits at the museums!
Quest.q_pyg_museum2_task1: Collect Baseballs from Apartments or Pinnacle Tower
Quest.q_pyg_museum2_task2: Send Tour Buses to Neighbor's Malls
Quest.q_pyg_museum2_dialog_finish: These kids are going to freak out when they see the Activity Club! I can’t wait to see their faces light up!
Quest.q_pyg_museum3_task2: Have Level 3 Mastery of Brussel Sprouts Crop
Quest.q_realtor_1_intro: Rachel's the name and real estate's my game! Your Downtown is gonna sell like hotcakes with me on the job!
Quest.q_realtor_1_dialog_header: In real estate, you must always be closing! And I'm gonna close every deal! Just you watch!
Quest.q_realtor_1_task1_hint: Residences, Businesses, and Decorations all increase Downtown Value
Quest.q_realtor_1_dialog_hint: Increase Downtown Value to expand your Downtown
Quest.q_realtor_1_dialog_finish: I told you I'd close them all! When it comes to real estate, Rachel Rich is the real deal!
Quest.q_realtor_2_task1_hint: The park increases your Downtown Value Limit!
Quest.q_realtor_2_task3_hint: Check the Businesses in the Downtown Marketplace
Quest.q_realtor_3_intro: Your Downtown looks great so far but this is only the beginning! Let's add an expansion to it as well!
Quest.q_realtor_3_dialog_header: You could also stand to add some Residences and Businesses to your Downtown, too! Let's get to it!
Quest.q_realtor_3_task1_hint: A larger Downtown will generate more earnings in your main City
Quest.q_realtor_3_task2_hint: Check the Residences in the Downtown Marketplace
Quest.q_realtor_3_dialog_finish: With me around as your realtor, your Downtown is going to be in good hands! Now, let's talk about my rate.
Quest.q_rec_center_1_intro: Now that summer is coming to a close, let's build a Youth Rec Center for your city's kids to hang out in after school!
Quest.q_rec_center_1_dialog_header: If you build a Youth Rec Center in your city, a lot of kids will be very grateful to you. I'm not kidding!
Quest.q_rec_center_1_task1: Place & Complete the Youth Rec Center
Quest.q_rec_center_1_dialog_finish: The youth in your city is already flocking to the Youth Rec Center! It's already the center of attention!
Quest.q_rec_center_2_dialog_header: Kids are going to need Permission Slips from their parents to stay at the Youth Rec Center after school!
Quest.q_rec_center_3_intro: More and more kids are going to the Youth Rec Center these days! So let's upgrade it one more time!
Quest.q_rec_center_3_dialog_header: The Youth Rec Center is becoming so popular that kids are flying in from New York to check it out!
Quest.q_rec_center_3_dialog_finish: I hope this Youth Rec Center is around for a long time! Otherwise, the kids are going to form a revolt!
Quest.q_roadside_attract_1_intro: You should build some animal inspired Hot Air Balloons so your city can rise to the top! But you'll need some help!
Quest.q_roadside_attract_1_dialog_header: You're going to need a business partner to help you build your Hot Air Balloon! Let's go find one!
Quest.q_roadside_attract_1_task2: Collect Helium from Balloon themed Residences
Quest.q_roadside_attract_2_intro: You can't enjoy your new Hot Air Balloons if you don't have baskets for them! Let's go ask your friends for some!
Quest.q_roadside_attract_2_task1: Ask friends for Hot Air Balloon Baskets
Quest.q_roadside_attract_2_dialog_finish: You must be pretty proud of yourself for scoring that Balloon Badge. You kinda look like a balloon sheriff.
Quest.q_roadside_attract_3_intro: Go find some more Business Partners to help you get your animal inspired Hot Air Balloons off the ground!
Quest.q_roadside_attract_3_dialog_finish: People really love the new Hot Air Balloons in your city! I guess you could say that you're full of hot air!
Quest.q_rollercoaster_expansion_dialog_header: Please consult your doctor before getting on the Epic Swing Ride! It’ll make your heart race!
Quest.q_rollercoaster_expansion_task2_hint: It drops Rare Photos to build the Roller Coaster
Quest.q_rollercoaster_expansion_task1: Ask Friends for 20 Blue Cotton Candy
Quest.q_rollercoaster_expansion_dialog_finish: Your citizens really love the new Epic Swing Ride! I’m getting dizzy just watching all of them ride it!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_1_intro: Get big holiday rewards when you help complete Santa's sleigh and help deliver gifts!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_1_dialog_header: Hard-working Santa is overjoyed to have your help this holiday season! Let's get started!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_1_task1_hint: You can send your sleigh after completing!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_1_task3: Collect Holiday Spirit from Sleigh Buildings
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_1_task3_hint: Holiday spirit to power your sleigh
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_2_intro: Santa is about to embark on a journey around a wintery world and could use your help!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_2_dialog_header: Santa could sure use your help scouting out his holiday routes! Hope you're up for it!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_3_intro: Earn rewards from Santa when you help deliver gifts to the world for the winter holidays!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_3_dialog_header: The weather outside is frightful but you've still got some delights to deliver! Let's go!
Quest.q_santa_sleigh_3_dialog_finish: You've done a fantastic job helping Santa! Enjoy your rewards and break out the cider!
Quest.q_shopaholic_1_intro: I can't wait to shop in your amazing new Downtown! I have so many things I desperately need!
Quest.q_shopaholic_1_task2_hint: Premium Businesses only accept Premium Goods
Quest.q_shopaholic_1_task3_hint: Collect Earnings within 1 day of filling for the best Bonus
Quest.q_shopaholic_2_intro: I need to buy something for my darling husband! Ooh, I wonder if there is a nice suit store nearby!
Quest.q_shopaholic_2_task2_hint: Earnings bonus decreases every day you don't collect
Quest.q_shopaholic_2_task3_hint: Collect immediately after filling for a bonus!
Quest.q_shopaholic_2_dialog_finish: I found his favorite color suit! He's going to love it! This will be the perfect outfit for our anniversary!
Quest.q_shopaholic_3_intro: I really love shopping in your new Downtown! I'm going to sniff out some sales and find something for my friends!
Quest.q_shopaholic_3_task3_hint: Anything you build Downtown increases Value
Quest.q_shopaholic_3_dialog_finish: All that shopping has made me sleepy!  I think I'll take a nap and then see if any of the stores are open late!
Quest.q_showbiz_1_intro: There’s no business like show business! So let’s build Showbiz Inc. and get this show on the road!
Quest.q_showbiz_1_task2_hint: Profits drop when you collect from Showbiz Businesses
Quest.q_showbiz_1_dialog_finish: Wow, Showbiz Inc. is quite the show stopper! I think it’s time we start thinking about our encore!
Quest.q_showbiz_2_task1_hint: Upgrade to get more population and downtown value
Quest.q_showbiz_2_task2_hint: Build businesses with higher profit drop rates to earn more!
Quest.q_showbiz_3_dialog_header: Let me give you a round of applause for all that you’ve done so far. There. Now, let’s get back to work!
Quest.q_showbiz_3_dialog_finish: Wow! Your Downtown citizens are giving us a standing ovation! They like us! They really like us!
Quest.q_ski_lodge_1_intro: My penthouse is lovely but I just want to get away from it all and ski! Won’t you join me?
Quest.q_ski_lodge_1_dialog_finish: This new ski lodge is sure to entice your fun-loving citizens! Warm up the cocoa!
Quest.q_ski_lodge_2_dialog_header: Increase the population so we’ll have even more people to share this lovely lodge with!
Quest.q_ski_lodge_2_task2: Collect Ear Muffs from Holiday Buildings
Quest.q_ski_lodge_3_intro: I hope you’re enjoying this ski lodge as much as I am! Keep improving it for winter rewards!
Quest.q_ski_lodge_3_dialog_header: Brr! It’s still a little chilly up here! Maybe we can heat things up with a cozy fire!
Quest.q_ski_lodge_3_task2: Send 75 Tour Buses to Neighbors' Businesses
Quest.q_ski_lodge_3_dialog_finish: Wow! With our new upscale ski lodge we’ll enjoy all that winter has to offer! Great job!
Quest.q_sky_tower_1_intro: Give your city’s skyline a lift by building the tallest building in the world: Sky Plaza!
Quest.q_sky_tower_1_dialog_header: You’ve got plans for the world’s tallest tower, but how high will your dreams take you?
Quest.q_sky_tower_1_dialog_finish: Your tower is sky-rocketing into the clouds! Will it soar to record-breaking heights?
Quest.q_sky_tower_2_intro: Tourists have started paying attention to your vertical pet-project! Keep building!
Quest.q_sky_tower_2_dialog_header: Another city has come forward claiming their tower is taller, but you’re not done yet!
Quest.q_sky_tower_2_dialog_finish: That’s one for the record-books! You’ve successfully built the world’s tallest tower!
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper_intro: With more and more successful citizens moving to your city, you’re going to need places for them all to live!
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper_dialog_header: Let’s move some of your new citizens into the beautiful new Keegan Tower! It’s filling up fast!
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper_task1: Collect from Taki Tower or Shiny Chateau
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper_task1_hint: These are also becoming quite popular
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper_dialog_finish: Now that you have Keegan Tower in your city, let’s roll out the welcome mat for its brand new residents!
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper2_dialog_header: You’re flying high with your new Keegan Tower! Speaking of flying, let’s collect from New York Airlines!
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper2_task2_hint: Build the Passenger Terminal of your Airport to send passenger planes!
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper2_dialog_finish: This is becoming second nature to you to build these fancy towers! It’s just business as usual in your city!
Quest.qf_elder_skyscraper3_intro: Let’s keep climbing to the top with your Keegan Tower! It could use more Conference Tables in the meeting rooms!
