Quest.q_whale_rescue_2_dialog_header: Oh no! It looks like the mama whale has more babies out there! Let's get her reunited with them quickly!
Quest.q_whale_rescue_2_task2_hint: Expand into water containing the baby whales
Quest.q_whale_rescue_2_dialog_finish: I can't believe it! The mama whale seems to be talking to her babies! I wonder what she's saying to them!
Quest.q_whale_rescue_3_intro: These whales really worked up an appetite today! Let's go get them some barrels of fish so they can be fed!
Quest.q_whale_rescue_3_dialog_header: Let's reunite the mama whale with all four of her babies so this happy family can be together again at last!
Quest.q_whale_rescue_3_dialog_finish: I’m so happy that we were able to help those adorable whales today! Look at ‘em! They’re having so much fun!
Quest.q_what_city_1_dialog_header: I feel like I'm pretty good at reading people. But I can't seem to figure out if you prefer books or blogs!
Quest.q_what_city_1_task2: Collect from a Daily News or Web Marketing Agency
Quest.q_what_city_1_dialog_finish: When it comes to being Modern or Classic, it looks like your city could go either way! On to the next chapter!
Quest.q_what_city_2_dialog_header: I don't know about you, but I like to wear Racing Gloves when I drive. Let's grab some from your friends!
Quest.q_what_city_3_dialog_header: Artists are dreamers who make things to make statements about the past and the future. What's your muse?!
Quest.q_what_city_3_task2: Place Historic Statue or Abstract Art of the Future
Quest.q_what_city_3_dialog_finish: This is going to be a tough one! It looks like you and your citizens have very eclectic tastes!
Quest.q_what_city_4_intro: How do you like to have fun? Do you like learning about history, playing board games, or what?! Tell me!
Quest.q_what_city_4_dialog_header: It's not whether you win or lose, it's how you play the game! What kind of games do you like to play?!
Quest.q_what_city_4_task2: Place Drawing Kids or Dancing Kids
Quest.q_what_city_4_dialog_finish: Your city has shown that variety is the spice of life! But you seem to be leaning in a certain direction!
Quest.q_what_city_5_intro: Your taste in music has to tip your hand! Now we'll definitely figure out whether you're Modern or Classic!
Quest.q_what_city_5_task2: Collect from 60s Architecture House or Modern House
Quest.q_what_city_5_dialog_finish: A lot of people have switched over to digital music. But I don't think I'll ever change. How about you?!
Quest.q_what_city_6_intro: I can tell that you really love watching movies. But how do you like to enjoy them? At home or in the theater?!
Quest.q_what_city_6_task2: Collect from Art House Theater or 3D Mega Plex
Quest.q_what_city_6_dialog_finish: I really enjoyed getting to know you and your city's personality! You're getting rave reviews from me!
Quest.q_wildcard_1_dialog_header: Build your Rainbow center to collect Rainbow Duct tape to finish any of your existing buildings!
Quest.q_wildcard_1_task1_hint: Rainbow duct tapes can be used to complete any building!
Quest.q_wildcard_1_dialog_finish: With your city’s new Rainbow Part Center, you’ve really stacked the deck in your favor!
Quest.q_wildcard_2_intro: Upgrade your Rainbow Part Center so you can finish even more of your city’s buildings! Go Now !!
Quest.q_wildcard_2_dialog_header: Upgrade your Rainbow Part Center so you can finish even more of your city’s buildings! Go Now !!
Quest.q_wildcard_2_task1: Upgrade Rainbow Part Center to Level 3
Quest.q_wildcard_2_task1_hint: Increases your rainbow duct tape inventory
Quest.q_wildcard_2_dialog_finish: You seemed to find a lot of yellow and blue duct tape out of the blue! That’s going to come in really handy!
Quest.q_wildcard_3_dialog_header: Let’s upgrade your Rainbow Part Center again so you can finish even more of your city’s buildings!
Quest.q_wildcard_3_task1: Upgrade Rainbow Part Center to Level 5
Quest.q_wildcard_3_task1_hint: Increases your rainbow duct tape inventory by 5
Quest.q_windfarm_upgrade_1_intro: Upgrade your Wind Farm! It will increase your city’s Energy Cap by 7! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.q_windfarm_upgrade_1_dialog_header: Upgrade your Wind Farm to Level 2! It will increase your Energy cap by 6!  Let’s get started!
Quest.q_windfarm_upgrade_1_task1: Expand and Build your Wind Farm
Quest.q_windfarm_upgrade_1_dialog_finish: You were smart to upgrade your Wind Farm! Let’s upgrade it again and give your city an energy boost!
Quest.q_windfarm_upgrade_3_intro: Now that your Wind Farm is upgraded, let’s balance out your efforts by taking care of your crops! Let’s go!
Quest.q_windfarm_upgrade_3_task2: Harvest Crops from any Level 2 Greenhouse
Quest.q_windfarm_upgrade_3_dialog_finish: After upgrading your Wind Farm and watering your crops, you really went on a power trip! Great job!
Quest.q_winter_castle_intro: For years, I've been designing the perfect place to come in from the cold! Behold, the Winter Castle!
Quest.q_winter_castle_task1_hint: Build quickly to get the premium version!
Quest.q_winter_castle_task2_hint: If you haven't placed the Ice Tower yet, you can find it in your inventory
Quest.q_winter_castle_task3_hint: Search for Winter items in the Build Menu!
Quest.q_winter_castle_dialog_finish: The Winter Castle has turned your city into a Winter Wonderland! I've really outdone myself!
Quest.q_winter_wonderland_2_dialog_header: The only thing that could make this day any better is some fruit cake! A holiday favorite!
Quest.q_winter_wonderland_2_dialog_finish: What a great time! After all this fun, I’m gonna sleep like a log! But we’re not done yet!
Quest.q_winter_wonderland_3_intro: The day is nearly done but we’re still having a fun time enjoying the winter atmosphere!
Quest.q_winter_wonderland_3_dialog_header: Let’s visit some workplaces and encourage people to get outside and enjoy the snow!
Quest.q_winter_wonderland_3_task2_hint: Prep for the busiest time of year
Quest.q_winter_wonderland_3_dialog_finish: Thanks for inviting me to enjoy the wintertime in your city! Now, who wants fruit cake?!
Quest.q_wonder_great_pyramid_goal: GOAL: BUILD THE GREAT PYRAMID WONDER!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_1_intro: It’s time for you to build the Zoning Permit Center so you can expand your city even more! Come on! Let’s get started!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_1_dialog_header: Before we place the Zoning Permit Center, let’s collect parts to build it! This will really help you out!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_1_task2_hint: Get Zoning Permits & expand your city
Quest.q_zoningpermit_1_dialog_finish: Now that your city has a Zoning Permit Center, your citizens are demanding that you expand!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_2_intro: It’s time for you to get in the zone and upgrade your Zoning Permit Center! It allows you to print your own zoning permits!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_2_dialog_header: In order to get out the message about Zoning Permits, you’re going to need some Permit Ink Bottles!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_2_task2_hint: You’re like a genie in a bottle
Quest.q_zoningpermit_2_dialog_finish: The sun’s shining and it looks like this is a great day to print even more Zoning Permits! Don’t you agree?!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_3_intro: Ever since you’ve built your Zoning Permit Center, it’s been your city’s center of attention! Let’s go collect!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_3_dialog_header: I know you already have a lot on your plate but you really need to find some more Permit Printing Plates!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_3_task2: Ask friends for Permit Printing Plates
Quest.q_zoningpermit_3_dialog_finish: Hey, wake up! This is not time to zone out! You still have a little bit more to do on your Zoning Permit Center!
Quest.q_zoningpermit_4_dialog_header: Let’s keep the momentum going with your new Zoning Permit Center and go collect Permit Printing Rolls!
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_1_task2_hint: This will help you hold on to the Pins
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_1_dialog_finish: Now that you have a Mascot House in your city, even more Mascots will appear! Which means even more Pins!
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_2_intro: Shhh! If you’re very quiet, you can hear a pin drop! Come on! Let’s go find more pins to add to your collection!
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_2_dialog_header: Let’s roll out the welcome mat over at the Mascot House so you can upgrade it and house more Mascots!
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_2_dialog_finish: You’ve found a lot of Pins so far! But let’s find even more so you can give yourself a bit of a cushion!
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_3_intro: Let’s keep hunting for Mascots so you can complete all the Pin collections and win the grand prize! Let’s go!
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_3_dialog_header: I can’t believe how many Pins you’ve found thus far! Upgrade your Mascot House so you can find even more!
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_3_task2_hint: Collect the Tennis Court Pin to be awarded this building
Quest.qf_CVG_pins_3_dialog_finish: Congrats on beating the Mascots at their own game! Hats off to you! Or should I say..heads off to you?!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_1_intro: You should build a Cargo Aircraft Carrier! It’ll look good out on the open seas!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_1_task1_hint: Place on the water to earn 3x goods and 2x mastery from Aircraft Carrier planes
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_1_task3_hint: Finish the Vacation Terminal of your Airport
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_1_dialog_finish: Your Aircraft Carrier looks good so far! It’ll come in handy when these planes need to make a water landing!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_2_intro: Upgrade your Cargo Aircraft Carrier to send 2 planes! Each plane earns 3x the goods and 2x the mastery!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_2_dialog_header: Upgrade your Cargo Aircraft Carrier to send 2 planes! Each plane earns 3x the goods and 2x the mastery!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_2_task1_hint: Send 2 planes from your Aircraft Carrier and earn 3x the goods and 2x the mastery!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_2_task2: Send Cargo Planes from the Cargo Aircraft Carrier 3 times
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_2_task2_hint: Sending cargo planes from the Carrier gives double mastery!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_2_task3_hint: Planes from the Carrier give Double Mastery
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_2_dialog_finish: Looks like we got a stowaway! It seems that one of your city’s pigeons hitched a ride on the Carrier!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_3_intro: The more you upgrade your Cargo Aircraft Carrier, the more Cargo Planes you can send! What are you waiting for? Let’s go!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_3_dialog_header: Upgrade your Cargo Aircraft Carrier to send 3 planes! Each plane earns 3x the goods and 2x the mastery!
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_3_task1_hint: Upgrade to send more Cargo Planes
Quest.qf_aircraft_carrier_3_dialog_finish: Based on what I’ve seen today, you were born to be on the sea! Maybe you’ll carry my torch when I retire!
Quest.qf_airports_1_intro: I’ve got high expectations for you! It’s time you build an airport so you can bring in more goods for your city!
Quest.qf_airports_1_task1: Complete the Cargo Terminal of your Airport
Quest.qf_airports_1_task2_hint: Purchase Cargo Planes from the Build Menu
Quest.qf_airports_1_dialog_finish: Your airport looks great so far! But we’ve got a lot of work to do. There’s no place to go but up!
Quest.qf_airports_2_goal: GOAL: SEND PLANES TO MASTER ROUTES!
Quest.qf_airports_2_intro: Running an airport isn’t easy but I know you can do it! We just need to make sure we have everything we need!
Quest.qf_airports_2_task1_hint: Master London by unloading London Cargo Planes!
Quest.qf_airports_2_task3_hint: Use your extra goods to supply businesses!
Quest.qf_airports_2_dialog_finish: Your airport is going to revolutionize how your city operates! It’s time to spread your wings and fly!
Quest.qf_airports_3_intro: Your airport is up and running and your city is more productive than ever before! You must be walking on air right now!
Quest.qf_airports_3_task3_hint: Buy more residences to increase population!
Quest.qf_airports_3_dialog_finish: Your airport is running like a well oiled machine! Congratulations! You must be very proud!
Quest.qf_airports_4_intro: One great thing about flying to different cities to collect cargo is that you get to see the world at the same time!
Quest.qf_airports_4_dialog_header: As you collect shipments from destinations, you unlock great souvenirs from places around the world!
Quest.qf_airports_4_task3_hint: Use the new good supply to run your Hotels!
Quest.qf_airports_4_dialog_finish: Wow, time flies when you’re having fun! Well, it’s been a pleasure being your wingman! See you soon!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_1_task1: Complete the Passenger Terminal of your Airport
Quest.qf_airports_v2_1_task2: Complete 2 Airport Extensions in your city
Quest.qf_airports_v2_1_task2_hint: Extensions let you place more planes! Place them right next to your Airport.
Quest.qf_airports_v2_1_dialog_finish: Flying to Rome is just the beginning! Who knows what other cities you'll have a chance to visit now?!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_intro: Tourists from around the world can't wait to fly to your city! But you still have some work to do before they arrive!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_task1: Master Toronto Passenger Airlines to 1 Star
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_task1_hint: Master Toronto by collecting passenger planes from there
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_task2: Collect 25 Plane Tickets from community buildings or Ask friends!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_task2_hint: You can ask friends for Plane Tickets or collect them from community buildings!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_task3: Collect 20 Airplane Meals from residences or Ask friends!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_task3_hint: You can ask friends for Airplane Meals or collect them from residences!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_2_dialog_finish: Those airplane meals are delicious! This airport is really going to be your city's meal ticket!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_3_dialog_header: I say we start with one of the most beautiful cities in the world! Let's go to Toronto!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_3_task1: Master Toronto Passenger Airlines to 2 Stars
Quest.qf_airports_v2_3_task1_hint: Master Toronto by collecting Toronto Passenger Planes!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_3_task2_hint: Click on a Cargo Plane to send it to a route!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_4_intro: As you master routes to 3 Stars, you unlock great souvenirs from places around the world!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_4_dialog_header: Let's head back to Toronto and see some old friends! I bet they'll be very excited and surprised to see us!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_4_task1: Master Toronto Passenger Airline to 3 Stars
Quest.qf_airports_v2_4_task2_hint: Tourists fill up your Hotels quicker!
Quest.qf_airports_v2_4_task3_hint: Click neighbors’ Hotels to check in and get VIP status!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_1_dialog_header: Traveling with your friends is going to be fun! Especially since it will help you earn more XP than ever before!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_1_task1: Complete the Vacation Terminal of your Airport
Quest.qf_airports_v3_1_task1_hint: Click the Vacation Terminal to get started!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_1_task3: Join 10 friends on their Vacation flights
Quest.qf_airports_v3_2_dialog_header: Ask friends to join your Vacation travels to earn more XP!  Remember, no friend left behind!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_2_task1_hint: Send a plane and ask friends! More friends equal more XP!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_2_task2_hint: Vacation Planes give you more XP than ever before!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_2_dialog_finish: I would hand you the travel agenda but it's hidden. No, seriously. I have no idea where it is!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_3_intro: Congratulations! Your Vacation Terminal is up and running! Pretty soon, your entire Airport will be complete!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_3_dialog_header: Vacation Planes give you XP and the more friends that join you the more you can earn! Enjoy your flight!
Quest.qf_airports_v3_3_dialog_finish: With all the new additions that you've made to your Airport, you must be floating on air! Be careful up there!
Quest.qf_airports_v4_1_task2_hint: Click on the Private Jet Terminal to send Private Jets!
Quest.qf_airports_v4_1_task3_hint: Private Jets can return with V.I.P.s! Click on a V.I.P. to start the bonus!
Quest.qf_airports_v4_1_dialog_finish: Now that you have a Private Jet Terminal at your Airport, you're going to enjoy flying even more!
Quest.qf_airports_v4_2_task1_hint: Master a V.I.P. Charter by sending Private Jets to that destination!
Quest.qf_airports_v4_2_task3: Collect 20 Cargo Manifests from Cargo Planes or Ask Friends
Quest.qf_airports_v4_2_task3_hint: Unload Cargo Planes for a chance of collecting Cargo Manifests!
Quest.qf_airports_v4_2_dialog_finish: Now that you've unloaded your Vacation Planes and Cargo Planes, you deserve a vacation!
Quest.qf_amex_quest_1_intro: Zynga Serve Rewards hopes this Garage Sale will help your City find some hidden treasures.
Quest.qf_amex_quest_1_task3_hint: Learn more about Zynga Serve Rewards coming soon to your City.
Quest.qf_amex_quest_2_goal: GOAL: EARN A SERVE MOBILE HOME!
Quest.qf_amex_quest_2_task1_hint: It's time to hit the open road in our Mobile Home
Quest.qf_amex_quest_2_task3_hint: We can visit our friends during the trip
Quest.qf_amex_quest_3_intro: Zynga Serve Rewards hopes this Cyber Café will keep your City connected.
Quest.qf_amex_quest_3_task1_hint: Scope out the latest technology for our Cyber Café
Quest.qf_amex_quest_3_task2_hint: Our citizens will need the finest coffee
Quest.qf_amex_quest_3_task3_hint: We can stock up on supplies to make snacks
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs_dialog_header: Your citizens have heard that Dogs the musical is coming to town! Let's get to work and open the theater!
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs_task1_hint: Place and complete the theater by casting actors, getting props and rehearsing!
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs_task2: Collect from London Liner Ship Routes
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs_task2_hint: This show has toured the world
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs_dialog_finish: Let's see if we can teach an old dog new tricks! Come on! Let's start spreading the word about the hit show, Dogs!
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs2_intro: The cast of Dogs is ready to sing their hearts out! Let's get them some voice lessons and finish the theater for them!
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs2_dialog_header: The choreography in this show is spectacular! Let's get the cast some dance shoes so they can rehearse!
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs2_task1_hint: Complete the theater by casting actors, getting props and rehearsing!
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs3_dialog_header: Programs! Get your programs! The buzz about this show is really heating up! I can't wait to finally see it!
Quest.qf_broadway_dogs3_dialog_finish: The critics love the show! They're calling Dogs the pick of the litter! Looks like the dog's are out!
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm_intro: You're really becoming the toast of Broadway! Everyone is excited about your new show, Fantasm!
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm_task3_hint: This show is an international sensation
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm_dialog_finish: Fantasm has a few songs that have extremely high notes! I hope they can hit them!
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm2_dialog_header: Just so you know, I'll be waiting in the wings if any of the actors get stage fright! I know all their roles!
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm2_task3_hint: Other shows can't hold a candle to this one
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm2_dialog_finish: Opening night is here! I just wanted to say break a leg! But maybe saying break a chandelier makes more sense!
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm3_intro: Congratulations! Opening night of Fantasm is a huge success! You should take a bow!
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm3_dialog_header: The audience loves the actor playing the Fantasm! He should remove his mask and let us see who he really is!
Quest.qf_broadway_fantasm3_dialog_finish: During the show, the audience was on the edges of their seats. But now they're giving you a standing ovation!
Quest.qf_broadway_tiger_dialog_header: If The Tiger Prince is a success, you're going to get the tiger's share of the credit! Come on! Let's get to work!
Quest.qf_broadway_tiger_dialog_finish: Now that you've found some amazing drummers, we're one step closer to performing The Tiger Prince!
Quest.qf_broadway_tiger2_dialog_header: All eyes are on your new show! It looks like you're ready to claw your way to the top of Broadway!
Quest.qf_broadway_tiger2_task1_hint: There are no small parts, only small actors
Quest.qf_broadway_tiger3_intro: The Tiger Prince is a huge hit! People love all the amazing costumes, puppets, and music! Congratulations!
Quest.qf_broadway_tiger3_dialog_finish: What an amazing show! From the looks of things, The Tiger Prince will be running on Broadway for a long time!
Quest.qf_business_district_1_dialog_header: A lot of people say that I’m gifted when it comes to making money. And I would agree with those people.
Quest.qf_business_district_1_dialog_finish: Your Business District is off to a great start! Everyone loves it. But for me, it’s just business as usual.
Quest.qf_business_district_2_intro: I know I should probably mind my own business but I think you should collect from your businesses soon.
Quest.qf_business_district_2_dialog_header: Any good businessman knows how to plant his feet, look you square in the eye, and get what he wants!
Quest.qf_business_district_2_dialog_finish: I have to admit that you’ve really surprised me so far. You’re really taking care of business out there!
Quest.qf_business_district_3_intro: Let’s build up your citizens’ credit by giving out Platinum Cards. I don’t know about you but I always have mine with me.
Quest.qf_business_district_3_task2: Build floor 3 of the Business District
Quest.qf_business_district_3_task3: Build floor 3 of the Premium Business District
Quest.qf_business_district_3_dialog_finish: Your Business District is booming so far. At this rate, one day you’ll be almost half as rich as I am!
Quest.qf_lovecars_intro: My wife, Louise, loves her car. But it's falling apart! I think I'll get her a new one as a Valentine's Day gift!
Quest.qf_lovecars_dialog_header: I think her heart will skip a beat if she sees that I bought her a new car! Her old one barely starts anymore!
Quest.qf_lovecars2_task1: Collect 35 Giant Bows from residences or friends
Quest.qf_lovecars2_task3: Collect 10 times from a Level 2 or Level 3 Fashion Center
Quest.qf_lovecars2_dialog_hint: Complete all 3 goals to earn the Love Shack residence (adds up to 680 population).
Quest.qf_lovecars2_dialog_finish: That car was really nice but I'm not sure she'd like it. I'm starting to feel pretty neutral about all this!
Quest.qf_lovecars3_dialog_finish: She loves her new car! They're a perfect fit for each other! Kind of reminds me of her and me!
Quest.qf_central_park_dialog_header: I love being able to escape the hectic pace of Downtown and enjoy the natural beauty of Central Park!
Quest.qf_central_park_task2_hint: Central Park is getting better and better
Quest.qf_central_park2_intro: One of my favorite things about Central Park is that you can get in some exercise while you’re here on your lunch break!
Quest.qf_central_park2_dialog_header: Sometimes I just feel like having a hot dog at the park with my friends!
Quest.qf_central_park2_task2_hint: I can’t believe how much Downtown has grown
Quest.qf_central_park3_dialog_header: Oops! I forgot my bicyle! If I don’t find one soon, I’m going to go back home!
Quest.qf_central_park3_dialog_finish: It was so fun seeing all my friends in Central Park today! I think I’m going to make this a daily habit!
Quest.qf_chinese_arcade_dialog_header: 2012 is the Year of the Dragon so let's celebrate by putting on a huge parade for your city!
Quest.qf_chinese_arcade_dialog_finish: The dragon parade was a huge success! What a great way to kick off the new year!
Quest.qf_chinese_booth_dialog_header: Collect red envelopes from the Red Envelope store, to trade in for exclusive items at the Chinese New Year parade.
Quest.qf_chinese_booth_task1_hint: Collect Red Envelopes from harvesting the Red Envelope Store
Quest.qf_chinese_booth_task2_hint: It’s time to harvest the Red Envelope Store
Quest.qf_chinese_booth_dialog_finish: Having these golden dragons and the red envelope store is going to bring you a very prosperous new year!
Quest.qf_christmasday_intro: You’ve been good all year long and now it’s time for you to see what Santa has brought you!
Quest.qf_christmasday_dialog_header: Well, what are you waiting for?! There’s no time like the present! Go ahead! Rip them open!
Quest.qf_christmasday_dialog_finish: I hope you like your presents! You’re going to need a big basket to carry all of them home!
Quest.qf_country_club_intro: Your citizens are lining up to become members of the new Country Club! Let’s complete it so we can start signing them up!
Quest.qf_country_club_dialog_header: The Country Club is going to look great! But that’s par for the course in your city! You always impress!
Quest.qf_country_club_dialog_finish: No, seriously. He’s very good. I was wondering if we could maybe trade caddies when we play golf today!
Quest.qf_country_club2_intro: You’ve spoiled your citizens for a long time now. So let’s pamper them even more with a fancy Country Club!
Quest.qf_country_club2_dialog_header: One of the most fun things to do at the Country Club is to play a little racquetball! Come on! Let’s play!
Quest.qf_country_club2_task3_hint: Some members like to stay overnight
Quest.qf_country_club2_dialog_finish: Your Country Club is attracting a lot of avid golfers! You’ve really scored a hole in one with your citizens!
Quest.qf_country_club3_dialog_header: The members of the Country Club like to mix business with pleasure. So send them out on a Private Jet!
Quest.qf_country_club3_dialog_finish: By the looks of this club, you adhere to the Golden Rule! And apparently you want to be treated very well!
Quest.qf_customres1_task3_hint: Build and personalize as many Custom Homes as you want!
Quest.qf_customres1_dialog_finish: You can build more Custom Homes to personalize your city!
Quest.qf_customres2_intro: You can make each Custom Home unique!
Quest.qf_customres2_dialog_header: I designed the floors to look great no matter which one you choose!
Quest.qf_customres2_task1_hint: You can find Custom Homes in the Build Menu under Housing under Custom!
Quest.qf_customres2_task3: Build one Custom Home to 5 Floors
Quest.qf_customres2_task3_hint: On the fifth floor, you can choose a custom roof!
Quest.qf_customresV2_1_task1: Place 1 Modern Home and build a second floor!
Quest.qf_customresV2_1_task1_hint: Choose the floors you want and add up to 4400 population to your city
Quest.qf_customresV2_1_dialog_finish: Build more Custom Homes to personalize your city!
Quest.qf_customresV2_2_dialog_header: Design Custom Homes just the way you want them! Choose the floors you want and add up to 4400 population to your city
Quest.qf_customresV2_2_task1_hint: You can find Modern Homes by searching for 'Custom' in the build menu!
Quest.qf_customresV2_2_task2: Gather 40 Doormats from Modern Homes or Ask Friends
Quest.qf_customresV2_2_task3: Build one new Modern Home to 5 Floors
Quest.qf_deco_mode1_intro: People from all over the world are excited to finally visit your city! But first, you need to open a Passport Office!
Quest.qf_deco_mode1_dialog_header: Use Storage space to help you decorate!  You can put items in Storage while you redecorate your city!
Quest.qf_deco_mode1_task2_hint: Use the Move tool to select the Shade Tree and click on an empty Storage Slot.
Quest.qf_deco_mode1_task3_hint: Click on the Shade Tree to take it out of Storage.
Quest.qf_deco_mode1_dialog_finish: Use the new Decoration Menu to easily redecorate your city!
Quest.qf_deco_mode2_goal: GOAL: EARN 30 MORE (80 TOTAL) STORAGE SLOTS!
Quest.qf_deco_mode2_task1: Collect 30 Tarps by unloading Shipping Routes or Ask friends!
Quest.qf_deco_mode2_task2_hint: Visit neighbors and collect rent from their residences!
Quest.qf_deco_mode3_task1: Collect 40 Packing Peanuts from collecting Businesses or Ask Friends!
Quest.qf_deco_mode3_task2_hint: Build new housing from the Build Menu for population!
Quest.qf_deco_mode3_task3: Send 50 Tour Buses to neighbor's cities
Quest.qf_deco_mode3_task3_hint: Visit neighbors and click on their businesses to send Tour Buses!
Quest.qf_deco_mode4_task2: Collect 30 Suitcases from unloading Passenger Planes!
Quest.qf_deco_mode4_task2_hint: Unlock and build the Passenger Terminal at level 31!
Quest.qf_deco_mode4_dialog_finish: You have earned all 150 Storage Slots!  Use Storage to keep your city freshly decorated!
Quest.qf_deco_scenes_dialog_header: Adding a beautiful European Residential Scene has never been easier.
Quest.qf_deco_scenes_task1_hint: Scene's are found in the market under decorations
Quest.qf_deco_scenes_task2: Add a Residence to the European Residential Scene
Quest.qf_deco_scenes_task2_hint: Click on an empty plot in the scene to add a building
Quest.qf_deco_scenes_2_task1_hint: Italian Residences can be found in the specials section in the market
Quest.qf_deco_scenes_2_task2_hint: Clicking Show Me will open up the market
Quest.qf_deco_scenes_2_dialog_finish: Great job, your European area looks beautiful!  Celebrate with rewards.
Quest.qf_detective_game_1_dialog_header: If you find all the clues and solve the mystery, you'll unlock mysterious prizes! Come on! Let's get going!
Quest.qf_detective_game_1_task2_hint: Find clues by collecting from businesses, residences, and community buildings!
Quest.qf_detective_game_1_task3_hint: Community Buildings have a high chance of dropping clues!
Quest.qf_detective_game_1_dialog_finish: This is fun, isn't it?! I spy with my little eyes a clue not too far from here! Follow me! I think I found a clue!
Quest.qf_detective_game_2_task1: Upgrade the Detective Training Center to Level 3
Quest.qf_detective_game_2_task1_hint: Click on the Detective Training Center to find the Upgrade Menu!
Quest.qf_detective_game_2_dialog_finish: Wow, you did an amazing job solving all the clues! You turned out to be quite the private detective after all!
Quest.qf_districts_1_dialog_header: The districts will help you store businesses, residences, and community buildings all in one place!
Quest.qf_districts_1_task2_hint: Harvest crops for a chance to collect a Banner
Quest.qf_districts_1_task3: Upgrade your European District Mall to Floor 2
Quest.qf_districts_1_task3_hint: Hint: Fill Floor 1, and unlock Floor 2
Quest.qf_districts_1_dialog_finish: With the addition of districts, your city is going to have a banner year! The European District looks great!
Quest.qf_districts_2_intro: Now that you have the European District in your city, let's expand its storage make it stand out!
Quest.qf_districts_2_dialog_header: Not only should we decorate the European District, we should upgrade it as well! Let's get started!
Quest.qf_districts_2_task2_hint: Fill the first block and unlock the second
Quest.qf_districts_2_task3: Go on 30 neighbor visits to show your European pride!
Quest.qf_districts_2_dialog_finish: The success of the European District makes me think I should come up a bunch of other districts as well!
Quest.qf_easter_task2_hint: Bunnies hide eggs in buildings close to them
Quest.qf_easter_task3_hint: Egg hunt buildings have a chance of dropping carrots
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_intro: I heard that there were a lot of sales going on in your city right now so I thought I’d go out and buy a few hundred things!
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_dialog_header: Let me swing by the bank so I can tell them not to put a hold on my credit card when they see all these purchases!
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_task3_hint: I love shopping in the Big Apple
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_dialog_finish: I’m ready to pound the pavement and hit all the sales! I just hope the stores don’t run out before I get there!
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_2_intro: I like to check out the Thrift shop to see if they have any mint condition vintage clothes I like! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_2_dialog_header: All of these shopping bags are heavy! Let’s jump in a cab so we don’t miss out on the other sales!
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_2_dialog_finish: I hope all of these dresses I’ve bought fit me! I’m not trying them on in the stores so I don’t waste time!
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_3_dialog_header: Wow, your city is bustling with shoppers today! I wonder if any of them recognize me?!
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_3_task1_hint: I bet everyone’s here for the sales
Quest.qf_elder_belladay_3_task2: Collect Receipts from Toy Tower or Song Bird Pet Shop
Quest.qf_elder_citysign_dialog_header: Not only do I want to meet all of these celebrities, but I want their autographs, too! I like to collect them!
Quest.qf_elder_citysign_dialog_finish: I’ve been walking around for quite a while and I’ve met a lot of famous people! But I still have more to meet!
Quest.qf_elder_citysign2_dialog_finish: I really deserve a hand for meeting all these celebrities! And for getting such a beautiful manicure!
Quest.qf_elder_citysign3_intro: If you really want to be a household name, you have to invite other household names over to your house for a party!
Quest.qf_elder_citysign3_dialog_finish: Now that I’ve met every celebrity in town, I can claim to be the celebrity with the most famous friends!
Quest.qf_elder_gala_intro: I plan on making quite a big entrance at the Red Carpet Gala! And I plan on making it in a fancy stretch limousine!
Quest.qf_elder_gala_dialog_header: Honestly, I could pay for the limo by myself but I’d rather get a few friends to chip in! Let’s go visit them!
Quest.qf_elder_gala_dialog_finish: It helps to have a few powerful friends from time to time. Good thing most of my friends are big stars!
Quest.qf_elder_gala2_dialog_header: When I step out of the backseat of my limo, I’m going to be the toast of the town. I hope the paparazzi see me!
Quest.qf_elder_gala2_task1: Collect from Rio Planes at the Passenger Terminal
Quest.qf_elder_gala2_task2_hint: I need to eat before the Gala
Quest.qf_elder_gala2_dialog_finish: I love my new suit! Now I’m definitely going to catch the paparazzi’s eye when I step out of my limo tonight!
Quest.qf_elder_gala3_intro: It’s time for me to finally make my big entrance at the Red Carpet Gala! The limo driver and I are ready to roll!
Quest.qf_elder_gala3_task3_hint: Good thing I looked in the mirror before I left
Quest.qf_elder_gala3_dialog_finish: The Red Carpet Gala was amazing! Now if only I could wake my driver up from his backseat nap so I can go home!
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_1_intro: With the rapid expansion of your city and its continued development, it can be easy to forget all its natural beauty!
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_1_task3_hint: This is a protected home for wildlife
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_1_dialog_finish: Wow, you really have great instincts when it comes to finding the natural beauty in your city!
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_2_intro: When nature calls, you have to answer! So let’s go out there and see what else we can do to improve your city!
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_2_dialog_finish: Your city is already naturally beautiful but adding the Cherry Blossom Trees is the cherry on top!
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_3_dialog_header: You should completely upgrade your Natural Wonder so you can receive its full benefits in your city!
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_3_task2_hint: Your city is becoming a wonderland
Quest.qf_elder_naturalwonder_3_dialog_finish: You did a fantastic job adding to the natural beauty of your city! It really seemed like second nature to you!
Quest.qf_elder_tinsel_dialog_finish: With the Big Gala coming up and the opening of the Tinseltown Café, you’ve really got a lot on your plate!
Quest.qf_elder_tinsel2_intro: Since a lot of the Tinseltown Café clientele will be celebrities, I think we can raise the prices of some of the entrees!
Quest.qf_elder_tinsel2_dialog_header: One of the hottest dishes at the Tinseltown Cafe will be my famous panini! I better alert the press!
Quest.qf_elder_tinsel2_task3_hint: Two of my favorite ingredients and rock bands
Quest.qf_elder_tinsel2_dialog_finish: It looks like the celebrities love all of my special desserts! Nothing tastes better than sweet success!
Quest.qf_elder_tinsel3_dialog_header: If the Tinseltown Café keeps doing as well as it’s doing now, it may well be your meal ticket for a long time!
Quest.qf_elder_tinsel3_dialog_finish: Every night at the Tinseltown Café, I see you rubbing elbows with celebrities! Savor these moments!
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_1_intro: Planning weddings is big business! And that’s why I’m opening Wedding Planners Inc. in your city!
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_1_dialog_header: You may not believe me, but I’m a hopeless romantic. And I know a thing or two about planning weddings.
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_1_task1: Ask friends for Wedding Check Lists
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_1_dialog_finish: The first time I got a paycheck, it was love at first sight. And I think I’m having déjà vu right now!
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_2_dialog_header: To stay competitive in the wedding planning business, we need to upgrade Wedding Planners Inc.!
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_3_dialog_header: Brides are flying into town from all over! Some just arrived from New York just moments ago!
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_3_task2: Collect from New York Passenger Jets
Quest.qf_elder_weddingplanner_3_dialog_finish: We really cleaned up at the bridal convention! I can’t wait to walk down the aisle... at the bank!
Quest.qf_elder_wondercraft_2_intro: Your Wonder is doing big business so far! Let’s upgrade it so you can get even bigger bonuses! Come on!
Quest.qf_elder_wondercraft_2_dialog_header: In order to upgrade your Wonder, you’re going to need to collect from Paris or Sydney Shipping Routes!
Quest.qf_elder_wondercraft_2_task2: Collect from Paris or Sydney Shipping Routes
Quest.qf_elder_wondercraft_2_dialog_finish: Congratulations! Your upgraded Wonder really looks fantastic! You really are working wonders!
Quest.qf_elder_wondercraft_3_intro: People are lining up to see your fully upgraded Wonder! They’re going to lose their minds once you activate it!
Quest.qf_elder_wondercraft_3_dialog_header: I’ve got wonderful news for you! The Wonder’s success is boosting the business of your Wonder Businesses!
Quest.qf_electric_company_intro: Let's build the Electric company so you can increase your energy cap to power your city! Let's Get started!
Quest.qf_electric_company_dialog_header: Having an Electric Company in your city will increase its energy cap! Come on! Let’s get started on it!
Quest.qf_electric_company_dialog_finish: Now that the electrical currents are flowing at your Electric Company, you’re up to date on current events!
Quest.qf_electric_company2_intro: Let’s upgrade your Electric Company to Level 2 so you can unlock your energy cap! Come on! Let’s get to work!
Quest.qf_electric_company2_task1: Upgrade your Electric Company to level 2
Quest.qf_electric_company2_task3: Supply your Electric Company 3 consecutive days
Quest.qf_electric_company3_intro: Let’s keep upgrading your Electric Company so we can instantly unlock your energy cap! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.qf_electric_company3_dialog_header: Now that you’ve upgraded your Electric Company, people are flocking to your city to become a power player!
Quest.qf_electric_company3_task1: Upgrade your Electric Company to level 3
Quest.qf_electric_company3_task2_hint: You have a lot of energy to spend now
Quest.qf_electric_company3_task3: Supply your Electric Company 5 consecutive days
Quest.qf_electric_company3_dialog_finish: Your citizens are so happy about their new Electric Company that they’re about to do the electric slide!
Quest.qf_electric_company4_task1: Upgrade your Electric Company to level 4
Quest.qf_electric_company4_task3: Supply Your Electric Company 7 consecutive days
Quest.qf_electric_company4_task3_hint: Maintain your Energy Cap so you can spend more energy
Quest.qf_embassy_japan_intro: Japan would like to open an embassy in your city!
Quest.qf_embassy_japan_task2_hint: Collect from the Passport Office and Tokyo Cargo Route to earn Japan Passport Stamps
Quest.qf_embassy_japan_dialog_finish: With your new Japanese Embassy, your city now resembles the Land of the Rising Sun! What an honor!
Quest.qf_embassy_spain_dialog_header: Spain has given your city the stamp of approval! You’re going to reap some great rewards from the embassy!
Quest.qf_embassy_spain_task1: Place the Spanish Embassy & collect 10 Spanish Passports Stamps
Quest.qf_embassy_spain_task3: Redeem Spanish Passport Stamps at the Spanish Embassy for a Reward
Quest.qf_embassy_spain_dialog_finish: With your new Spanish Embassy, a lot of your citizens are going to have Spain on the brain very soon!
Quest.qf_embassy_uk_task1_hint: Redeem UK Passport Stamps at the Embassy for limited edition rewards!
Quest.qf_eurostadium_intro: Your city is filled with lots of soccer fans so I say we use our heads and figure out how to give them a European Soccer Stadium!
Quest.qf_eurostadium_task3: Collect from a Level 2 or higher Television Tower
Quest.qf_eurostadium_dialog_finish: Now that you have a state of the art European Soccer Stadium, let’s prepare it for its first ever soccer match!
Quest.qf_eurostadium2_dialog_header: You should foot the bill and make sure the players have everything their hearts desire! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.qf_eurostadium3_dialog_header: The soccer teams are from all over the world. So fans from all over the world are attending the big game!
Quest.qf_eurostadium3_task1: Collect from Mediterranean or Around the World Cruise Lines
Quest.qf_eurostadium3_task2: Collect from a Level 3 French Café or Chippy Shop
Quest.qf_eurostadium3_task2_hint: A great place for a pregame meal
Quest.qf_eurostadium3_dialog_finish: Everyone enjoyed the game and they were very impressed with your European Soccer Stadium! Congratulations!
Quest.qf_farmers_market_intro: Put a Farmer’s Market in your city so you can get special premium goods crops and great bonuses! Let’s get started!
Quest.qf_farmers_market_task1_hint: The Farmer's market gives great bonuses and premium crops when it's open!
Quest.qf_farmers_market_task2_hint: Opening lets you plant premium crops!
Quest.qf_farmers_market_dialog_finish: With your new Farmer’s Market, you’ve really cornered the market on fresh produce! Your citizens love it!
Quest.qf_farmers_market2_dialog_header: Business is already booming! Get more bonuses and premium crops by opening the Farmer’s Market again!
Quest.qf_farmers_market2_task1: Have a Level 2 Farmer’s Market in your city
Quest.qf_farmers_market2_task2_hint: Don’t put all your eggs into one basket
Quest.qf_farmers_market2_task3_hint: They also drop Pickle Jars to help you open the market!
Quest.qf_farmers_market2_dialog_finish: Look at all the fruits of your labor here at the Farmer’s Market! And the vegetables don’t look bad, either!
Quest.qf_farmers_market3_dialog_header: When you upgrade the Farmer's Market, you'll get access to more crops that plant premium goods!
Quest.qf_farmers_market3_task1: Have a Level 3 Farmer’s Market in your city
Quest.qf_farmers_market3_dialog_finish: Your new Farmer’s Market has proven to be the cream of the crop! That reminds me. I have some shopping to do!
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_1_dialog_header: Great idea! A colorful fireworks display should be just the thing to treat your citizens!
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_1_task1_hint: Fire and water go together nicely
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_1_task2_hint: A few test rounds before the big show
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_2_dialog_header: Collect as many fireworks as you can and prepare for an evening of colorful bursts!
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_2_task1_hint: A loud treat for a loud show
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_2_dialog_finish: Everyone is absolutely bursting with festive energy set off by your big fireworks show!
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_3_intro: Create more sparkling arrays of aerial decor in your skies with new kinds of fireworks!
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_3_dialog_header: Make sure you’ve got everything in place for a night of jubilant celebrations!
Quest.qf_fireworks_main_3_dialog_finish: The bundles of bursts in the sky can only mean a sure success! Happy Anniversary!
Quest.qf_fishing_1_intro: I say we do a little catch and release fishin’ so you can hook yourself some amazing rewards! Come on! Let’s go!
Quest.qf_fishing_1_dialog_header: First, we need ourselves a fishing boat! Let’s go complete it so we can get started! Don’t forget the bait!
Quest.qf_fishing_1_dialog_finish: We reeled in some whoppers out there today. Let’s get ‘em off the hook and throw ‘em back into the sea!
Quest.qf_fishing_2_intro: Your catch and release fishing expedition is off to a great start! But let’s be honest. You’re gonna need a bigger boat.
Quest.qf_fishing_2_dialog_header: You don’t seem to be too comfortable on a boat. Ha, you’re a regular fish outta water!
Quest.qf_fishing_2_task2: Expand and Place Uncommon Fishing Hole
Quest.qf_fishing_2_dialog_finish: Well, looks like you’re hooked on this whole thing now! I knew I’d make a fisherman out of you yet!
Quest.qf_fishing_3_intro: Y’all know me. Know how I earn a livin’. I say we go way out there and see what’s hidin’ underneath the surface!
Quest.qf_fishing_3_dialog_finish: Wow, our nets are filled with fish! I wonder how much they’d be worth if we didn’t throw ‘em back!
Quest.qf_fishing_4_intro: Let’s head out to a very rare fishing hole. But it’s not like going down to the pond chasin’ bluegills and tommy cods.
Quest.qf_fishing_4_dialog_header: I have to admit that you’re becoming quite the first mate! Now throw out another line and reel in’ a big one!
Quest.qf_fishing_4_dialog_finish: We had a lot of success at that fishing hole! You’re really making a splash with the other local fishermen!
Quest.qf_fishing_5_intro: We’ve got bigger fish to fry now! Let’s go out there and try to get our tentacles on the mythical beast, the Kraken!
Quest.qf_fishing_5_dialog_header: This isn’t any ordinary fishing trip we’re going on. Desperate times call for desperate measures!
Quest.qf_fishing_5_dialog_finish: Well, look at you! Master fisherman and conqueror of the mighty Kraken! You’ve really made me proud!
Quest.qf_game_flying_main_intro: A trip to the library uncovered a tale of a wizard who left hidden spells in your city!
Quest.qf_game_flying_main_dialog_header: The wizard’s spell says rewards will come when buildings fly above the clouds!
Quest.qf_gondola_1_task2: Place gondola tracks next to the station
Quest.qf_gondola_1_task2_hint: Place gondola tracks instead of building roads!
Quest.qf_gondola_1_dialog_finish: You’re on the right track! Soon we’ll have a new addition to the transportation system!
Quest.qf_gondola_2_intro: Keep on upgrading your winter gondola to earn special benefits including bonus payouts!
Quest.qf_gondola_2_dialog_header: Gondolas are complicated projects, but I think you’re getting the "hang" of it! Get it?!
Quest.qf_gondola_2_task2_hint: Upgrade or buy from market to unlock new tracks
Quest.qf_gondola_2_task3_hint: More people to share the holidays with
Quest.qf_gondola_2_dialog_finish: Great job! Everyone is taking advantage of the convenience and fun of your winter gondola!
Quest.qf_gondola_3_intro: Collect and upgrade your new winter gondola to enjoy the benefits it brings to your city!
Quest.qf_gondola_3_dialog_header: This gondola makes it easy for holiday shoppers to travel! Collect on the economy boost!
Quest.qf_gondola_3_dialog_finish: Congratulations on having a successful winter gondola! A marvelous addition to your city!
Quest.qf_govcenter_dialog_header: The Learning Center is a great creative outlet for your citizens and will spark their imaginations!
Quest.qf_govcenter_task1_hint: Stores up to 4 Education Community Buildings
Quest.qf_govcenter_task3: Upgrade the Learning Center to Level 2
Quest.qf_govcenter_dialog_finish: You made a smart decision by putting the Learning Center in your city! Your citizens are going to learn a lot!
Quest.qf_grandcanyon_intro: Let’s make a grand gesture and place the Great Canyon, one of the seven natural wonders of the world, in your city!
Quest.qf_grandcanyon_dialog_header: The Great Canyon truly is a sight to behold! Once you place it, tourists will be lining up to see it!
Quest.qf_grandcanyon_task2_hint: Complete the Airport Passenger Terminal to send Passenger Planes
Quest.qf_grandcanyon_dialog_finish: Wow! You really put the “can” in “canyon”! After this, I’m convinced that there’s nothing you can’t do!
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_1_intro: It’s up to you to fill the city with Halloween spirit! Are you up for a dreadful dare?
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_1_dialog_header: A graveyard will bring Halloween spirit to your city, and spooky spirits too!
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_2_intro: Your city is brimming with Halloween haunts and spirits, but there is still more to do!
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_2_dialog_header: Collect on your hard work by trick-or-treating for some sweet cash! Knock-knock!
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_2_dialog_finish: Gloomy graveyards, macabre monies, bloodcurdling bats. You’ve been busy!
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_3_intro: Nothing says "Halloween" like genuine ghosts, ghouls and wraiths! Keep attracting as many as you can!
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_3_dialog_header: Building a good graveyard takes a lot of hard work and upper body strength! Grab a shovel!
Quest.qf_halloween_graveyard_3_dialog_finish: You wrangled those uncanny wraiths and put them back in their place! Now that’s Halloween spirit!
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_1_dialog_heade: It’s time to begin building your Spectral Civic Center and ghastly ghost neighborhood!
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_1_dialog_finis: Your Spectral space savers are looking quite eerie indeed! You’ve done excellent work!
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_2_intro: Maybe some home improvements will attract the right kind of alarming attention!
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_2_dialog_finis: Things are getting creepy now that you’ve grouped your ghostly buildings!
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_3_dialog_heade: I’m sure the inspector will give you high marks, but let’s make sure all is in place!
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_3_task1: Collect from Haunted Heights or Spectral Civic Center
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_3_task3: Upgrade the Spectral Civic Center to Level 3
Quest.qf_halloween_space_savers_3_dialog_finis: The inspector is very impressed with your new endeavors! A convenient haunt!
Quest.qf_helicopter_1_task2_hint: Helicopter jobs help you collect from your buildings, send tourists, or supply your businesses!
Quest.qf_helicopter_1_dialog_finish: Great job! Now that you've placed your Helicopter Port, you're going to be saving lots of goods and energy!
Quest.qf_helicopter_2_dialog_header: Your helicopters are flying high so far! Let's upgrade the Helicopter Port and get you more Helicopters!
Quest.qf_helicopter_2_task1_hint: Each helipad gives you an extra helicopter!
Quest.qf_helicopter_3_intro: Your helicopters are making your city more efficient and making your life a little easier! Let's keep working!
Quest.qf_helicopter_3_dialog_header: Remember, safety first! Let's collect some Helicopter Fins from your friends so we can fly safely!
Quest.qf_helicopter_3_dialog_finish: Wow, your fleet of helicopters have really gotten a lot done! I bet your head is in the clouds right about now!
Quest.qt_helicopter_all_intro: Did you know there are three helicopter pads available in your city? Let's build them all!
Quest.qt_helicopter_all_task2_hint: The Yellow Helipad unlocks better Helicopter jobs!
Quest.qt_helicopter_all_dialog_finish: Great job, you've built all the helicopter pads and gotten some amazing prizes!
Quest.q_elder_helicopter_intro: Now that you're flying high with helicopters, it's time you added a Water Helicopter Port to your city! Let's go!
Quest.q_elder_helicopter_dialog_finish: It looks like your Water Helicopter Port is going to come in mighty handy! You're making quite the splash!
Quest.qf_high_click_intro: Your city has always been one of the most innovative cities in the world! So let's give it a new type of building!
Quest.qf_high_click_dialog_header: The French Chateau requires fewer parts and your friends can help you build in a new way!
Quest.qf_honeymoon_1_intro: I think the lovebirds of your city deserve the romantic getaway of their dreams! Let’s send them on a honeymoon cruise!
Quest.qf_honeymoon_1_task3: Place your Sailboat pier on Water and complete building your boat.
Quest.qf_honeymoon_1_dialog_finish: The breeze off the water keeps blowing out those scented candles! Oh well. The moon will light their path!
