Quest.qf_upgrade_residences_family2_intro: Keep upgrading your family residences to increase your population before time runs out!
Quest.qf_upgrade_residences_family2_dialog_hea: Grab a hammer! It’s time to give your family residences a step up with a luxury upgrade!
Quest.qf_upgrade_residences_family2_task3: Collect from a Level 2 Family Residence office
Quest.qf_upgrade_residences_family2_dialog_fin: Great job in your efforts to increase your population! Your homes are looking spiffy!
Quest.qf_upgrade_residences_family3_dialog_hea: Increase your population and give your family residences the ultimate upgrade! Let’s go!
Quest.qf_upgrade_residences_family3_task3: Collect from a Level 3 Family Residence office
Quest.qf_upgrade_residences_family3_dialog_fin: You did it! You beat the clock, increased your population and created swanky new digs!
Quest.qf_weather_dialog_header: Weather has arrived in CityVille. Build the Weather Forecasting Tower to get bonuses from rain!
Quest.qf_weather_task1_hint: The Weather Forecasting Tower will bring rain to your city
Quest.qf_weather_dialog_finish: You are going to love the weather in CityVille.  It rains bonus coins and goods!
Quest.qf_weather2_task1_hint: Citizens will need umbrellas when it rains!
Quest.qf_weather2_task3_hint: When it rains, businesses need to stock up on goods
Quest.qf_weather3_task1_hint: Get bonus goods from crops by harvesting when it is raining
Quest.qf_weather3_dialog_finish: Enjoy the rain while it lasts! You never know what weather will come next.
Quest.qf_wedding_1_intro: It's up to you to host the biggest wedding in CityVille so you can win exclusive prizes on the couple's big day!
Quest.qf_wedding_1_dialog_header: Choose who you'd like to see get married so you can start sending out invitations!
Quest.qf_wedding_1_task3_hint: You get a wedding gift for each RSVP
Quest.qf_wedding_1_dialog_finish: Well, you have two RSVPs and two wedding presents to open on the big day! Let's go get some more!
Quest.qf_wedding_2_intro: Invite as many guests to the dream wedding as you can so you can pile up the wedding gifts! Each one contains a reward!
Quest.qf_wedding_2_dialog_header: This wedding is going to be huge so invite as many friends as you can! I can't wait to see the cake!
Quest.qf_wedding_2_dialog_finish: I can't believe that the big day is so close! I'm so nervous and I'm not even getting married!
Quest.qf_wedding_3_intro: You're making this whole wedding planning thing look like a piece of cake! That reminds me! We need cake toppers!
Quest.qf_wedding_3_dialog_header: This cake looks great! While the happy couple whispers sweet nothings, we'll be eating sweet somethings!
Quest.qf_wedding_3_dialog_finish: While the couple rehearses their vows, I have decided to take a vow of silence! I don't want to disturb them!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_1_intro: It's almost time for the couple's big day! This is going to be the biggest and best wedding of the year!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_1_dialog_header: Before the wedding, we need to hold the Wedding Rehearsal. We can't leave anything to chance!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_1_task3_hint: Traditional Restaurant, Cosmopolitan Restaurant or Outdoor Restaurant
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_1_dialog_finish: That was such a beautiful wedding rehearsal! Now the stage is set for the real thing! I can't wait!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_2_intro: The girls want to blow off some steam before the big day! So let's help them get ready to go out on the town!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_2_dialog_header: The bridesmaids can't wait to fight over the bouquet! Let's find them a few to practice with!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_2_task2_hint: The girls want a light snack before heading out
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_2_task3_hint: Traditional, Cosmopolitan or Outdoor Wedding Chairs
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_2_dialog_finish: The girls must've had a blast last night! They can't stop talking about how much fun they had together!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_3_intro: The couple looks stunning! I can't believe that they're getting married today! They're going to be so happy together!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_3_dialog_header: Aw, what a sweet kiss! You can tell that they really love each other. I wish them nothing but the best!
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_3_task3_hint: Traditional, Cosmopolitan or Outdoor Wedding Aisle
Quest.qf_wedding_v2_3_dialog_finish: Well, the happy couple is off to start their lives together! And I'm sure they'll live happily ever after!
Quest.qf_wendys_1_intro: Your citizens are going to be thrilled when they hear that you’re putting a Wendy’s® restaurant in your city!
Quest.qf_wendys_1_task2: Collect Chicken Mozzarella Sandwiches from Wendy’s®
Quest.qf_wendys_1_task3: Visita la página de Wendy’s® en la Comunidad para intentar conseguir tarjetas regalo
Quest.qf_wendys_1_task3_hint: © 2012 Oldemark LLC. For official rules visit www.andtoallagoodbite.com
Quest.qf_wendys_1_dialog_finish: You’ve mastered the Wendy’s® business. Share the news with your friends!
Quest.qf_winter_coreloop_1_dialog_header: My husband is coming to town, and he’s expecting an extra festive city! Let’s get ready!
Quest.qf_winter_coreloop_1_task3_hint: High trafficked this time of year
Quest.qf_winter_coreloop_1_dialog_finish: You’ve taken some nice first steps in preparing for Santa Claus’s visit! Keep it up!
Quest.qf_winter_coreloop_2_intro: Santa Claus is coming to your town with a gift for the city with the most holiday cheer!
Quest.qf_winter_coreloop_2_dialog_finish: You’re preparing splendidly for a visit from Santa Claus, but we’re not finished yet!
Quest.qf_winter_coreloop_3_intro: Santa is on his way with a gift for your city! Let’s throw a party for his arrival!
Quest.qf_winter_coreloop_3_dialog_finish: What a festive party! Even the reindeer had fun! We hope you enjoy your holiday gift!
Quest.qf_winter_trees_intro: Winter is here! Create a wonderful winter-full forest and unlock a rare tree!
Quest.qf_winter_trees_dialog_finish: You’ve just begun to grow a grove of unique winter trees in your forest! Keep it up!
Quest.qf_winter_trees2_intro: Continue to grow your forest of winter trees! Beautify your city and increase rewards!
Quest.qf_winter_trees2_dialog_header: Your winter wonderland is sprucing up nicely with so many trees! Let’s grow!
Quest.qf_winter_trees2_task2_hint: Even palm trees can be holiday trees
Quest.qf_winter_trees2_dialog_finish: The air is cool, crisp, and your trees look gorgeous against the snow! A serene setting!
Quest.qf_winter_trees3_intro: Keep expanding the number of trees in your park! That rare tree is almost yours!
Quest.qf_winter_trees3_task1: Have 10 Winter Forest Buildings in your city
Quest.qf_winter_trees3_dialog_finish: You’ve earned a Wildwood Growth and populated your forest with beautiful winter trees!
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_1_goal: GOAL: UPGRADE YOUR BRIDGE, INCREASE POPULATION!
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_1_intro: It's time to bridge the gap between your city and the greatest cities in the world! Let's start by upgrading your bridge!
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_1_task2_hint: Citizens will move into Residences with space
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_1_task3_hint: Some family homes for the new arrivals
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_1_dialog_finish: Your city is already moving up in the world! Let's keep upgrading the bridge and take your city to the top!
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_2_task2_hint: Upgrading your bridge requires a lot of goods!
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_3_task2_hint: People will move to your city after the upgrade
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_3_task3: Unload 25 Ships from San Francisco Supply
Quest.qm_bridge_v2_3_dialog_finish: Let's deliver the goods and give your citizens the best bridge in the world! They're going to love it!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_1_dialog_header: Place the Bubble Safari Monkey to get great rewards! Complete Level 6 and increase your population!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_1_task3: Complete Level 6 in Bubble Safari to increase your max population
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_1_dialog_finish: Now that you have the Bubble Safari Monkey in your city, get him to keep raising your population!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_2_intro: Let's keep your city out of bubble trouble and go ask friends for more bubbles! So stop monkeying around and get going!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_2_dialog_finish: You're so good at Bubble Safari that you deserve to do a little celebratory jungle boogie! Get down!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_3_intro: It's time for you to go on safari and hunt for some Coconuts! And don't forget to get that monkey off your back!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_3_dialog_header: Your Rewards are just getting awesome!! Reach Level 42 to win the Bubble Safari Museum!!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_3_dialog_finish: It looks like the Bubble Safari monkey really likes you! He's mimicking everything you do! It's hilarious!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_4_intro: You're really rising up the ranks in Bubble Safari! Let's get some Hummingbirds so you can grow your city even more!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_4_dialog_header: You've made it this far so keep going so you can reach Level 50 in Bubble Safari! I know you can do it!
Quest.qm_bubblesafari_4_dialog_finish: You did a fantastic job playing Bubble Safari! That looked like it was more fun than a barrel of monkeys!
Quest.qm_bus_station_1_task1_hint: This is really going to help people get around
Quest.qm_bus_station_1_task2: Place and Build 2 Bus Stops in your city
Quest.qm_bus_station_1_task2_hint: Bus Stops can be found in the Build Menu in the Feature Tab of Special section
Quest.qm_bus_station_1_task3_hint: Bus Stops fill with citizens from your businesses.
Quest.qm_bus_station_2_dialog_finish: You really are the driving force behind this Bus Station! Maybe you can take the wheel and drive the bus, too!
Quest.qm_bus_station_2_task1_hint: You will unlock new buses and better Bus Stops!
Quest.qm_bus_station_2_task2: Supply 20 businesses next to your Bus Stops
Quest.qm_bus_station_2_task2_hint: Bus Stops will send citizens to speed up your businesses!
Quest.qm_bus_station_2_task3: Send 10 Buses from your Bus Station
Quest.qm_bus_station_3_dialog_finish: Your new Bus Station makes it really easy for your citizens to travel through your city!
Quest.qm_bus_station_3_task1_hint: This Bus Station has come a long way
Quest.qm_bus_station_3_task2: Send 40 Buses from your Bus Station
Quest.qm_chefville_1_intro: It's time to grab your oven mitts and head over to ChefVille so you can win some awesome rewards for your city!
Quest.qm_chefville_1_task2_hint: Place the ChefVille deco beside any restaurant
Quest.qm_chefville_1_dialog_finish: Your cooking is great. But the more ketchup I put on it, the better it tastes! What?! That's a compliment!
Quest.qm_chefville_2_intro: Nothing puts a smile on diners faces like a dish that is covered in cheese! So let's go ask your friends for some!
Quest.qm_chefville_2_dialog_header: I can almost taste those amazing cheese burgers and hamburgers! Hurry up and find the cheese!
Quest.qm_chefville_2_task3_hint: Finish the Quest to win a Tapas Restaurant
Quest.qm_chefville_2_dialog_finish: Wow, you're already up to Level 8 in ChefVille! You're turning out to be quite the top chef!
Quest.qm_chefville_3_dialog_finish: I'd love to dig into this amazing looking dish but I can't. I'm not quite sure which fork I'm supposed to use!
Quest.qm_chefville_4_dialog_header: How bout you lend me a hand and help me peel this orange! These oranges aren’t gonna make juice out of themselves!
Quest.qm_chefville_4_dialog_finish: You've done an amazing job in ChefVille! It's really going to make a difference in your city, too!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_1_dialog_header: Let's start mapping out your strategy for winning City of the Year by collecting Navigation maps!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_1_task2: Have Terminal Extensions in your City
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_1_dialog_finish: After collecting from Toronto Airlines, your city is really reaching for the sky! Let's keep going!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_2_intro: Your city's transportation is getting better and better! Now let's turn our attention to your ships and ports!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_2_task1_hint: When it comes to Ports, three's company
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_3_intro: Let's put you on the fast track to winning City of the Year by making sure your city's cars and buses are in good shape!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_3_dialog_header: Let's make sure your buses are running on time and that your bus stops are in good shape!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act1_3_task3_hint: Your citizens love your public transportation
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act2_1_dialog_header: Let's lure a few movie stars to your city to give your film industry a boost! So, let's wine ‘em and dine ‘em!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act2_2_intro: Nothing will make the movie stars feel more welcome than giving them a star on your city's walk of fame!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act2_2_dialog_header: Wow! The biggest stars in the movie business are here! I have to admit that I'm getting a little star struck!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act2_2_task2_hint: And they probably worked for peanuts
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act2_2_task3_hint: Your stars are reaching new heights
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act2_3_intro: Your new movie star residents are the toast of the town! Let's celebrate their arrival and throw them a big party!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act2_3_dialog_header: You really did yourself a favor by improving your city's entertainment industry! You're a shoe in to win!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act3_1_dialog_header: Maybe some flower power will persuade the City of the Year judges! Let's plant some Sun Flowers!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act3_2_dialog_header: Let's plant the seed in the judges' heads that your city is blossoming more than ever! Come on! Let's go!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act3_2_task1_hint: Any building on Scenic Hill will work
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act3_2_dialog_finish: Your gardens are looking lovely this summer! I bet the judges will think your city is the cream of the crop!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act3_3_dialog_header: Let's show the judges how popular your neighborhoods and attractions are with your citizens! Come on!
Quest.qm_cityoftheyear_act3_3_dialog_finish: With all the amazing summer attractions we've seen, your city really is a ray of sunshine!
Quest.qm_cityville2_1_dialog_header: These blueprints could be anywhere! Enlist everyone’s help by spreading the word!
Quest.qm_cityville2_1_task2_hint: Revisit the police for further clues
Quest.qm_cityville2_1_dialog_finish: We’ve made some real progress! The blueprints are still out there, but we’ll find them!
Quest.qm_cityville2_2_intro: We’re still on the hunt for missing blueprints! Let’s explore all possible avenues!
Quest.qm_cityville2_2_dialog_header: Let’s track down the last person to see the blueprints: a delivery boy working downtown!
Quest.qm_cityville2_2_task1_hint: We’ve got to find out which restaurant it was
Quest.qm_cityville2_2_task3_hint: Gain a stronger presence in this town
Quest.qm_cityville2_2_dialog_finish: You’ve recovered a blueprint! One of the blueprints got mixed up with the take-out menu!
Quest.qm_cityville2_3_intro: We’re hot on the trail of missing blueprints and have already found one! Only two left!
Quest.qm_cityville2_3_dialog_finish: You’ve found another blueprint in a nest! It must have been stolen by errant pigeons!
Quest.qm_cityville2_4_intro: The case of the missing blueprints is almost solved! Find one more to earn big rewards!
Quest.qm_cityville2_4_dialog_header: We’ve searched most of the city, but let’s look more thoroughly! They could be anywhere!
Quest.qm_cityville2_4_task1_hint: To unlock every place we find
Quest.qm_cityville2_4_dialog_finish: You found the third blueprint on a statue! The pigeons strike again! Great detective work!
Quest.qm_coasterville_1_intro: Start playing CoasterVille so you can earn some awesome rewards for your city! Come on! Let’s get started!
Quest.qm_coasterville_1_dialog_finish: Your theme park looks amazing! I’ll catch up with you soon. I’m gonna see which ride has the shortest line!
Quest.qm_coasterville_2_intro: Okay, let’s keep our eyes on the prize so you can keep earning rewards for your city! Next up, we need prize tickets!
Quest.qm_coasterville_2_dialog_header: Your park’s guests are winning prizes left and right! We better go round up a few more prize tickets!
Quest.qm_coasterville_2_dialog_finish: Your park’s popularity is through the roof! People of all ages are having a blast on all your attractions!
Quest.qm_coasterville_3_dialog_header: All those hatless guests need something else to wear! Let’s go round them up some souvenir hats!
Quest.qm_coasterville_3_dialog_finish: Wow, I can’t believe how awesome your new theme park turned out! I think I’m gonna need an annual pass!
Quest.qm_coasterville_4_intro: Shops are a source of fun for both your park and your city! Let’s explore and improve them!
Quest.qm_coasterville_4_task3_hint: You’re climbing higher than the rides
Quest.qm_coasterville_4_dialog_finish: Great job! Managing a city and a theme park is a lot of work, but the rewards are big!
Quest.qm_equalityplaza_1_intro: Equality Plaza accepts any and all Community Buildings! So let’s place the newest neighborhood in your city now!
Quest.qm_equalityplaza_1_dialog_header: Before you place Equality Plaza in your city, you can actually start collecting parts for it! Let’s go!
Quest.qm_equalityplaza_1_dialog_finish: Now that you have an Equality Plaza in your city, your Community Buildings can have a community of their own!
Quest.qm_equalityplaza_2_intro: Let’s upgrade your Equality Plaza so you can increase the number of Community Buildings that it can hold!
Quest.qm_equalityplaza_2_dialog_header: Let’s make a splash with your new Equality Plaza by fixing the place up with a few Fountains!
Quest.qm_equalityplaza_3_intro: There’s no better way to build the community than by placing more Community Buildings in your Equality Plaza!
Quest.qm_farmville2_1_intro: Don your best straw hat and head over to FarmVille 2 so you can win some awesome rewards for your city!
Quest.qm_farmville2_1_dialog_finish: Your family farm is off to a great start. But you best keep an eye out for gophers! They're such pests!
Quest.qm_farmville2_2_intro: All this plowing would be a lot easier with Steel Plows!  Maybe your friends could give you some?! Let's go ask 'em!
Quest.qm_farmville2_2_dialog_header: I refuse to plant another seed until we have a better plow! Hurry up and get that plow!
Quest.qm_farmville2_2_dialog_finish: Wow, you're already up to Level 10 in FarmVille 2! You're turning out to be quite the farmer!
Quest.qm_farmville2_3_intro: Your fruits and vegetables are delicious!  I think it's time to add some protein to the menu, though!
Quest.qm_farmville2_3_dialog_header: With a growing number of animals living at your farm there is a long line at the water trough!
Quest.qm_farmville2_3_dialog_finish: Your animals are much more comfortable now! Though I wish the pigs would stop bathing in the trough.
Quest.qm_farmville2_4_intro: The number of happy animals on your farm is staggering! But we're going to need more equipment to keep them fed!
Quest.qm_farmville2_4_dialog_finish: You've done an amazing job in FarmVille 2! It's really going to make a difference in your city, too!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_1_message: Take a chance on romance with this handsome devil!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_1_intro: If looks could kill, I'd have been locked up a long time ago. Luckily, I'm not only a free man but I'm a single man, too!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_1_task2_hint: No woman can resist pink roses
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_1_task3: Collect 10 Dress Shoes from the Shoe Store
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_1_dialog_finish: I don't want to sound cocky but I think these pink roses are going to go over pretty well tonight!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_2_intro: I just got paid and I'm about to spend the evening with a beautiful woman! Man, I love my life!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_2_dialog_header: I think I know this dating game pretty well by now but I can always use some more ammo for my arsenal!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_2_task3: Collect 15 Colognes from Cosmetic Store or Perfume Shop
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_2_task3_hint: I know what drives women wild
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_2_dialog_finish: I've got some cash, some cologne, and some new pointers on how to woo a woman! Let the date begin!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_3_dialog_header: I hope you don't mind, but I'm going to buy Sam dinner at the best restaurant in town!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_3_task3: Collect from the Level 3 Flower Kiosk five times
Quest.qm_lovestory_act1_3_dialog_finish: Sam didn't say much on the way home but I can tell she's already falling for me! I don't blame her.
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_1_message: Take a chance on romance with this dashing daredevil!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_1_dialog_header: Before the date, I'm gonna clear my head by doing a little karate! Let's do this!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_1_dialog_finish: If Sam's going to keep up with me, she's gonna have to be one tough woman. I'm sure she  can handle it!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_2_dialog_header: I just can't decide what we should do on the date! There are just so many awesome activities to choose from!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_2_task2_hint: We could go cliff diving in Rio
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_2_task3: Collect 30 Energy Bars from Super Market
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_2_dialog_finish: Uh oh! I ate too many energy bars! Now I'm going to be bouncing off the walls on our date!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_3_dialog_header: If Sam's really want to fall in love, she has to jump in head first! We should go bungee jumping!
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_3_task1: Collect from the Reverse Bungee Attraction twice
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_3_task2: Collect 5 Jet Skis from Jet Ski Shop
Quest.qm_lovestory_act2_3_dialog_finish: Looks like Sam had a great time! Who knew you'd be such a natural at extreme sports?
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_1_task2: Upgrade Natural History Museum to level 2
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_1_task2_hint: I love to learn and share with the special people in my life
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_1_task3: Collect 25 Dance Lessons at the Dance Studio
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_1_task3_hint: Collect from the Dance Studio for a chance to get Dance Lessons
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_2_task1_hint: Being well read is very important. What is your favorite book?
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_2_task2: Collect 25 Magazine from any library or ask friends
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_2_task2_hint: Keeping up with current events is a must
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_2_task3_hint: I love making wine. You should try mine.
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_3_task1: Collect 3 Art Pieces from any Level 3 Museum
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_3_task1_hint: Collect from any level 3 Museum for a chance to get Art Pieces
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_3_task2_hint: I was wondering if Sam and I should have our first dance
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_3_task3: Collect 3 Fresh Chess Sets from High Society Collection
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_3_dialog_finish: Looks like I've met my match on the dance floor and chess board!
Quest.qm_package_facility_task1_hint: Supplying businesses with premium goods gives a higher payout
Quest.qm_package_facility_dialog_finish: Wow! You really sealed the deal with that new Packaging Plant! By the way, can I have a raise?!
Quest.qm_skyscraper_pagoda_intro: On a recent trip to China, I learned that the Chinese phoenix is called fenghuang. It gave me an idea for your city!
Quest.qm_skyscraper_pagoda_dialog_header: Let’s place the Fenghuang Pagoda in your city as a symbol of prosperity for Chinese New Year!
Quest.qm_skyscrapers1_task1_hint: Place an expansion and make room for the skyline
Quest.qm_skyscrapers1_task2_hint: Upgrade Mirror Heights to Level 6 to win the one-time 10X Wonder Bonus
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_1_intro: I can't believe that I got promoted! Let's celebrate with a party!
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_1_task2_hint: We need money for party supplies
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_1_task3_hint: Collect from Residences or Ask Friends
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_1_dialog_finish: I rarely spend time away from my ships but it's kind of nice to be on land for once! The Platinum Tower is awesome!
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_2_intro: This party's getting out of control! Instead of bothering the neighbors, let's take it back to my cruise ship!
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_2_dialog_header: The Platinum Tower was cool but nothing beats a day in the sun on a cruise ship!
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_2_task2_hint: Place your Buffet Business reward from the first goal
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_2_dialog_finish: Wow! I never knew Paul was such a good volleyball player! He's pretty valuable down there under the net!
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_3_dialog_header: Oh, I forgot to bring my dancing shoes! I hope someone on the cruise ship has the same shoe size as me!
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_3_task2: Collect 30 times from the Cosmetic Store, Handbag Store, or Jeans Store
Quest.qm_skyscrapers2_3_task3: Collect 40 Disco Balls by unloading ships
Quest.qm_sledquest_dialog_header: The Stumpfords head on down to the park, and sled the day away!
Quest.qm_sledquest_task2: Build a Snowman House for the Stumpfords
Quest.qm_sledquest_task2_hint: Starts with 500 residents. With some hard work you can make this a home for 2180 friends!
Quest.qm_sledquest_task3_hint: Gotta bundle up for a cold day outside!
Quest.qm_themepark_1_dialog_finish: You’ve completed Section 1 of your Theme Park but you still have two more to go! Let’s get to work!
Quest.qm_themepark_1_dialog_header: The Theme Park works as a Neighborhood so you can store Attractions and save space in your city!
Quest.qm_themepark_1_task1_hint: Theme Parks hold Attractions and look amazing!
Quest.qm_themepark_1_task2: Place all 3 Attractions in Section 1 of your Theme Park
Quest.qm_themepark_1_task2_hint: Place Go Karts, Ferris Wheel and build the new Roller Coaster to complete Section 1.
Quest.qm_themepark_1_task3_hint: Section 2 allows you to place more Attractions and get better payouts!
Quest.qm_themepark_2_dialog_finish: Wow, your Theme Park is looking better and better! Let’s work on Section 3 and finish the job!
Quest.qm_themepark_2_dialog_header: Your Theme Park is off to a great start so far! Everyone loves it! Let’s collect from it now!
Quest.qm_themepark_2_task1: Place all 3 Attractions in Section 2 of your Theme Park
Quest.qm_themepark_2_task1_hint: Reverse Bungee, Pirate Ship and Wave Pool!
Quest.qm_themepark_2_task3_hint: Start working on Section 3 to have a complete Theme Park for your City!
Quest.qm_themepark_3_task1: Place all 3 Attractions in Section 3 of your Theme Park
Quest.qm_volcano_island_task3_hint: Warning: the rewards are red hot!
Quest.qm_volcano_island_dialog_finish: Your citizens are fired up about the new Volcano and Lava Rock Island!
Quest.qt_chinesebusiness_task1_hint: To finish Shanghai Center, click it to bring up the Task Menu.
Quest.qt_coreloop_52912_dialog_header: Race to finish these tasks and earn big rewards!
Quest.qt_coreloop_52912_dialog_finish: You did it! Your city is really running smoothly now!
Quest.qt_coreloop_52912_dialog_start: Your city is looking great! But make sure all the essential services are running smoothly.
Quest.qt_crooked_house_intro: If I've learned anything in all my years it's that you gotta have a gimmick. And this tourist attraction has a good one!
Quest.qt_crooked_house_dialog_finish: I like the Crooked Castle so much that I just might live here! I wonder if my pigeons would like it as much as me!
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_ski_slope_intro: Earn the Ski Resort to make your city a winter adventure destination!
Quest.qt_expansion_quest_ski_slope_dialog_head: The citizens of your city want to get out and enjoy the great wintery outdoors! Provide them with a Ski Resort!
Quest.qt_goforgems_dialog_start: You should take advantage of this golden opportunity to get fantastic rewards for things you already love doing!
Quest.qt_goforgems_dialog_header: Let’s start by harvesting your crops! Come on! Those rewards are just waiting for you to win them!
Quest.qt_goforgems_dialog_finish: You did a great job of finishing everything in time! And you’ll be happy to know that you’ve struck gold!
Quest.qt_goforgold_dialog_start: It’s time for you to get rewarded for all the things you love doing in your city! So let’s get started and go for the gold!
Quest.qt_goforgold_dialog_header: The faster you complete the goals, the better your rewards will be! Let’s start by harvesting your Ships!
Quest.qt_goforgold_dialog_finish: Wow, you really took advantage of this golden opportunity! And now it’s time for you to claim your reward!
Quest.qt_goforloot_intro: I just don’t want summer to end! So let’s throw a celebration for your citizens and keep summer going a little longer!
Quest.qt_goforloot_dialog_header: I’m going to bring my special barbecue sauce to the party. But keep your hands off of it until it’s lunchtime!
Quest.qt_goforloot_task2: Collect Grill Tongs from Summer Party Residences
Quest.qt_goforloot_task3: Collect Beverage Sweetener from Summer Party Crops
Quest.qt_goforloot_dialog_finish: My barbecue sauce was a big hit at the party! I think this was the best summer of my life! I hope it never ends!
Quest.qt_halloween2012_dialog_header: Let’s see how fast you can get Halloween essentials: candy, crops and cash!
Quest.qt_halloween2012_dialog_finish: Your city is full of ghostly Halloween spirit thanks to your new business endeavors!
Quest.qt_halloween2012_dialog_start: Your city has grown a lot recently! Keep raising Halloween spirits in your city!
Quest.qt_highclick_dialog_header: Let's place and complete the Franklin Center so everything will be ready in time! You're doing a great job so far!
Quest.qt_highclick_task3_hint: People are coming from miles around
Quest.qt_russianresidence_intro: I’ve always wanted to cut down a Russian tree. The wood can build a beautiful mansion with high population!
Quest.qt_russianresidence_task1_hint: To finish Moscow Mansion, click it to bring up the Build Menu.
Quest.qt_supermuni_weatherballoon_dialog_heade: You better find some umbrellas for your citizens because I'm cooking up some Halloween havoc as we speak!
Quest.qt_surfs_up_dialog_start: Wow, look at those big waves! Try to catch the biggest wave you can while the surf’s up and win big rewards!
Quest.qt_surfs_up_dialog_header: The faster you finish, the better your rewards will be! So let’s grab our boards and head for the beach!
Quest.qt_surfs_up_dialog_finish: You really know your way around a surfboard! I’m going to start calling you the chairman of the board!
Quest.qt_surfs_upRewardMessage: You just sent {user,name} a Surfboard! Here's a reward of {amount} {count,reward} for helping out!
Quest.qt_surfs_up_complete_AttachmentDesc: {user,name} is hanging ten with the big dogs and has some knowledge to spread! Click below to claim some coins now!
Quest.qt_treeoflife_dialog_header: Let's show the Tree of Life some love and nurse it back to health! Its sap is worth 100 energy! Let's go!
Quest.qt_treeoflife_task1_hint: Click the Tree of Life to get started
Quest.qt_treeoflife_task2_hint: Nature buildings have a good chance of attracting birds!
Quest.qt_treeoflife_task3_hint: Attract Parrots by collecting from Nature Buildings or ask your friends!
Quest.qt_truespend_dialog_header: The Twisty Tier Tower is completely exclusive and is only available through this goal!
Quest.qt_truespend_task1_hint: Shop around in time for the Twisty Tier Tower which adds 4000 – 6000 population
Quest.qt_truespend_dialog_finish: Yipes! Are your feet tired? That was an inspiring shopping session!
Quest.qt_truespend_dialog_start: Go on a Shopping Spree! Spend your City Cash to win an exclusive high powered residence. Hurry!
Quest.qt_venetianresidence_intro: It is so romantic here! I love the canals and architecture style!
Quest.qt_venetianresidence_task1_hint: To finish Venetian Palace, click it to bring up the Task Menu.
Quest.qt_waterfall_timed_dialog_header: You’re gonna fall in love with your Waterfall all over again once you receive your new energy!
Quest.qt_waterfall_timed_task1: Upgrade your Waterfall Station to Level 25
Quest.qt_waterfall_timed_task2: Build a Moist Manor or Hydro Power House
Quest.q_amphitheater_1_dialog_header: ¡Train se dirige a tu ciudad para dar un gran concierto! Haz clic aquí para ver el mensaje de bienvenida y no olvides hacer clic en Me gusta en nuestra página de fans.
Quest.q_amphitheater_2_dialog_header: ¿Has oído que Train está en la ciudad? Haz clic aquí para ver un vídeo del concierto y no te olvides de hacer clic en Me gusta en nuestra página de fans. ¡Completa la misión para desbloquear otro vídeo!
Quest.q_amphitheater_3_dialog_header: ¡La gente está haciendo cola para el nuevo concierto de Train! Haz clic aquí para ver un vídeo del concierto y no te olvides de hacer clic en Me gusta en nuestra página de fans.
Quest.q_bookmarks_favorites_task1_hint: Vuelve a cargar Comunidad y haz clic en el marcador de CityVille.
Quest.qf_hotels_4_dialog_hint: Al registrarte en el hotel de un amigo, podrás ver a jugadores que no son amigos tuyos en la Comunidad y ellos también podrán verte.
Quest.qf_wendys_1_dialog_header: Coloca tu negocio Wendy’s®. Visita www.andtoallagoodbite.com y tendrás la posibilidad de ganar 101 tarjetas regalo para canjear por deliciosos platos de Wendy’s®, como el sándwich de pollo y queso. Hay una para ti y 100 para tus amigos.
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_1_dialog_finish: He escrito miles de canciones de amor. Quizás debería escribirle una a Lowlitta. Descubre mis canciones en mi página de la Comunidad
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_1_dialog_header: Me encantan el arte, la música y la comida. Me muero de ganas de compartir mis cosas favoritas en nuestra cita. Descubre mis canciones favoritas en mi página de la Comunidad.
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_1_intro: Siempre me ha encantado la música y quiero compartir la mía con Lowlitta. ¿Crees que le gustará? Podrás escuchar algunos de mis temas al hacer clic en Me gusta en mi página de la Comunidad. Haz clic aquí.
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_2_dialog_header: Me muero de ganas de pasar tiempo con Lowlitta y conocernos un poco mejor. Me pregunto si habrá visitado mi perfil de Comunidad.
Quest.qm_lovestory_act3_3_dialog_header: Lowlitta tiene una personalidad increíble y es muy inteligente. Quizás cambie pronto mi estado de Comunidad.
Quest.qm_promo_2bbuy_dialog_hint: Grandes beneficios y energía cada vez que recaudes de tu negocio. Completa la colección para conseguir la decoración señal de la plaza de Best Buy® antes de que se acabe el tiempo. ¡Visita la página de la Comunidad de Best Buy® para descubrir más sorpresas!

Saga.act_governor_1_complete_body: You made quite the impression on these citizens! But you'll need more support if you think you're going to beat Krunsch!
Saga.act_governor_2_complete_body: The Special Interest Groups are delivering support to your campaign! But beating Krunsch is going to be serious business!
Saga.act_governor_3_complete_body: The Big Business are delivering support to your campaign! But beating Krunsch is going to be serious business!
Saga.halloweenSaga_complete_body: You've made the monsters feel so at home that they've decided to stay for good!
Saga.act_halloween_1_complete_body: You made quite the impression on these monsters! But you're not out of the wicked woods yet!
Saga.act_halloween_2_complete_title: You Showed The Monsters Who's Boss!
Saga.act_halloween_2_complete_body: The monsters love their new jobs! But you still have a job of your own to do!
Saga.act_halloween_3_complete_body: You fit right in with the monsters on Halloween! They've made you an honorary monster!
Saga.Intl2013Saga_complete_body: You turned out to be quite the globetrotter after showering your citizens with international items!
Saga.act_Intl2013_1_complete_body: Your citizens love the new North American buildings! But you’ve got a lot more continents to explore!
Saga.act_Intl2013_2_complete_body: Your citizens love the new European buildings! But you’ve got a lot more continents to explore!
Saga.act_Intl2013_3_complete_body: Your citizens love the new Asian buildings! But you’ve got a lot more continents to explore!
Saga.Xmas2011Saga_complete_body: Congratulations! Your hard work and giving spirit has spread holiday cheer across the North Pole!
Saga.act_Xmas2011_3_complete_body: Congratulations! You helped Mrs. Claus spread some holiday cheer and celebrate the season in style!
Saga.q_xmas_saga_act1_1_tooltip: Help Santa set up shop in your city!
Saga.q_xmas_saga_act1_2_tooltip: Make the elves feel at home in your city!
Saga.q_xmas_saga_act1_3_tooltip: Spread some holiday cheer in your city!
Saga.q_xmas_saga_act2_1_tooltip: Make sure Santa's elves don't come up short this Holiday season!
Saga.q_xmas_saga_act2_2_tooltip: Get Santa's reindeer ready so the Holidays can take flight!
Saga.q_xmas_saga_act2_3_tooltip: Turn your city into a full fledged Holiday headquarters!
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_salvador_1_tooltip: Help me take my casino resort to the top and I'll take you with me!
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_salvador_2_tooltip: What do a horse race and the Governor's Race have in common? You, that's what.
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_salvador_3_tooltip: Every patron at Salvador's is a potential voter!
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_bella_1_tooltip: Help me launch my own brand of products and I'll help you launch your political career!
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_bella_2_tooltip: Help me get a state of the art recording studio!
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_bella_3_tooltip: Every candidate needs a celebrity endorsement!
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_bella_4_tooltip: I want to touch people's lives with my own line of products!
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_vance_1_tooltip: Give back to the community and they'll give back to you.
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_vance_3_tooltip: Great leaders listen to      those around them.
Saga.q_governor_run_act3_vance_4_tooltip: Every great leader needs a lift at some point.
Saga.qf_halloween_1_3_tooltip: Help the monster population expand so the witches can take flight!
Saga.NewYears2012Resolutions_complete_body: Congratulations! You stuck to all of your New Year's Resolutions and you're well on your way to an amazing 2012!
Saga.act_new_years_2012_act1_complete_body: You stuck to your New Year's Resolution and have made a lot of kids and neighbors very happy!
Saga.act_new_years_2012_act2_complete_body: You stuck to your New Year's Resolution and you're on your way toward getting into tip top shape!
Saga.act_international_1_complete_body: You made quite the impression on these peeps! But you're not out of the wicked woods yet!
Saga.act_international_2_complete_title: You Showed The Peeps Who's Boss!
Saga.q_international_saga_act2_1_tooltip: Welcome Japan to your city and become an Ambassador to the world!
Saga.CityMapSaga_complete_body: You have done an amazing job of putting your city on the map and making it your nation's capital! Congratulations!
Saga.LoveStory_complete_body: Thanks to you, Sam had her pick of the litter of CityVille bachelors this Valentine's Day!
Saga.act_love_story_2012_act3_complete_body: I feel like I've known you for centuries! That alone has to be worth a second date!
Saga.CityAtNightSaga_complete_body: Thanks to you, your citizens are having the time of their lives in the Famous Nightlife District!
Saga.act_cityatnight_1_complete_body: Thanks to you, your city is shining brighter than ever! But the night's not over just yet!
Saga.act_cityatnight_2_complete_body: Thanks to you, your city's nightlife is hopping! But the night is still young!
Saga.act_cityatnight_3_complete_body: Thanks to you, your city's nightlife is in full swing! But it’s not bedtime just yet!
Saga.act_citymap_2012_complete_body: Your city has really made a name for itself! But now it’s time for you to really put your city on the map! Let's keep going!
Saga.act_halloween2012_1_complete_body: You really made your new spooky citizens feel welcome! But you've got a ghostly task ahead of you still!
Saga.act_halloween2012_3_complete_body: The ghostly ball has been frightning! All the ghostly guest have never felt so... dead!
Saga.Holiday2012Saga_complete_title: YOU'VE GOT THE BIGGEST TREE IN TOWN!
Saga.Holiday2012Saga_complete_body: You know how to create a holiday atmosphere to share with everyone! So generous!
Saga.act_holiday2012_2_complete_body: Everyone in town is flocking to your new ski slopes! Better print extra lift tickets!
Saga.LakefrontSaga_complete_body: You really made a splash with your beautiful Lakefront! Your citizens will be coming back here for years to come!
Saga.act_lakefront_1_complete_body: You have lured countless vacationers to your city's new Lakefront and they couldn't be happier!
Saga.act_lakefront_2_complete_body: You really took advantage of that fishing frenzy down by the lake! But now you've got bigger fish to fry!
Saga.act_lakefront_3_complete_body: You're really living large down by the lake! But don't get too comfortable! You're not done yet!
Saga.act_cityoftheyear_2012_complete_body: You’re on your way to becoming City of the Year, and your citizens are proud to live here!
